/**
 * 1. HTTP Function de Callback (blingCallback):
 * Recebe ?code=... da URL de redirecionamento do Bling OAuth 2.0,
 * troca pelos primeiros tokens via POST https://api.bling.com.br/v3/oauth/token
 * e salva na tabela BlingIntegration do PostgreSQL via Data Connect Admin SDK.
 */
export const blingCallback = onRequest(
  {
    region: 'southamerica-east1',
    secrets: [BLING_CLIENT_ID_SECRET, BLING_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRET],
    cors: false,
  },
  async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const oauthError = typeof req.query.error === 'string' ? req.query.error.trim() : '';
      if (oauthError) {
        res.status(400).send(`Erro retornado pelo Bling OAuth: ${oauthError}`);
        return;
      }

      const code = typeof req.query.code === 'string' ? req.query.code.trim() : '';
      if (!code) {
        res.status(400).send('Parâmetro "code" não encontrado na query string (?code=...).');
        return;
      }

      const forwardedProto = (req.headers['x-forwarded-proto'] as string) || req.protocol || 'https';
      const forwardedHost = (req.headers['x-forwarded-host'] as string) || req.get('host') || '';
      const redirectUri = forwardedHost ? `${forwardedProto}://${forwardedHost}${req.path}` : undefined;

      const saved = await exchangeBlingAuthorizationCode(code, redirectUri);

      res.status(200).send(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html lang="pt-BR">
          <head>
            <meta charset="utf-8" />
            <title>Bling ERP Conectado</title>
          </head>
          <body style="font-family:sans-serif;background:#0e0e0e;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;margin:0;">
            <div style="background:#171717;border:1px solid #2a2a2a;border-radius:12px;padding:32px;max-width:440px;text-align:center;">
              <h2 style="margin-top:0;color:#22c55e;">Bling ERP v3 Autorizado!</h2>
              <p style="color:#b3b3b3;font-size:14px;">
                Tokens iniciais salvos com segurança no PostgreSQL via Firebase Data Connect (<code>BlingIntegration</code>).
              </p>
              <p style="color:#737373;font-size:12px;">
                Próxima expiração do accessToken: ${new Date(saved.expiresAtMs).toISOString()}
              </p>
            </div>
          </body>
        </html>
      `);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      logger.error('Erro no blingCallback:', { error: message });
      res.status(500).send(`Falha ao concluir autenticação do Bling: ${message}`);
    }
  }
);

/**
 * 2. Prevenção de Inatividade (onSchedule a cada 15 dias):
 * Chama getValidBlingToken() periodicamente para rotacionar o refreshToken no PostgreSQL
 * antes do limite de 30 dias sem uso imposto pelo Bling v3.
 */
export const keepBlingTokenAlive = onSchedule(
  {
    schedule: '0 3 */15 * *', // A cada 15 dias às 03:00 (horário de Brasília)
    timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo',
    region: 'southamerica-east1',
    secrets: [BLING_CLIENT_ID_SECRET, BLING_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRET],
  },
  async () => {
    logger.info('Executando rotina preventiva de 15 dias do token Bling via Data Connect...');
    const token = await getValidBlingToken();
    logger.info('Token Bling validado/rotacionado com sucesso.', { hasToken: Boolean(token) });
  }
);

export function verifySyncSecret(providedSecret?: string | null): boolean {
  const expected = (process.env.CRON_SECRET || '').trim();
  const actual = (providedSecret || '').trim();

  if (!expected || !actual) {
    return false;
  }

  const expectedBuf = Buffer.from(expected, 'utf8');
  const actualBuf = Buffer.from(actual, 'utf8');
  if (expectedBuf.length !== actualBuf.length) {
    return false;
  }
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuf, actualBuf);
}

function cleanBlingDescription(raw?: string): string {
  if (!raw) return '';
  return String(raw)
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, '&')
    .replace(/<\/p>/gi, '\n\n')
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '')
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 1500);
}

function isThumbnailLikeUrl(url: string): boolean {
  const u = (url || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!u) return false;
  if (
    u.includes('miniatura') ||
    u.includes('/thumb/') ||
    u.includes('_thumb.') ||
    u.includes('-thumb.') ||
    u.includes('_mini.') ||
    u.includes('-mini.')
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  if (u.includes('orgbling.s3.amazonaws.com') || u.includes('bling.com')) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(u);
      if (/\/t\/[^/]+$/i.test(parsed.pathname) || /\/t\/[a-z0-9_-]{8,}/i.test(parsed.pathname)) {
        return true;
      }
    } catch {
      if (/\/t\/[a-z0-9_-]{8,}/i.test(u)) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function cleanBlingImageUrl(url?: string): string {
  const raw = String(url || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return '';
  if (raw.startsWith('/assets/')) return raw;
  if (!raw.startsWith('http://') && !raw.startsWith('https://')) {
    return '';
  }
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(raw);
    for (const key of ['w', 'h', 'width', 'height', 'size', 'quality', 'q', 'resize', 'fit', 'thumb', 'mini']) {
      parsed.searchParams.delete(key);
    }
    return parsed.toString();
  } catch {
    return raw;
  }
}

function extractAllImageUrls(item: BlingProdutoRaw): string[] {
  const highRes: string[] = [];
  const thumbs: string[] = [];

  const pushUrl = (raw: string | undefined, target: string[]) => {
    const cleaned = cleanBlingImageUrl(raw);
    if (cleaned && !target.includes(cleaned)) {
      target.push(cleaned);
    }
  };

  const internas = Array.isArray(item.midia?.imagens?.internas)
    ? [...item.midia!.imagens!.internas!].sort((a, b) => (a?.ordem ?? 0) - (b?.ordem ?? 0))
    : [];
  const externas = Array.isArray(item.midia?.imagens?.externas)
    ? [...item.midia!.imagens!.externas!].sort((a, b) => (a?.ordem ?? 0) - (b?.ordem ?? 0))
    : [];

  for (const entry of [...internas, ...externas]) {
    const full = entry?.link || entry?.url;
    if (full) {
      if (isThumbnailLikeUrl(full)) {
        pushUrl(full, thumbs);
      } else {
        pushUrl(full, highRes);
      }
    }
    if (entry?.linkMiniatura) {
      pushUrl(entry.linkMiniatura, thumbs);
    }
  }

  if (item.imagemURL) {
    if (isThumbnailLikeUrl(item.imagemURL)) {
      pushUrl(item.imagemURL, thumbs);
    } else {
      pushUrl(item.imagemURL, highRes);
    }
  }

  return highRes.length > 0 ? highRes : thumbs;
}

let cachedImageSeed: {
  byId: Record<string, string[]>;
  bySku: Record<string, string[]>;
} | null = null;

function loadReadOnlyImageSeed() {
  if (cachedImageSeed) return cachedImageSeed;
  const empty = { byId: {}, bySku: {} };
  try {
    const tmpSeed = path.resolve('/tmp', '.bling_product_images.json');
    const rootSeed = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.bling_product_images.json');
    const target = fs.existsSync(tmpSeed) ? tmpSeed : (fs.existsSync(rootSeed) ? rootSeed : null);
    if (target) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(target, 'utf8'));
      cachedImageSeed = {
        byId: parsed?.byId || {},
        bySku: parsed?.bySku || {},
      };
      return cachedImageSeed;
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore read-only cache errors
  }
  cachedImageSeed = empty;
  return cachedImageSeed;
}

function inferCategory(item: BlingProdutoRaw): {
  label: string;
  categoriaStore: 'roupas' | 'calcados' | 'acessorios';
  subcategoriaStore: 'hoodies' | 'camisetas' | 'calcas' | 'shorts' | 'sneakers' | 'bones' | 'bags' | 'acessorios-metal';
} {
  const rawDesc = String(item.categoria?.descricao || '').trim();
  const lower = `${rawDesc} ${String(item.nome || '')}`.toLowerCase();

  if (/\b(boné|bone|bucket|gorro|touca)\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return { label: rawDesc || 'Acessórios', categoriaStore: 'acessorios', subcategoriaStore: 'bones' };
  }
  if (/\b(bag|shoulder|mochila|pochete|mala)\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return { label: rawDesc || 'Acessórios', categoriaStore: 'acessorios', subcategoriaStore: 'bags' };
  }
  if (/\b(oculos|óculos|radar|juliet|penny|oakley|cartier|cinto|carteira|relogio|relógio|corrente|meia|cadarco|cadarço)\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return { label: rawDesc || 'Acessórios', categoriaStore: 'acessorios', subcategoriaStore: 'acessorios-metal' };
  }
  if (/\b(tenis|tênis|sneaker|chinelo|bota|sandalia|sapato|dunk|jordan|air max|yeezy)\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return { label: rawDesc || 'Calçados', categoriaStore: 'calcados', subcategoriaStore: 'sneakers' };
  }
  if (/\b(moletom|hoodie|jaqueta|corta vento|bobojoco|casaco)\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return { label: rawDesc || 'Moletons & Jaquetas', categoriaStore: 'roupas', subcategoriaStore: 'hoodies' };
  }
  if (/\b(calca|calça|cargo|jogger|jeans)\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return { label: rawDesc || 'Calças', categoriaStore: 'roupas', subcategoriaStore: 'calcas' };
  }
  if (/\b(bermuda|short)\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return { label: rawDesc || 'Bermudas & Shorts', categoriaStore: 'roupas', subcategoriaStore: 'shorts' };
  }

  return { label: rawDesc || 'Camisetas & Vestuário', categoriaStore: 'roupas', subcategoriaStore: 'camisetas' };
}

function parseVariantMeta(item: BlingProdutoRaw): {
  baseName: string;
  size: string;
  color: string;
} {
  const fullName = String(item.nome || '').trim();
  const varLabel = String(item.variacao?.nome || '').trim();

  let baseName = fullName;
  if (baseName.includes(' // ')) {
    baseName = baseName.split(' // ')[0].trim();
  } else if (baseName.includes(': ')) {
    baseName = baseName.split(': ')[0].trim();
  } else if (baseName.includes(' - Tam')) {
    baseName = baseName.split(' - Tam')[0].trim();
  }

  let size = '';
  if (varLabel) {
    const tamMatch = varLabel.match(/(?:tamanho|tam|size)\s*[:=]\s*([^;|,/]+)/i);
    if (tamMatch?.[1]) {
      size = tamMatch[1].trim();
    } else if (/^(PP|P|M|G|GG|XG|XGG|XXG|G[1-4]|Único|Unico|\d{2})$/i.test(varLabel)) {
      size = varLabel;
    }
  }

  if (!size && fullName.includes(':')) {
    const afterColon = fullName.split(':').slice(1).join(':').trim();
    if (afterColon && afterColon.length <= 24) {
      size = afterColon.replace(/^tam(?:anho)?\s*/i, '').trim();
    }
  }

  if (!size) {
    const endSizeMatch = fullName.match(/\b(PP|P|M|G|GG|XG|XGG|G[1-4]|3[4-9]|4[0-6])\s*$/i);
    if (endSizeMatch?.[1]) {
      size = endSizeMatch[1].toUpperCase();
    }
  }

  let color = '';
  const colorSource = `${varLabel} ${fullName}`;
  const colorMatch = colorSource.match(
    /\b(preto|preta|branco|branca|off[- ]?white|cinza|chumbo|grafite|azul|marinho|verde|militar|vermelho|vermelha|rosa|roxo|bege|caqui|marrom|laranja|amarelo)\b/i
  );
  if (colorMatch?.[1]) {
    color = colorMatch[1].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + colorMatch[1].slice(1).toLowerCase();
  }

  return {
    baseName: baseName || fullName || `Produto ${item.id}`,
    size: size || 'Único',
    color: color || 'Padrão',
  };
}

function getStockQuantity(item: BlingProdutoRaw, realStockMap?: Map<string, number>): number {
  const idKey = String(item.id);
  if (realStockMap && realStockMap.has(idKey)) {
    return realStockMap.get(idKey)!;
  }
  const raw =
    item.estoque?.saldoVirtualTotal ??
    item.estoque?.saldoFisicoTotal ??
    item.estoque?.saldoFisico ??
    0;
  const parsed = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? Math.max(0, parsed) : 0;
}

async function fetchBlingJson<T = unknown>(pathAndQuery: string): Promise<T> {
  return blingApiRequest<T>(pathAndQuery, { method: 'GET' });
}

async function fetchStockBalancesForIds(ids: string[]): Promise<Map<string, number>> {
  const stockMap = new Map<string, number>();
  const uniqueIds = Array.from(new Set(ids.filter(Boolean)));
  const chunks: string[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < uniqueIds.length; i += 50) {
    chunks.push(uniqueIds.slice(i, i + 50));
  }

  const results = await Promise.all(
    chunks.map(async (chunk) => {
      const qs = chunk.map((id) => `idsProdutos[]=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`).join('&');
      try {
        return await fetchBlingJson<{
          data?: Array<{
            produto?: { id?: number | string };
            saldoVirtualTotal?: number | string;
            saldoFisicoTotal?: number | string;
            saldoFisico?: number | string;
          }>;
        }>(`/estoques/saldos?${qs}`);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    })
  );

  for (const res of results) {
    for (const entry of res?.data || []) {
      const pId = entry?.produto?.id;
      if (pId !== undefined && pId !== null) {
        const bal = entry.saldoVirtualTotal ?? entry.saldoFisicoTotal ?? entry.saldoFisico ?? 0;
        stockMap.set(String(pId), Math.max(0, Number(bal) || 0));
      }
    }
  }
  return stockMap;
}

/**
 * Busca uma página (100 produtos ativos) na API v3 do Bling e grava em lote via WriteBatch
 * na coleção `products` do Firestore usando o `id` do Bling (ou `idProdutoPai` para variações)
 * como ID do documento com `{ merge: true }`.
 */
export async function syncBlingProdutosPageToFirestore(
  paginaInput: number,
  options?: { enrichHighResImages?: boolean; maxDetailMs?: number }
): Promise<SyncProdutosPageResult> {
  const pagina = Number.isFinite(paginaInput) && paginaInput >= 1 ? Math.floor(paginaInput) : 1;
  // Interceptor de pré-sincronização: valida expiração e renova via refresh_token se necessário
  await interceptBlingTokenBeforeSync();

  const json = await fetchBlingJson<{ data?: BlingProdutoRaw[] }>(
    `/produtos?pagina=${pagina}&limite=100&criterio=2`
  );

  const lista = Array.isArray(json.data) ? json.data : [];

  if (lista.length === 0) {
    return {
      success: true,
      finalizado: true,
      totalImportado: 0,
    };
  }

  // Busca saldos reais de estoque em até 2 chamadas (chunks de 50 IDs)
  const itemIds = lista.map((item) => String(item.id));
  const realStockMap = await fetchStockBalancesForIds(itemIds);
  const imageSeed = loadReadOnlyImageSeed();

  type GroupedProductWrite = {
    docId: string;
    blingId: string;
    nome?: string;
    codigo?: string;
    preco?: number;
    estoqueDireto?: number;
    imagens: string[];
    imagemURL?: string;
    categoria?: string;
    categoriaStore?: 'roupas' | 'calcados' | 'acessorios';
    subcategoriaStore?: string;
    categoriaId?: string | null;
    descricao?: string;
    sizes: Set<string>;
    colors: Set<string>;
    variacoes: Record<
      string,
      {
        blingId: string;
        codigo: string;
        nome: string;
        tamanho: string;
        cor: string;
        preco: number;
        estoque: number;
        imagemURL: string;
      }
    >;
    hasParentRecord: boolean;
  };

  const grouped = new Map<string, GroupedProductWrite>();

  const ensureGroup = (docId: string): GroupedProductWrite => {
    let entry = grouped.get(docId);
    if (!entry) {
      entry = {
        docId,
        blingId: docId,
        imagens: [],
        sizes: new Set<string>(),
        colors: new Set<string>(),
        variacoes: {},
        hasParentRecord: false,
      };
      grouped.set(docId, entry);
    }
    return entry;
  };

  const mergeImages = (target: string[], incoming: string[]) => {
    const combined = [...target];
    for (const url of incoming) {
      if (url && !combined.includes(url)) {
        combined.push(url);
      }
    }
    const fullRes = combined.filter((u) => !isThumbnailLikeUrl(u));
    return (fullRes.length > 0 ? fullRes : combined).slice(0, 10);
  };

  for (const item of lista) {
    const itemId = String(item.id);
    const parentIdRaw = item.idProdutoPai ?? item.variacao?.produtoPai?.id ?? null;
    const hasParent = parentIdRaw !== null && parentIdRaw !== undefined && Number(parentIdRaw) > 0;
    const docId = hasParent ? String(parentIdRaw) : itemId;

    const group = ensureGroup(docId);
    const meta = parseVariantMeta(item);
    const stock = getStockQuantity(item, realStockMap);
    const price = Number(item.preco || 0);
    const skuKey = String(item.codigo || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    const seedImgs = [
      ...(imageSeed.byId[itemId] || []),
      ...(hasParent ? imageSeed.byId[docId] || [] : []),
      ...(skuKey ? imageSeed.bySku[skuKey] || [] : []),
    ];
    const itemImgs = mergeImages(extractAllImageUrls(item), seedImgs);
    const primaryImg = itemImgs[0] || '';
    const catInfo = inferCategory(item);
    const desc = cleanBlingDescription(item.descricaoCurta || item.descricaoComplementar);

    if (itemImgs.length > 0) {
      group.imagens = mergeImages(group.imagens, itemImgs);
      group.imagemURL = group.imagens[0] || group.imagemURL;
    }

    if (!hasParent) {
      group.hasParentRecord = true;
      group.blingId = itemId;
      group.nome = meta.baseName;
      group.codigo = String(item.codigo || '');
      group.preco = price;
      group.estoqueDireto = stock;
      group.categoria = catInfo.label;
      group.categoriaStore = catInfo.categoriaStore;
      group.subcategoriaStore = catInfo.subcategoriaStore;
      group.categoriaId = item.categoria?.id ? String(item.categoria.id) : null;
      if (desc) group.descricao = desc;

      if (Array.isArray(item.variacoes) && item.variacoes.length > 0) {
        for (const v of item.variacoes) {
          const vMeta = parseVariantMeta(v);
          const vStock = getStockQuantity(v, realStockMap);
          const vPrice = Number(v.preco || price || 0);
          const vImgs = extractAllImageUrls(v);
          const vImg = vImgs[0] || primaryImg;
          if (vImgs.length > 0) {
            group.imagens = mergeImages(group.imagens, vImgs);
            group.imagemURL = group.imagens[0] || group.imagemURL;
          }
          group.sizes.add(vMeta.size);
          group.colors.add(vMeta.color);
          group.variacoes[String(v.id)] = {
            blingId: String(v.id),
            codigo: String(v.codigo || ''),
            nome: String(v.nome || meta.baseName),
            tamanho: vMeta.size,
            cor: vMeta.color,
            preco: vPrice,
            estoque: vStock,
            imagemURL: vImg,
          };
        }
      } else {
        if (meta.size !== 'Único') group.sizes.add(meta.size);
        if (meta.color !== 'Padrão') group.colors.add(meta.color);
      }
    } else {
      if (!group.nome) group.nome = meta.baseName;
      if (!group.categoria) {
        group.categoria = catInfo.label;
        group.categoriaStore = catInfo.categoriaStore;
        group.subcategoriaStore = catInfo.subcategoriaStore;
      }
      if (!group.preco && price > 0) group.preco = price;
      if (!group.descricao && desc) group.descricao = desc;

      group.sizes.add(meta.size);
      if (meta.color !== 'Padrão') group.colors.add(meta.color);

      group.variacoes[itemId] = {
        blingId: itemId,
        codigo: String(item.codigo || ''),
        nome: String(item.nome || meta.baseName),
        tamanho: meta.size,
        cor: meta.color,
        preco: price,
        estoque: stock,
        imagemURL: primaryImg,
      };
    }
  }

  // Enriquecimento opcional de imagens em alta resolução (.link via GET /produtos/{id}) respeitando teto de tempo
  if (options?.enrichHighResImages !== false) {
    const detailBudgetMs = options?.maxDetailMs ?? 2200;
    const detailStart = Date.now();
    const candidates = Array.from(grouped.values()).filter(
      (g) => g.imagens.length === 0 || g.imagens.every((u) => isThumbnailLikeUrl(u))
    );

    for (const group of candidates.slice(0, 8)) {
      if (Date.now() - detailStart >= detailBudgetMs) break;
      try {
        const detail = await fetchBlingJson<{ data?: BlingProdutoRaw }>(`/produtos/${group.docId}`);
        const fullItem = detail?.data;
        if (fullItem) {
          const fullImgs = extractAllImageUrls(fullItem);
          if (fullImgs.length > 0) {
            group.imagens = mergeImages(fullImgs, group.imagens);
            group.imagemURL = group.imagens[0] || group.imagemURL;
          }
          const fullDesc = cleanBlingDescription(fullItem.descricaoCurta || fullItem.descricaoComplementar);
          if (fullDesc && !group.descricao) {
            group.descricao = fullDesc;
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // Continua graciosamente sem travar o lote
      }
    }
  }

  const db = getAdminFirestore();
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const entries = Array.from(grouped.values());

  // Firestore WriteBatch suporta no máximo 500 operações por commit
  for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i += 400) {
    const slice = entries.slice(i, i + 400);
    const batch = db.batch();

    for (const group of slice) {
      const docRef = db.collection('products').doc(group.docId);
      const variacoesList = Object.values(group.variacoes);
      const estoqueTotalVariacoes = variacoesList.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v.estoque, 0);

      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        blingId: group.blingId,
        ativo: true,
        updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        syncedAtIso: nowIso,
      };

      if (group.hasParentRecord) {
        payload.nome = group.nome;
        payload.codigo = group.codigo;
        payload.preco = group.preco ?? 0;
        payload.estoque = variacoesList.length > 0 ? estoqueTotalVariacoes : (group.estoqueDireto ?? 0);
        if (group.imagemURL) payload.imagemURL = group.imagemURL;
        if (group.imagens.length > 0) payload.imagens = group.imagens;
        if (group.categoria) payload.categoria = group.categoria;
        if (group.categoriaStore) payload.categoriaStore = group.categoriaStore;
        if (group.subcategoriaStore) payload.subcategoriaStore = group.subcategoriaStore;
        if (group.categoriaId !== undefined) payload.categoriaId = group.categoriaId;
        if (group.descricao) payload.descricao = group.descricao;
      } else {
        if (group.nome) payload.nome = group.nome;
        if (group.categoria) payload.categoria = group.categoria;
        if (group.categoriaStore) payload.categoriaStore = group.categoriaStore;
        if (group.subcategoriaStore) payload.subcategoriaStore = group.subcategoriaStore;
        if (group.imagemURL) payload.imagemURL = group.imagemURL;
        if (group.imagens.length > 0) payload.imagens = group.imagens;
        if (group.preco !== undefined && group.preco > 0) payload.preco = group.preco;
        if (group.descricao) payload.descricao = group.descricao;
        if (variacoesList.length > 0) {
          payload.estoque = estoqueTotalVariacoes;
        }
      }

      if (group.sizes.size > 0) {
        payload.tamanhos = FieldValue.arrayUnion(...Array.from(group.sizes));
      }
      if (group.colors.size > 0) {
        payload.cores = FieldValue.arrayUnion(...Array.from(group.colors));
      }
      if (Object.keys(group.variacoes).length > 0) {
        payload.variacoes = group.variacoes;
      }

      batch.set(docRef, payload, { merge: true });
    }

    await batch.commit();
  }

  const isLastPage = lista.length < 100;

  return {
    success: true,
    finalizado: isLastPage,
    ...(isLastPage ? { totalImportado: lista.length } : { proximaPagina: pagina + 1 }),
    importadosNaPagina: lista.length,
    documentosGravados: grouped.size,
  };
}

/**
 * Percorre automaticamente páginas do Bling (`pagina = startPage` até o fim)
 * dentro de um orçamento de tempo seguro para nunca estourar o timeout da Vercel.
 */
export async function syncAllBlingProdutosToFirestore(options?: {
  startPage?: number;
  maxExecutionMs?: number;
  maxPages?: number;
  enrichHighResImages?: boolean;
}): Promise<SyncAllResult> {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  const startPage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(options?.startPage || 1));
  const maxExecutionMs = Math.max(2000, options?.maxExecutionMs ?? (process.env.VERCEL ? 8200 : 120000));
  const maxPages = Math.max(1, options?.maxPages ?? 100);

  let currentPage = startPage;
  let ultimaPagina = startPage;
  let paginasProcessadas = 0;
  let totalImportado = 0;
  let documentosGravados = 0;
  let finalizado = false;
  let paradoPorTempoLimite = false;

  while (paginasProcessadas < maxPages) {
    const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
    if (paginasProcessadas > 0 && elapsed >= maxExecutionMs) {
      paradoPorTempoLimite = true;
      break;
    }

    const remainingBudget = Math.max(500, maxExecutionMs - elapsed);
    const pageResult = await syncBlingProdutosPageToFirestore(currentPage, {
      enrichHighResImages: options?.enrichHighResImages ?? false,
      maxDetailMs: Math.min(1200, Math.floor(remainingBudget * 0.2)),
    });

    ultimaPagina = currentPage;
    paginasProcessadas++;
    totalImportado += pageResult.importadosNaPagina || 0;
    documentosGravados += pageResult.documentosGravados || 0;

    if (pageResult.finalizado) {
      finalizado = true;
      break;
    }

    currentPage = pageResult.proximaPagina || currentPage + 1;
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    finalizado,
    paginaInicial: startPage,
    ultimaPagina,
    ...(finalizado ? {} : { proximaPagina: currentPage }),
    paginasProcessadas,
    totalImportado,
    documentosGravados,
    duracaoMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
    ...(paradoPorTempoLimite ? { paradoPorTempoLimite: true } : {}),
  };
}

import { Timestamp } from 'firebase-admin/firestore';
import { getAdminFirestore, isFirebaseAdminConfigured } from './firebaseAdmin';

export const BLING_AUTHORIZE_URL = 'https://www.bling.com.br/Api/v3/oauth/authorize';
export const BLING_TOKEN_ENDPOINT = 'https://www.bling.com.br/Api/v3/oauth/token';
export const BLING_TOKEN_FALLBACK_ENDPOINT = 'https://api.bling.com.br/v3/oauth/token';
export const BLING_OFFICIAL_API_BASE = 'https://www.bling.com.br/Api/v3';
export const BLING_API_BASE = 'https://api.bling.com.br/v3';
const BLING_FIRESTORE_DOC = 'integrations/bling';

const SIX_HOURS_MS = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const REFRESH_THRESHOLD_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000; // Renova se faltar menos de 10 minutos para vencer

export interface BlingFirestoreTokenDoc {
  access_token: string;
  refresh_token: string;
  expires_at: number; // Timestamp UTC em milissegundos
  expires_at_iso?: string;
  expires_in?: number;
  token_type?: string;
  scope?: string;
  obtained_at?: number;
  updated_at?: string;
  refreshing_until?: number;
}

interface BlingTokenApiResponse {
  access_token: string;
  refresh_token: string;
  expires_in?: number;
  token_type?: string;
  scope?: string;
  error?: string | { message?: string; description?: string };
  error_description?: string;
}

let activeRefreshPromise: Promise<string> | null = null;

export function hasFirebaseAdminEnv(): boolean {
  return isFirebaseAdminConfigured();
}

function getBlingBasicAuthHeader(): string {
  const clientId = (process.env.BLING_CLIENT_ID || '').trim();
  const clientSecret = (process.env.BLING_CLIENT_SECRET || '').trim();

  if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
    throw new Error('Variáveis BLING_CLIENT_ID e BLING_CLIENT_SECRET não configuradas em process.env.');
  }

  const credentialsBase64 = Buffer.from(`${clientId}:${clientSecret}`, 'utf8').toString('base64');
  return `Basic ${credentialsBase64}`;
}

function extractJwtExpiresAtMs(token?: string): number {
  if (!token || !token.includes('.')) return 0;
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return 0;
    const payloadB64 = parts[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const jsonStr = Buffer.from(payloadB64, 'base64').toString('utf8');
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr) as { exp?: unknown };
    if (typeof parsed.exp === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsed.exp) && parsed.exp > 0) {
      return parsed.exp * 1000;
    }
  } catch {
    // Bling pode emitir token opaco em vez de JWT — ignora silenciosamente
  }
  return 0;
}

function resolveExpiresAtMs(rawExpiresAt: unknown, accessToken?: string): number {
  if (typeof rawExpiresAt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(rawExpiresAt) && rawExpiresAt > 0) {
    return rawExpiresAt;
  }
  if (rawExpiresAt && typeof (rawExpiresAt as Timestamp).toMillis === 'function') {
    return (rawExpiresAt as Timestamp).toMillis();
  }
  if (typeof rawExpiresAt === 'string') {
    const parsed = Date.parse(rawExpiresAt);
    if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0) {
      return parsed;
    }
  }
  return extractJwtExpiresAtMs(accessToken);
}

export function isBlingTokenExpiringOrExpired(
  accessToken: string | undefined,
  expiresAtMs: number,
  thresholdMs: number = REFRESH_THRESHOLD_MS
): boolean {
  if (!accessToken || !accessToken.trim()) return true;
  const jwtExp = extractJwtExpiresAtMs(accessToken);
  const effectiveExpiresAt =
    expiresAtMs > 0 && jwtExp > 0
      ? Math.min(expiresAtMs, jwtExp)
      : (expiresAtMs || jwtExp);

  if (effectiveExpiresAt <= 0) return true;
  return effectiveExpiresAt - Date.now() <= thresholdMs;
}

async function postBlingTokenForm(body: URLSearchParams): Promise<{ status: number; rawText: string; ok: boolean }> {
  const headers = {
    Authorization: getBlingBasicAuthHeader(),
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    Accept: 'application/json',
    'User-Agent': 'StreetStore/1.0',
  };

  let response = await fetch(BLING_TOKEN_ENDPOINT, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers,
    body: body.toString(),
  });

  if (response.status === 403) {
    response = await fetch(BLING_TOKEN_FALLBACK_ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers,
      body: body.toString(),
    });
  }

  const rawText = await response.text();
  return { status: response.status, rawText, ok: response.ok };
}

export async function saveBlingTokensToFirestore(payload: {
  access_token: string;
  refresh_token: string;
  expires_in?: number;
  token_type?: string;
  scope?: string;
}): Promise<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc> {
  if (!payload.access_token || !payload.refresh_token) {
    throw new Error('Resposta do Bling não retornou access_token e refresh_token válidos.');
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const expiresInSec = Number(payload.expires_in) || 21600; // 6 horas padrão Bling v3
  const expiresAtMs = now + (payload.expires_in ? expiresInSec * 1000 : SIX_HOURS_MS);

  const docData: BlingFirestoreTokenDoc = {
    access_token: payload.access_token,
    refresh_token: payload.refresh_token,
    expires_at: expiresAtMs,
    expires_at_iso: new Date(expiresAtMs).toISOString(),
    expires_in: expiresInSec,
    token_type: payload.token_type || 'Bearer',
    scope: payload.scope || '',
    obtained_at: now,
    updated_at: new Date(now).toISOString(),
    refreshing_until: 0,
  };

  // Sobrescreve ambos (access_token e refresh_token) + expires_at em integrations/bling
  const db = getAdminFirestore();
  await db.doc(BLING_FIRESTORE_DOC).set(docData, { merge: false });

  return docData;
}

export async function getBlingTokenStatusFromFirestore(): Promise<Partial<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc> | null> {
  if (!hasFirebaseAdminEnv()) return null;
  try {
    const snap = await getAdminFirestore().doc(BLING_FIRESTORE_DOC).get();
    if (!snap.exists) return null;
    return snap.data() as Partial<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc>;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function hasFirestoreBlingToken(): Promise<boolean> {
  const data = await getBlingTokenStatusFromFirestore();
  return Boolean(data && (data.access_token || data.refresh_token));
}

/**
 * Troca o authorization_code recebido em /api/bling/callback pelos primeiros tokens
 * e grava no documento integrations/bling do Firestore.
 */
export async function exchangeBlingCodeForTokens(
  code: string,
  redirectUri?: string
): Promise<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc> {
  const cleanCode = code.trim();
  if (!cleanCode) {
    throw new Error('Parâmetro code é obrigatório para troca no Bling.');
  }

  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    grant_type: 'authorization_code',
    code: cleanCode,
  });

  const resolvedRedirect = (redirectUri || process.env.BLING_REDIRECT_URI || '').trim();
  if (resolvedRedirect) {
    body.set('redirect_uri', resolvedRedirect);
  }

  const { status, rawText, ok } = await postBlingTokenForm(body);

  let json: BlingTokenApiResponse;
  try {
    json = JSON.parse(rawText) as BlingTokenApiResponse;
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Bling retornou resposta não-JSON [${status}]: ${rawText}`);
  }

  if (!ok || json.error || !json.access_token || !json.refresh_token) {
    const errDetail =
      (typeof json.error === 'object' ? json.error?.message || json.error?.description : json.error) ||
      json.error_description ||
      rawText;
    throw new Error(`Erro Bling OAuth [${status}]: ${errDetail}`);
  }

  return saveBlingTokensToFirestore(json);
}

/**
 * Renova o par de tokens via grant_type=refresh_token com trava distribuída no Firestore
 * para impedir race-condition entre instâncias serverless paralelas, e sobrescreve
 * o novo access_token, o novo refresh_token e o expires_at em integrations/bling.
 */
export async function refreshBlingTokenInFirestore(
  currentRefreshToken: string,
  options?: { force?: boolean; failedAccessToken?: string }
): Promise<string> {
  if (activeRefreshPromise) {
    return activeRefreshPromise;
  }

  activeRefreshPromise = (async () => {
    const db = getAdminFirestore();
    const docRef = db.doc(BLING_FIRESTORE_DOC);

    // 1. Trava distribuída rápida via transação no Firestore para evitar dois containers renovando o mesmo refresh_token único
    let tokenToUse = currentRefreshToken.trim();
    const lockUntil = Date.now() + 15000;
    const failedToken = (options?.failedAccessToken || '').trim();

    try {
      const txResult = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
        const snap = await tx.get(docRef);
        if (!snap.exists) {
          return { action: 'proceed' as const, refreshToken: tokenToUse, accessToken: '' };
        }
        const data = snap.data() as Partial<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc>;
        const latestAccess = (data.access_token || '').trim();
        const latestExpires = resolveExpiresAtMs(data.expires_at, latestAccess);
        const latestRefresh = (data.refresh_token || '').trim();

        const isDifferentValidToken = !options?.force || (Boolean(failedToken) && latestAccess !== failedToken);

        // Outra instância acabou de renovar e o token agora é válido (> 10 min)
        if (latestAccess && isDifferentValidToken && !isBlingTokenExpiringOrExpired(latestAccess, latestExpires)) {
          return { action: 'use_existing' as const, accessToken: latestAccess, refreshToken: latestRefresh };
        }

        // Outra instância está renovando neste instante
        if (typeof data.refreshing_until === 'number' && data.refreshing_until > Date.now()) {
          return { action: 'wait_peer' as const, accessToken: latestAccess, refreshToken: latestRefresh };
        }

        tx.set(docRef, { refreshing_until: lockUntil }, { merge: true });
        return {
          action: 'proceed' as const,
          accessToken: latestAccess,
          refreshToken: latestRefresh || tokenToUse,
        };
      });

      if (txResult.action === 'use_existing' && txResult.accessToken) {
        return txResult.accessToken;
      }

      if (txResult.action === 'wait_peer') {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200));
        const afterWait = await docRef.get();
        const afterData = afterWait.data() as Partial<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc> | undefined;
        const afterAccess = (afterData?.access_token || '').trim();
        const afterExpires = resolveExpiresAtMs(afterData?.expires_at, afterAccess);
        if (afterAccess && !isBlingTokenExpiringOrExpired(afterAccess, afterExpires) && afterAccess !== failedToken) {
          return afterAccess;
        }
        if (afterData?.refresh_token) {
          tokenToUse = afterData.refresh_token.trim();
        }
      } else if (txResult.refreshToken) {
        tokenToUse = txResult.refreshToken;
      }
    } catch {
      // Continua com tokenToUse caso transação sofra contenção
    }

    if (!tokenToUse) {
      throw new Error('refresh_token ausente em integrations/bling.');
    }

    console.log('[Bling Interceptor] Token expirado ou próximo do vencimento — renovando via refresh_token...');

    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: 'refresh_token',
      refresh_token: tokenToUse,
    });

    const { status, rawText, ok } = await postBlingTokenForm(body);

    let json: BlingTokenApiResponse;
    try {
      json = JSON.parse(rawText) as BlingTokenApiResponse;
    } catch {
      await docRef.set({ refreshing_until: 0 }, { merge: true }).catch(() => {});
      throw new Error(`Erro ao renovar token Bling [${status}]: ${rawText}`);
    }

    if (!ok || json.error || !json.access_token || !json.refresh_token) {
      await docRef.set({ refreshing_until: 0 }, { merge: true }).catch(() => {});

      // Se falhou porque outro processo acabou de rotacionar o refresh_token no Firestore, recupera o novo token!
      const fallbackSnap = await docRef.get().catch(() => null);
      const fallbackData = fallbackSnap?.data() as Partial<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc> | undefined;
      const fallbackRefresh = (fallbackData?.refresh_token || '').trim();
      const fallbackAccess = (fallbackData?.access_token || '').trim();
      const fallbackExpires = resolveExpiresAtMs(fallbackData?.expires_at, fallbackAccess);

      if (
        fallbackAccess &&
        fallbackRefresh &&
        fallbackRefresh !== tokenToUse &&
        fallbackExpires > Date.now() &&
        fallbackAccess !== failedToken
      ) {
        return fallbackAccess;
      }

      const errDetail =
        (typeof json.error === 'object' ? json.error?.message || json.error?.description : json.error) ||
        json.error_description ||
        rawText;
      throw new Error(`Falha ao renovar refresh_token Bling [${status}]: ${errDetail}`);
    }

    const saved = await saveBlingTokensToFirestore(json);
    console.log(`[Bling Interceptor] Token renovado com sucesso (expira em ${saved.expires_at_iso}).`);
    return saved.access_token;
  })().finally(() => {
    activeRefreshPromise = null;
  });

  return activeRefreshPromise;
}

/**
 * Middleware/Função Interceptora (getValidBlingToken):
 * Lê integrations/bling no Firestore, verifica validade (expiração) do access_token
 * e usa refresh_token para renovar de forma transparente antes de qualquer requisição/sincronização.
 */
export async function getValidBlingToken(): Promise<string> {
  const db = getAdminFirestore();
  const snap = await db.doc(BLING_FIRESTORE_DOC).get();

  if (!snap.exists) {
    throw new Error(
      'Documento integrations/bling não encontrado no Firestore. Autorize primeiro via /api/bling/callback?code=...'
    );
  }

  const data = snap.data() as Partial<BlingFirestoreTokenDoc> | undefined;
  const accessToken = (data?.access_token || '').trim();
  const refreshToken = (data?.refresh_token || '').trim();
  const expiresAtMs = resolveExpiresAtMs(data?.expires_at, accessToken);

  if (!refreshToken) {
    throw new Error('Documento integrations/bling sem refresh_token. Refaça a autorização inicial do Bling.');
  }

  if (isBlingTokenExpiringOrExpired(accessToken, expiresAtMs)) {
    return refreshBlingTokenInFirestore(refreshToken);
  }

  return accessToken;
}

export const interceptBlingTokenBeforeSync = getValidBlingToken;

/**
 * Interceptor HTTP completo para todas as requisições à API v3 do Bling:
 * 1. Antes da chamada, valida expiração e renova via refresh_token se expirado ou < 10 min.
 * 2. Trata 429 (Rate Limit) com backoff progressivo.
 * 3. Em 401 inesperado, força renovação via refresh_token e reexecuta transparentemente.
 */
export async function blingApiRequest<T = unknown>(
  endpoint: string,
  init: RequestInit = {},
  rateLimitAttempt: number = 0
): Promise<T> {
  const token = await getValidBlingToken();
  const url = endpoint.startsWith('http') ? endpoint : `${BLING_API_BASE}${endpoint}`;

  const response = await fetch(url, {
    ...init,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      Accept: 'application/json',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'StreetStore/1.0',
      ...(init.headers || {}),
    },
  });

  if (response.status === 429 && rateLimitAttempt < 3) {
    const waitMs = 600 * (rateLimitAttempt + 1);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, waitMs));
    return blingApiRequest<T>(endpoint, init, rateLimitAttempt + 1);
  }

  if (response.status === 401) {
    const snap = await getAdminFirestore().doc(BLING_FIRESTORE_DOC).get();
    const currentRefresh = (snap.data()?.refresh_token as string | undefined) || '';
    if (currentRefresh) {
      const freshToken = await refreshBlingTokenInFirestore(currentRefresh, {
        force: true,
        failedAccessToken: token,
      });
      const retryRes = await fetch(url, {
        ...init,
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${freshToken}`,
          Accept: 'application/json',
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'User-Agent': 'StreetStore/1.0',
          ...(init.headers || {}),
        },
      });
      if (!retryRes.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Bling API [${retryRes.status}]: ${(await retryRes.text()).slice(0, 300)}`);
      }
      return retryRes.json() as Promise<T>;
    }
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Bling API [${response.status}]: ${(await response.text()).slice(0, 300)}`);
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { App, cert, getApps, initializeApp, ServiceAccount } from 'firebase-admin/app';
import { Firestore, getFirestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore';

type ParsedServiceAccount = ServiceAccount & {
  project_id?: string;
  client_email?: string;
  private_key?: string;
};

function isPlaceholderValue(val: string): boolean {
  const upper = val.trim().toUpperCase();
  return !upper || upper.startsWith('YOUR_') || upper.startsWith('MY_') || upper === 'REPLACE_ME';
}

function parseServiceAccountFromEnv(): ParsedServiceAccount {
  const rawJsonOrBase64 = (
    process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY ||
    process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT ||
    ''
  ).trim();

  if (rawJsonOrBase64 && !isPlaceholderValue(rawJsonOrBase64)) {
    let jsonString = rawJsonOrBase64;
    if (!rawJsonOrBase64.startsWith('{')) {
      try {
        jsonString = Buffer.from(rawJsonOrBase64, 'base64').toString('utf8').trim();
      } catch {
        throw new Error('FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT inválida: não é JSON nem Base64 válido.');
      }
    }

    let parsed: ParsedServiceAccount;
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(jsonString) as ParsedServiceAccount;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      throw new Error(`Falha ao fazer parse do JSON do Firebase Service Account: ${msg}`);
    }

    if (typeof parsed.private_key === 'string') {
      parsed.private_key = parsed.private_key.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    }
    if (!parsed.projectId && parsed.project_id) {
      parsed.projectId = parsed.project_id;
    }
    if (!parsed.clientEmail && parsed.client_email) {
      parsed.clientEmail = parsed.client_email;
    }
    if (!parsed.privateKey && parsed.private_key) {
      parsed.privateKey = parsed.private_key;
    }

    return parsed;
  }

  // Fallback para variáveis individuais da Vercel: FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL, FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY
  const projectId = (process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || '').trim();
  const clientEmail = (process.env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL || '').trim();
  const rawPrivateKey = (process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY || '').trim();

  if (
    projectId &&
    clientEmail &&
    rawPrivateKey &&
    !isPlaceholderValue(projectId) &&
    !isPlaceholderValue(clientEmail) &&
    !isPlaceholderValue(rawPrivateKey)
  ) {
    const privateKey = rawPrivateKey.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    return {
      projectId,
      clientEmail,
      privateKey,
      project_id: projectId,
      client_email: clientEmail,
      private_key: privateKey,
    };
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Credenciais do Firebase Admin não configuradas. Defina FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (ou FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY) em JSON/Base64 ou as variáveis individuais FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL e FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY.'
  );
}

export function isFirebaseAdminConfigured(): boolean {
  try {
    const sa = parseServiceAccountFromEnv();
    return Boolean((sa.projectId || sa.project_id) && (sa.clientEmail || sa.client_email) && (sa.privateKey || sa.private_key));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

let cachedProjectId = '';

function resolveDatabaseId(projectId?: string): string {
  const envDbId = (process.env.FIREBASE_DATABASE_ID || '').trim();
  if (envDbId && envDbId !== '(default)') {
    return envDbId;
  }

  try {
    const configPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'firebase-applet-config.json');
    if (fs.existsSync(configPath)) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8')) as {
        projectId?: string;
        firestoreDatabaseId?: string;
      };
      if (
        parsed?.firestoreDatabaseId &&
        parsed.firestoreDatabaseId !== '(default)' &&
        (!projectId || !parsed.projectId || parsed.projectId === projectId)
      ) {
        return parsed.firestoreDatabaseId;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Nunca crasha caso firebase-applet-config.json esteja ausente no bundle serverless
  }

  if (projectId === 'gen-lang-client-0932917743') {
    return 'ai-studio-streetstoreautor-c6d5cd06-e80e-408d-80ad-ef741184e925';
  }

  return envDbId || '(default)';
}

export function getFirebaseAdminApp(): App {
  if (!getApps().length) {
    const serviceAccount = parseServiceAccountFromEnv();
    cachedProjectId = String(serviceAccount.projectId || serviceAccount.project_id || '');
    return initializeApp({
      credential: cert(serviceAccount),
    });
  }

  return getApps()[0];
}

/**
 * Retorna a instância do Firestore com privilégios Admin SDK.
 * Usa FIREBASE_DATABASE_ID, o banco provisionado se o projectId coincidir, ou "(default)".
 */
export function getAdminFirestore(): Firestore {
  const app = getFirebaseAdminApp();
  const projectId = cachedProjectId || app.options.projectId;
  const databaseId = resolveDatabaseId(projectId);

  if (databaseId && databaseId !== '(default)') {
    return getFirestore(app, databaseId);
  }

  return getFirestore(app);
}

function resolveMelhorEnvioBaseUrl(): string {

  for (const raw of candidates) {
    const cleaned = (raw || '')
      .trim()

/**
 * Calcula fretes disponíveis na API v2 do Melhor Envio (POST /api/v2/me/shipment/calculate).
 */
export async function calcularFreteMelhorEnvio(params: {
  cepDestino: string;
  cepOrigem?: string;
  produtos: ProdutoFreteInput[];
}): Promise<CalcularFreteResult> {
  const { token, apiBaseUrl, userAgent, fromPostalCode } = getMelhorEnvioConfig();
  const cepDestino = sanitizeCep(params.cepDestino);
  const cepOrigem = sanitizeCep(params.cepOrigem || fromPostalCode);

  if (cepDestino.length !== 8) {
    throw new Error('CEP de destino inválido. Informe 8 dígitos numéricos.');
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(params.produtos) || params.produtos.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Informe ao menos um produto com dimensões e peso para cálculo do frete.');
  }

  const productsPayload = params.produtos.map((item, index) => {
    const peso = Number(item.weight ?? item.peso ?? 0.35);
    const altura = Number(item.height ?? item.altura ?? 5);
    const largura = Number(item.width ?? item.largura ?? 24);
    const comprimento = Number(item.length ?? item.comprimento ?? 30);
    const valorSegurado = Number(item.insurance_value ?? item.valorSegurado ?? item.preco ?? 50);
    const quantidade = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(item.quantity ?? item.quantidade ?? 1)));

    return {
      id: String(item.id ?? `item-${index + 1}`),
      width: Math.max(11, largura),
      height: Math.max(2, altura),
      length: Math.max(16, comprimento),
      weight: Math.max(0.1, Number(peso.toFixed(3))),
      insurance_value: Math.max(1, Number(valorSegurado.toFixed(2))),
      quantity: quantidade,
    };
  });

  const response = await fetch(`${apiBaseUrl}/me/shipment/calculate`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Accept: 'application/json',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      'User-Agent': userAgent,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from: { postal_code: cepOrigem },
      to: { postal_code: cepDestino },
      products: productsPayload,
    }),
  });

  const rawText = await response.text();
  let json: unknown;
  try {
    json = JSON.parse(rawText);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`Resposta inválida do Melhor Envio [${response.status}]: ${rawText}`);
  }

  if (!response.ok || !Array.isArray(json)) {
    const errObj = json as { message?: string; error?: string; errors?: unknown };
    const detail = errObj?.message || errObj?.error || rawText;
    throw new Error(`Erro Melhor Envio [${response.status}]: ${detail}`);
  }

  const transportadoras: TransportadoraFormatada[] = json
    .filter((opt: any) => !opt?.error && (opt?.custom_price || opt?.price))
    .map((opt: any) => {
      const preco = Number(parseFloat(String(opt.custom_price || opt.price || '0')).toFixed(2));
      const prazo = parseInt(String(opt.custom_delivery_time || opt.delivery_time || '5'), 10);

      return {
        id: Number(opt.id),
        nome: String(opt.name || 'Frete'),
        empresa: {
          id: Number(opt.company?.id || 0),
          nome: String(opt.company?.name || 'Transportadora'),
          logo: String(opt.company?.picture || ''),
        },
        preco,
        precoFormatado: preco.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
          style: 'currency',
          currency: 'BRL',
        }),
        desconto: Number(parseFloat(String(opt.discount || '0')).toFixed(2)),
        moeda: String(opt.currency || 'BRL'),
        prazoEntregaDias: prazo,
        prazoTexto: prazo === 1 ? '1 dia útil' : `${prazo} dias úteis`,
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.preco - b.preco);

  return {
    sucesso: true,
    cepOrigem,
    cepDestino,
    transportadoras,
  };
}

      document: from.documento.replace(/\D/g, ''),
      address: from.endereco,
      number: from.numero,
      complement: from.complemento || '',
      district: from.bairro,

      state_abbr: from.estado.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
      country_id: 'BR',
      postal_code: sanitizeCep(from.cep),

interface ImageStore {
  updatedAt: string;
  bySku: Record<string, string[]>;
  byName: Record<string, string[]>;
  byId: Record<string, string[]>;
}

function normalizeName(name: string): string {
  let n = (name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (n.includes(':')) n = n.split(':')[0].trim();
  if (n.includes(' // ')) n = n.split(' // ')[0].trim();
  n = n.replace(/\s+-\s+(pp|p|m|g|gg|xg|xgg|g1|g2|\d{2})$/i, '').trim();
  return n.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

async function main() {

  const storePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.bling_product_images.json');
  let store: ImageStore = {
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    bySku: {},
    byName: {},
    byId: {}
  };

  if (fs.existsSync(storePath)) {
    try {
      store = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(storePath, 'utf8'));

      // fresh
    }

    });

    if (res.ok) {

        const imgUrls = (p.images || []).map((img: any) => img.src).filter(Boolean);

              const prefixMatch = skuKey.match(/^([A-Z]+)(\d+)?$/);
              if (prefixMatch && prefixMatch[1]) {
                const prefix = prefixMatch[1];
                if (!store.bySku[prefix]) store.bySku[prefix] = imgUrls;
              }
            }
          });

=== ARQUIVO: src\components\AdminBlingSyncPage.tsx ===
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Lock,
  RefreshCw,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowLeft,
  PackageCheck,
  ShieldCheck,
  StopCircle,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface SyncPageResponse {
  finalizado: boolean;
  totalImportado?: number;
  proximaPagina?: number;
  ultimaPagina?: number;
  paginasProcessadas?: number;
  importadosNaPagina?: number;
  documentosGravados?: number;
  authorized?: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

const SESSION_KEY = 'bling_admin_sync_secret';
const ESTIMATED_TOTAL_PAGES = 15;

export function AdminBlingSyncPage() {
  const [secretInput, setSecretInput] = useState('');
  const [verifiedSecret, setVerifiedSecret] = useState<string>('');
  const [isVerifying, setIsVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState('');

  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [isFinished, setIsFinished] = useState(false);
  const [syncError, setSyncError] = useState('');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(0);
  const [estimatedPages, setEstimatedPages] = useState(ESTIMATED_TOTAL_PAGES);
  const [totalImported, setTotalImported] = useState(0);
  const [totalDocsWritten, setTotalDocsWritten] = useState(0);
  const [lastBatchInfo, setLastBatchInfo] = useState<string>('');

  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const cancelledRef = useRef(false);

  // Restaura senha da sessão apenas se validada anteriormente nesta aba
  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      setVerifiedSecret(saved);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleUnlock = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const candidate = secretInput.trim();
    if (!candidate) {
      setAuthError('Digite o CRON_SECRET para liberar o painel.');
      return;
    }

    setIsVerifying(true);
    setAuthError('');

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/bling/sync?verify=true', {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
          'x-cron-secret': candidate,
        },
      });
      const data = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as SyncPageResponse;

      if (!response.ok || !data.authorized) {
        setAuthError(data.error || 'Senha inválida. Acesso negado.');
        return;
      }

      sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, candidate);
      setVerifiedSecret(candidate);
      setSecretInput('');
    } catch {
      setAuthError('Erro de conexão ao validar a senha no servidor.');
    } finally {
      setIsVerifying(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLock = () => {
    if (isSyncing) return;
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
    setVerifiedSecret('');
    setIsFinished(false);
    setSyncError('');
  };

  const handleStopSync = () => {
    cancelledRef.current = true;
    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  };

  const handleStartSync = async () => {
    if (!verifiedSecret || isSyncing) return;

    cancelledRef.current = false;
    setIsSyncing(true);
    setIsFinished(false);
    setSyncError('');
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setEstimatedPages(ESTIMATED_TOTAL_PAGES);
    setTotalImported(0);
    setTotalDocsWritten(0);
    setLastBatchInfo('Iniciando conexão segura com a API v3 do Bling...');

    let pagina = 1;
    let finalizado = false;
    let acumuladoProdutos = 0;
    let acumuladoDocs = 0;

    try {
      while (!finalizado && !cancelledRef.current) {
        setCurrentPage(pagina);
        if (pagina > estimatedPages) {
          setEstimatedPages(pagina + 2);
        }

        const controller = new AbortController();
        abortControllerRef.current = controller;

        const response = await fetch(
          `/api/bling/sync?all=true&pagina=${encodeURIComponent(String(pagina))}`,
          {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
              'x-cron-secret': verifiedSecret,
            },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }
        );

        const data = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as SyncPageResponse;

        if (response.status === 401) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
          setVerifiedSecret('');
          throw new Error('Sessão expirada ou CRON_SECRET inválido. Faça login novamente.');
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(data.error || `Falha na página ${pagina} (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
        }

        const naPagina = Number(data.totalImportado ?? data.importadosNaPagina ?? 0);
        const docsNaPagina = Number(data.documentosGravados ?? naPagina);
        acumuladoProdutos += naPagina;
        acumuladoDocs += docsNaPagina;

        setTotalImported(acumuladoProdutos);
        setTotalDocsWritten(acumuladoDocs);

        if (data.finalizado) {
          finalizado = true;
          setIsFinished(true);
          setLastBatchInfo(
            acumuladoProdutos > 0
              ? `Sincronização concluída! ${acumuladoProdutos} itens processados em ${acumuladoDocs} produtos no Firestore.`
              : 'Nenhum produto ativo encontrado no Bling para sincronizar.'
          );
          break;
        }

        const ultima = Number(data.ultimaPagina || pagina);
        setLastBatchInfo(
          `Lote até página ${ultima} gravado via WriteBatch (${acumuladoProdutos} itens / ${acumuladoDocs} docs na coleção products).`
        );

        pagina = Number(data.proximaPagina || ultima + 1);
      }

      if (cancelledRef.current) {
        setLastBatchInfo(
          `Sincronização interrompida manualmente na página ${pagina}. ${acumuladoProdutos} produtos já foram gravados.`
        );
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError') {
        setLastBatchInfo(
          `Sincronização interrompida na página ${pagina}. ${acumuladoProdutos} produtos gravados até o momento.`
        );
      } else {
        const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        setSyncError(message);
      }
    } finally {
      abortControllerRef.current = null;
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const progressPercent = isFinished
    ? 100
    : currentPage === 0
      ? 0
      : Math.min(95, Math.round((currentPage / Math.max(estimatedPages, currentPage)) * 100));

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0E0E0E] text-[#F5F5F5] flex flex-col justify-between px-4 py-8 selection:bg-[#E50914] selection:text-white">
      {/* Top Bar */}
      <header className="max-w-2xl w-full mx-auto flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-5">
        <a
          href="/"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Voltar à Loja
        </a>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-neutral-500">
          <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-[#E50914]" />
          Admin · Bling ERP v3
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Card */}
      <main className="max-w-2xl w-full mx-auto my-auto py-10">
        <div className="bg-[#141414] border border-white/10 rounded-lg p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="mb-6">
            <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#E50914] font-semibold mb-2">
              Sincronização em Lote · Firestore
            </p>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
              Catálogo Bling ERP
            </h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-neutral-400 mt-2 leading-relaxed">
              Importa todos os produtos ativos do Bling v3 em lotes seguros via{' '}
              <code className="text-neutral-300">/api/bling/sync</code>, salvando estoque, preço,
              grades e imagens <code className="text-neutral-300">.link</code> em alta resolução com{' '}
              <code className="text-neutral-300">WriteBatch</code>.
            </p>
          </div>

          {!verifiedSecret ? (
            <form onSubmit={handleUnlock} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label
                  htmlFor="cron-secret-input"
                  className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-neutral-400 mb-2"
                >
                  Senha de Acesso (CRON_SECRET)
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <input
                    id="cron-secret-input"
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="current-password"
                    value={secretInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setSecretInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Digite o CRON_SECRET configurado no servidor"
                    className="w-full bg-[#0E0E0E] border border-white/15 rounded-md pl-10 pr-4 py-3 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-neutral-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914] transition-colors"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {authError && (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-red-950/40 border border-red-500/30 rounded-md p-3 text-xs text-red-300">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>{authError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isVerifying}
                className="w-full bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-60 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] py-3.5 rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isVerifying ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    Validando credencial...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Desbloquear Painel
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              {/* Progress Display */}
              {(isSyncing || isFinished || totalImported > 0) && (
                <div className="bg-[#0E0E0E] border border-white/10 rounded-md p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs">
                    <span className="font-medium text-white">
                      {isSyncing
                        ? `Importando página ${currentPage} de ~${estimatedPages}... ${totalImported} produtos sincronizados`
                        : isFinished
                          ? `Concluído — ${totalImported} produtos sincronizados`
                          : `Pausado na página ${currentPage} — ${totalImported} produtos sincronizados`}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-neutral-400 shrink-0">{progressPercent}%</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="w-full h-2.5 bg-neutral-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className={`h-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                        isFinished ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-[#E50914]'
                      }`}
                      style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-neutral-400 pt-1">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {isFinished ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                      ) : (
                        <PackageCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-400" />
                      )}
                      {lastBatchInfo}
                    </span>
                    {totalDocsWritten > 0 && (
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-neutral-500">
                        Docs Firestore: {totalDocsWritten}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {syncError && (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-red-950/40 border border-red-500/30 rounded-md p-3.5 text-xs text-red-300">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-red-200">Erro durante a sincronização</p>
                    <p>{syncError}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Actions */}
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleStartSync}
                  disabled={isSyncing}
                  className="flex-1 bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-[#c80812] disabled:opacity-60 text-white font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] py-3.5 px-5 rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {isSyncing ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                      Sincronizando Página {currentPage}...
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Sincronizar Catálogo do Bling
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>

                {isSyncing ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleStopSync}
                    className="sm:w-auto bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-200 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] py-3.5 px-5 rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <StopCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Parar
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleLock}
                    className="sm:w-auto bg-transparent border border-white/15 hover:border-white/30 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] py-3.5 px-5 rounded-md transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Bloquear
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </main>

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="max-w-2xl w-full mx-auto text-center text-[11px] text-neutral-600 border-t border-white/5 pt-4">
        Rota administrativa protegida por CRON_SECRET · Tokens OAuth 2.0 gerenciados automaticamente via Firestore
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { X, RefreshCw, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Image as ImageIcon, Sparkles, ExternalLink, Upload, Key, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { Product } from '../types';

interface BlingSyncModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  targetProduct?: Product | null;
  onCatalogRefresh: () => void;
}

const POPULAR_TARGETS = [
  { name: 'TENIS TESLA HERTZ ART PURPLE', sku: 'TTHA10139', label: '🟣 Tesla Hertz Art Purple' },
  { name: 'TENIS TESLA HERTZ BLACK', sku: 'TTHA10438', label: '⚫ Tesla Hertz Black' },
  { name: 'TENIS TESLA FLOW XL BLACK E WHITE', sku: 'TTFX10143', label: '⚪ Tesla Flow XL Black/White' },
  { name: 'CHINELO HAVAIANAS CITY BASIC ROSE GOLD', sku: 'CHCB10140', label: '🩴 Havaianas City Rose Gold' }
];

export function BlingSyncModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  targetProduct,
  onCatalogRefresh
}: BlingSyncModalProps) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{
    connected: boolean;
    clientId?: string;
    tokenInvalid?: boolean;
    error?: string;
    redirectUri?: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [tokenInput, setTokenInput] = useState('');
  const [isSavingToken, setIsSavingToken] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [syncResult, setSyncResult] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedRedirect, setCopiedRedirect] = useState(false);

  // Selected product to update image
  const [selectedTarget, setSelectedTarget] = useState<{ name: string; sku: string }>(() => {
    if (targetProduct) {
      return { name: targetProduct.name, sku: targetProduct.integration?.sku || '' };
    }
    return POPULAR_TARGETS[0];
  });

  const [imageUrlInput, setImageUrlInput] = useState('');
  const [isUpdatingImage, setIsUpdatingImage] = useState(false);
  const [imageUpdateSuccess, setImageUpdateSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [copiedWebhook, setCopiedWebhook] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const webhookUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    ? `${window.location.origin}/api/webhooks/bling`
    : 'https://ais-dev-oyrco7oz4nuj4kmovythxd-110121272862.us-east1.run.app/api/webhooks/bling';

  const callbackUrl = status?.redirectUri || (typeof window !== 'undefined'
    ? `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback`
    : 'https://ais-dev-oyrco7oz4nuj4kmovythxd-110121272862.us-east1.run.app/auth/callback');

  const loadBlingStatus = () => {
    fetch('/api/bling/status?verify=true')
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        setStatus(data);
        if (data.tokenInvalid && data.error) {
          setErrorMsg(data.error);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => setStatus({ connected: false }));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSyncResult(null);
    loadBlingStatus();

    if (targetProduct) {
      setSelectedTarget({
        name: targetProduct.name,
        sku: targetProduct.integration?.sku || ''
      });
    }
  }, [isOpen, targetProduct]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOAuthMessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      const origin = event.origin || '';
      if (!origin.endsWith('.run.app') && !origin.includes('localhost') && origin !== window.location.origin) {
        return;
      }
      if (event.data?.type === 'OAUTH_AUTH_SUCCESS' && event.data?.provider === 'bling') {
        setErrorMsg(null);
        setStatus((prev) => ({ ...prev, connected: true, tokenInvalid: false }));
        setSyncResult('Bling ERP conectado via OAuth! Puxando novos produtos e fotos...');
        handleSyncImages();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('message', handleOAuthMessage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleOAuthMessage);
  }, []);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleOAuthPopup = async () => {
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/bling/auth-url');
      const data = await res.json();
      const targetUrl = data.url || data.urlWithRedirect;
      if (!targetUrl) {
        throw new Error('URL de autorização do Bling indisponível.');
      }
      const popup = window.open(targetUrl, 'bling_oauth_popup', 'width=640,height=740');
      if (!popup) {
        setErrorMsg('Pop-up bloqueado pelo navegador. Permita pop-ups para este site e clique novamente.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Erro ao iniciar autorização OAuth do Bling.');
    }
  };

  const handleCopyRedirect = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(callbackUrl);
    setCopiedRedirect(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedRedirect(false), 2500);
  };

  const handleSyncImages = async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    setSyncResult(null);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const [imgRes, catRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/bling/sync-images?clearCache=true', { method: 'POST' }),
        fetch(`/api/catalog/products?refresh=true&_t=${Date.now()}`)
      ]);
      const imgData = await imgRes.json();
      const catData = await catRes.json();

      if (catData.blingConnected) {
        setStatus((prev) => ({ ...prev, connected: true, tokenInvalid: false }));
      }

      if (imgData.success && imgData.connected) {
        const pulledLabel = catData.blingCount ? `${catData.blingCount} produtos do Bling no catálogo` : 'catálogo atualizado';
        setSyncResult(`${pulledLabel}. ${imgData.message || ''}`.trim());
        onCatalogRefresh();
      } else if (catData.blingError || imgData.error || !imgData.connected) {
        setStatus((prev) => ({ ...prev, connected: false, tokenInvalid: true }));
        setErrorMsg(
          catData.blingError ||
          imgData.error ||
          'Bling ERP não conectado ou token expirado. Clique em "Autorizar Conexão no Bling ERP (1 Clique)" acima para puxar seus novos produtos.'
        );
      } else {
        setSyncResult(imgData.message || 'Catálogo sincronizado.');
        onCatalogRefresh();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Falha na requisição de sincronização.');
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveToken = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!tokenInput.trim()) return;
    setIsSavingToken(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/bling/token', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ access_token: tokenInput.trim() })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setStatus((prev) => ({ ...prev, connected: true, tokenInvalid: false }));
        setTokenInput('');
        setSyncResult('Bling ERP conectado! Puxando novos produtos e imagens...');
        handleSyncImages();
      } else {
        setStatus((prev) => ({ ...prev, connected: false, tokenInvalid: true }));
        setErrorMsg(data.error || 'Token inválido ou expirado.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Erro ao conectar ao Bling.');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingToken(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateProductImageByUrl = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!imageUrlInput.trim()) return;
    setIsUpdatingImage(true);
    setImageUpdateSuccess(false);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/products/update-image', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          sku: selectedTarget.sku,
          name: selectedTarget.name,
          imageUrl: imageUrlInput.trim()
        })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setImageUpdateSuccess(true);
        setImageUrlInput('');
        onCatalogRefresh();
      } else {
        setErrorMsg(data.error || 'Falha ao atualizar imagem.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Erro ao salvar nova imagem.');
    } finally {
      setIsUpdatingImage(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setIsUpdatingImage(true);
    setImageUpdateSuccess(false);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async () => {
      try {
        const fileData = reader.result as string;
        const res = await fetch('/api/products/upload-image', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            sku: selectedTarget.sku,
            name: selectedTarget.name,
            fileData,
            fileName: file.name
          })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          setImageUpdateSuccess(true);
          onCatalogRefresh();
        } else {
          setErrorMsg(data.error || 'Falha ao fazer upload da imagem.');
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Erro ao processar imagem.');
      } finally {
        setIsUpdatingImage(false);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleCopyWebhook = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(webhookUrl);
    setCopiedWebhook(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedWebhook(false), 2500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0F0F0F] border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 overflow-hidden max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-zinc-800/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-600/20 border border-red-600/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#E50914]">
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-black uppercase text-white font-oswald tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2">
                Sincronizar Bling ERP (Até 1.350 Produtos)
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Puxa até 1.350 produtos com fotos reais e oculta itens sem estoque automaticamente</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Fechar"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Connection warning notice */}
        {!status?.connected && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-800/50 text-amber-200 text-xs leading-relaxed space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-amber-400" />
              <span>Conexão Bling ERP necessária para puxar novos produtos</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-300 leading-normal">
              {status?.tokenInvalid
                ? 'O token anterior do Bling expirou ou é inválido. Clique em "Autorizar Conexão no Bling ERP (1 Clique)" abaixo para gerar um novo token OAuth e puxar todos os novos produtos.'
                : 'Autorize sua conta Bling API v3 abaixo para importar automaticamente até 1.350 produtos novos, estoque real (ocultando itens sem estoque) e fotos internas armazenadas no Bling.'}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* SECTION 1: CONNECT BLING API & PULL ALL PRODUCTS */}
        <div className="mt-5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 space-y-3">

          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleSaveToken} className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex gap-2">
