                value={tokenInput}
                onChange={(e) => setTokenInput(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-yellow-400 font-mono"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSavingToken || !tokenInput.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-500 hover:bg-yellow-400 disabled:opacity-50 text-black font-black uppercase text-xs rounded-xl transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isSavingToken ? 'Validando...' : 'Conectar'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Sync Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSyncImages}
            disabled={isSyncing}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer border border-zinc-700"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSyncing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{isSyncing ? 'Puxando até 1.350 Produtos e Fotos...' : 'Puxar Até 1.350 Produtos e Fotos do Bling Agora'}</span>
          </button>

          {syncResult && (
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-800/60 text-emerald-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>{syncResult}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-red-950/40 border border-red-800/60 text-red-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-400" />
              <span>{errorMsg}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* SECTION 2: INSTANT PRODUCT IMAGE UPDATE */}
        <div className="mt-5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-800 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-oswald">
              <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#E50914]" />
              <span>2. Atualizar Foto Manual no Catálogo</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">Reflete na vitrine na hora</span>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Target Chips */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-medium">Selecione a peça:</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {POPULAR_TARGETS.map((t) => {
                const isSelected = selectedTarget.name === t.name;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={t.sku}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedTarget({ name: t.name, sku: t.sku });
                      setImageUpdateSuccess(false);
                    }}
                    className={`text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all border cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected

                        : 'bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-300 border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>{t.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] opacity-70 font-mono font-normal">SKU: {t.sku}</div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2">
            <input
              type="file"
              ref={fileInputRef}
              accept="image/*"
              onChange={handleFileUpload}
              className="hidden"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isUpdatingImage}
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              className="w-full py-2.5 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500"
            >
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>{isUpdatingImage ? 'Enviando Imagem...' : `Escolher Arquivo do Computador p/ ${selectedTarget.name.split(' ')[2] || 'Produto'}`}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* OR Paste URL */}
          <div className="pt-1">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 text-center mb-1.5 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">OU COLE A URL DA IMAGEM:</div>
            <form onSubmit={handleUpdateProductImageByUrl} className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="url"
                placeholder="Cole o link da foto (https://...)"
                value={imageUrlInput}
                onChange={(e) => setImageUrlInput(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914]"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isUpdatingImage || !imageUrlInput.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-red-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Aplicar
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {imageUpdateSuccess && (
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-800/60 text-emerald-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Foto atualizada com sucesso! A vitrine da loja já está exibindo a nova imagem.</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* SECTION 3: AUTOMATIC WEBHOOK SETUP */}
        <div className="mt-5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-800/80 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-300 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-oswald">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>3. Webhook Automático no Bling (Atualização Instantânea)</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
            Para que cada foto trocada no Bling seja enviada automaticamente para o site sem você precisar clicar em nada:
          </p>
          <div className="p-2.5 bg-zinc-950 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-300">
            <span className="truncate">{webhookUrl}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCopyWebhook}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copiedWebhook ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              <span>{copiedWebhook ? 'Copiado!' : 'Copiar URL'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
            Cadastre no Bling em <em>Configurações &gt; Integrações &gt; Webhooks &gt; Adicionar Webhook</em> selecionando o evento <strong>Produtos (Alteração)</strong>.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface CartDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  items: CartItem[];

// Formatters and Brand Detector
function formatCardNumber(value: string): string {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 16);
  return digits.replace(/(\d{4})(?=\d)/g, '$1 ').trim();
}

function formatExpiration(value: string): string {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 4);
  if (digits.length >= 3) {
    return `${digits.slice(0, 2)}/${digits.slice(2, 4)}`;
  }
  return digits;
}

function formatCpf(value: string): string {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
  if (digits.length > 9) {
    return `${digits.slice(0, 3)}.${digits.slice(3, 6)}.${digits.slice(6, 9)}-${digits.slice(9)}`;
  }
  if (digits.length > 6) {
    return `${digits.slice(0, 3)}.${digits.slice(3, 6)}.${digits.slice(6)}`;
  }
  if (digits.length > 3) {
    return `${digits.slice(0, 3)}.${digits.slice(3)}`;
  }
  return digits;
}

function formatPhone(value: string): string {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
  if (digits.length > 10) {
    return `(${digits.slice(0, 2)}) ${digits.slice(2, 7)}-${digits.slice(7)}`;
  }
  if (digits.length > 6) {
    return `(${digits.slice(0, 2)}) ${digits.slice(2, 6)}-${digits.slice(6)}`;
  }
  if (digits.length > 2) {
    return `(${digits.slice(0, 2)}) ${digits.slice(2)}`;
  }
  return digits;
}

function detectCardBrand(cardNumber: string): 'visa' | 'master' | 'elo' | 'amex' | 'hipercard' | 'unknown' {
  const clean = cardNumber.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (/^4/.test(clean)) return 'visa';
  if (/^(5[1-5]|2[2-7])/.test(clean)) return 'master';
  if (/^(4011|4389|4514|4576|5041|5066|5090|6277|6362|6363|650|651|655)/.test(clean)) return 'elo';
  if (/^(34|37)/.test(clean)) return 'amex';
  if (/^(606282|3841)/.test(clean)) return 'hipercard';
  return 'unknown';
}

function formatCep(value: string): string {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  if (digits.length > 5) {
    return `${digits.slice(0, 5)}-${digits.slice(5)}`;
  }
  return digits;
}

export function CartDrawer({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  items,
  onUpdateQuantity,
  onRemoveItem,
  onClearCart,
  initialStep = 'cart',
  onOpenTracking,
  currentUser = null,
  onRequireAuth
}: CartDrawerProps) {
  // Step state: 'cart' (Review items) or 'checkout' (Transparent Payment)
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'cart' | 'checkout'>(initialStep);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setStep(initialStep);
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialStep]);

  // Coupon state
  const [couponCode, setCouponCode] = useState('');
  const [appliedDiscount, setAppliedDiscount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [couponMessage, setCouponMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  // Payment Method: 'card' (Transparent Card) or 'pix' (Transparent Pix)
  const [activePaymentMethod, setActivePaymentMethod] = useState<'card' | 'pix'>('card');
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pixPendingNotice, setPixPendingNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Customer contact info (persisted in localStorage for convenience)
  const [customerName, setCustomerName] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('street_customer_name') || '';
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  });
  const [customerEmail, setCustomerEmail] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('street_customer_email') || '';
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  });
  const [customerCpf, setCustomerCpf] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('street_customer_cpf') || '';
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  });
  const [customerPhone, setCustomerPhone] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('street_customer_phone') || '';
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  });

  // Auto-fill checkout fields from logged-in customer profile
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentUser) {
      if (currentUser.name) setCustomerName(currentUser.name);
      if (currentUser.email) setCustomerEmail(currentUser.email);
      if (currentUser.phone) setCustomerPhone(currentUser.phone);
    }
  }, [currentUser]);

  // Credit Card Form Fields (Checkout Transparente)
  const [cardNumber, setCardNumber] = useState('');
  const [cardholderName, setCardholderName] = useState('');
  const [cardExpiration, setCardExpiration] = useState('');
  const [cardCvv, setCardCvv] = useState('');
  const [installments, setInstallments] = useState<number>(1);

  // Pix state (Checkout Transparente)
  const [pixData, setPixData] = useState<MercadoPagoPixResponse | null>(null);
  const [pixCopied, setPixCopied] = useState(false);
  const [paymentApproved, setPaymentApproved] = useState(false);
  const [approvedPaymentDetails, setApprovedPaymentDetails] = useState<{
    id?: string | number;
    amount?: number;
    method?: string;
    orderNumber?: string;
    customerEmail?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const pollIntervalRef = useRef<any>(null);

  // Shipping & Melhor Envio state
  const [shippingCep, setShippingCep] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('street_shipping_cep') || '';
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  });
  const [shippingLoading, setShippingLoading] = useState(false);
  const [shippingError, setShippingError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [shippingOptions, setShippingOptions] = useState<ShippingOption[]>([]);
  const [shippingLive, setShippingLive] = useState(false);
  const [isPickup, setIsPickup] = useState(false);
  const [selectedShippingOption, setSelectedShippingOption] = useState<ShippingOption | null>(null);

  const [shippingAddress, setShippingAddress] = useState<{
    street: string;
    number: string;
    complement: string;
    neighborhood: string;
    city: string;
    state: string;
  }>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('street_shipping_address');
      if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    return {
      street: '',
      number: '',
      complement: '',
      neighborhood: '',
      city: '',
      state: ''
    };
  });

  // Mercado Pago SDK from @mercadopago/sdk-js initialized with .env key
  const MP_PUBLIC_KEY = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_MERCADO_PAGO_PUBLIC_KEY || 'APP_USR-20a95c8d-1249-4b33-b19f-39e50c1a8407';
  const [mpInstance, setMpInstance] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isMpLoaded, setIsMpLoaded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function initSdk() {
      try {
        await loadMercadoPago();
        if ((window as any).MercadoPago && active) {
          const mp = new (window as any).MercadoPago(MP_PUBLIC_KEY, {
            locale: 'pt-BR',
            advancedFraudPrevention: false,
          });
          setMpInstance(mp);
          setIsMpLoaded(true);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Safe warning
      }
    }
    initSdk();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [MP_PUBLIC_KEY]);

  // Calculations
  const subtotal = items.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.product.price * item.quantity, 0);
  const freeShippingThreshold = 299.0;
  const missingForFreeShipping = Math.max(0, freeShippingThreshold - subtotal);
  const freeShippingProgress = Math.min(100, (subtotal / freeShippingThreshold) * 100);

  // Cheapest option qualifies for Free Shipping above R$ 299
  const cheapestOptionId = shippingOptions.length > 0
    ? shippingOptions.reduce((min, opt) => (opt.price < min.price ? opt : min), shippingOptions[0]).id
    : null;

  const getOptionEffectivePrice = (opt: ShippingOption): number => {
    if (subtotal >= freeShippingThreshold && opt.id === cheapestOptionId) {
      return 0;
    }
    return opt.price;
  };

  // 5% discount when paying with Pix
  const pixSpecialDiscountPercent = activePaymentMethod === 'pix' ? 5 : 0;
  const totalDiscountPercent = appliedDiscount + pixSpecialDiscountPercent;
  const discountValue = (subtotal * totalDiscountPercent) / 100;
  const shippingFee =
    subtotal === 0 || isPickup
      ? 0
      : selectedShippingOption
        ? getOptionEffectivePrice(selectedShippingOption)
        : subtotal >= freeShippingThreshold
          ? 0
          : 18.90;
  const total = Math.max(0.01, subtotal - discountValue + shippingFee);

  const handleCalculateShipping = async (cepOverride?: string) => {
    const cleanCep = (cepOverride ?? shippingCep).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 8);
    if (cleanCep.length !== 8) {
      setShippingError('Informe um CEP válido com 8 dígitos.');
      return;
    }

    setShippingLoading(true);
    setShippingError(null);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('street_shipping_cep', formatCep(cleanCep));
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }

    try {
      const [quoteRes, viaCepRes] = await Promise.all([
        calculateShippingQuotes({
          cep: cleanCep,
          cartTotal: subtotal,
          items: items.map((it) => ({
            id: it.product.id,
            price: it.product.price,
            quantity: it.quantity,
            weight: 0.4
          }))
        }),
        fetch(`https://viacep.com.br/ws/${cleanCep}/json/`).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null)
      ]);

      if (viaCepRes && !viaCepRes.erro) {
        setShippingAddress((prev) => {
          const next = {
            ...prev,
            street: viaCepRes.logradouro || prev.street,
            neighborhood: viaCepRes.bairro || prev.neighborhood,
            city: viaCepRes.localidade || prev.city,
            state: viaCepRes.uf || prev.state
          };
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('street_shipping_address', JSON.stringify(next));
          } catch {
            // ignore
          }
          return next;
        });
      }

      if (quoteRes.success && quoteRes.options && quoteRes.options.length > 0) {
        setShippingOptions(quoteRes.options);
        setShippingLive(Boolean(quoteRes.live));
        setIsPickup(false);
        const existingMatch = selectedShippingOption
          ? quoteRes.options.find((o) => o.id === selectedShippingOption.id)
          : null;
        setSelectedShippingOption(existingMatch || quoteRes.options[0]);
      } else {
        setShippingError(quoteRes.error || 'Não foi possível calcular o frete para este CEP.');
      }
    } catch {
      setShippingError('Erro ao consultar frete no Melhor Envio.');
    } finally {
      setShippingLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Re-calculate automatically when drawer opens with saved 8-digit CEP
  useEffect(() => {
    const clean = shippingCep.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (isOpen && items.length > 0 && clean.length === 8 && shippingOptions.length === 0) {
      handleCalculateShipping(clean);
    }
  }, [isOpen, items.length]);

  // Save customer info & shipping address
  const saveCustomerInfo = () => {
    try {
      if (customerName) localStorage.setItem('street_customer_name', customerName);
      if (customerEmail) localStorage.setItem('street_customer_email', customerEmail);
      if (customerCpf) localStorage.setItem('street_customer_cpf', customerCpf);
      if (customerPhone) localStorage.setItem('street_customer_phone', customerPhone);
      if (shippingCep) localStorage.setItem('street_shipping_cep', shippingCep);
      localStorage.setItem('street_shipping_address', JSON.stringify(shippingAddress));
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  // Poll Pix payment status in background (strict real bank accreditation)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pixData?.paymentId && !paymentApproved) {
      pollIntervalRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          const res = await getPaymentStatus(pixData.paymentId!);
          if (res.approved === true && res.status === 'approved') {
            clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
            setPaymentApproved(true);
            setApprovedPaymentDetails({
              id: res.orderNumber || pixData.paymentId,
              amount: total,
              method: 'Pix Instantâneo (Aprovado)',
              orderNumber: res.orderNumber,
              customerEmail: customerEmail
            });
            confetti({
              particleCount: 120,
              spread: 110,
              origin: { y: 0.6 },
              colors: ['#009EE3', '#E50914', '#00FF66', '#FFFFFF']
            });
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Error polling pix status:', e);
        }
      }, 3500);

      return () => {
        if (pollIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(pollIntervalRef.current);
      };
    }
  }, [pixData, paymentApproved, total, customerEmail]);

  const handleApplyCoupon = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const code = couponCode.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (code === 'STREETVIP') {
      setAppliedDiscount(15);
      setCouponMessage('Cupom VIP aplicado! 15% de desconto!');
    } else if (code === 'PRIMEIRACOMPRA') {
      setAppliedDiscount(10);
      setCouponMessage('Cupom de primeira compra aplicado! 10% de desconto!');
    } else {
      setCouponMessage('Cupom inválido. Tente STREETVIP ou PRIMEIRACOMPRA.');
    }
  };

  // Process Transparent Credit Card Payment (directly in website with @mercadopago/sdk-js)
  const handleProcessCardPayment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    if (!currentUser) {
      setErrorMessage('Faça login ou cadastre-se para finalizar sua compra.');
      onRequireAuth?.();
      return;
    }

    // Validations
    const cleanNum = cardNumber.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (cleanNum.length < 13) {
      setErrorMessage('Informe o número completo do seu cartão de crédito.');
      return;
    }
    if (!cardholderName.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Informe o nome do titular como está impresso no cartão.');
      return;
    }
    const expParts = cardExpiration.split('/');
    if (expParts.length !== 2 || expParts[0].length !== 2 || expParts[1].length !== 2) {
      setErrorMessage('Informe a validade do cartão no formato MM/AA.');
      return;
    }
    if (cardCvv.length < 3) {
      setErrorMessage('Informe o código de segurança (CVV) do cartão.');
      return;
    }
    const cleanCpf = customerCpf.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (cleanCpf.length < 11) {
      setErrorMessage('Informe um CPF válido para identificação do pagamento.');
      return;
    }
    if (!customerEmail.includes('@')) {
      setErrorMessage('Informe um e-mail válido para envio do comprovante.');
      return;
    }

    const cleanCep = shippingCep.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!isPickup) {
      if (cleanCep.length !== 8 || !shippingAddress.street.trim() || !shippingAddress.number.trim() || !shippingAddress.city.trim() || !shippingAddress.state.trim()) {
        setErrorMessage('Preencha o CEP e endereço completo para entrega via Melhor Envio (ou selecione Retirada na Loja).');
        return;
      }
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    saveCustomerInfo();

    try {
      const brand = detectCardBrand(cardNumber);
      let cardTokenId: string | undefined = undefined;

      // 1. Tokenize natively using SDK in-browser
      if (mpInstance && typeof mpInstance.createCardToken === 'function') {
        try {
          const expYearFull = expParts[1].length === 2 ? `20${expParts[1]}` : expParts[1];
          const tokenRes = await mpInstance.createCardToken({
            cardNumber: cleanNum,
            cardholderName: cardholderName.trim().toUpperCase(),
            cardExpirationMonth: expParts[0],
            cardExpirationYear: expYearFull,
            securityCode: cardCvv,
            identificationType: 'CPF',
            identificationNumber: cleanCpf
          });
          if (tokenRes && tokenRes.id) {
            cardTokenId = tokenRes.id;
            console.log('[SDK] Card token created successfully:', tokenRes.id);
          }
        } catch (sdkTokenErr) {
          console.warn('[SDK] Notice during client tokenization:', sdkTokenErr);
        }
      }

      // 2. Process transparent payment on backend with store sync + Melhor Envio
      const resolvedCarrier = isPickup
        ? 'Retirada na Loja Física (Itabira - MG)'
        : selectedShippingOption
          ? `${selectedShippingOption.company.name} ${selectedShippingOption.name}`
          : 'Melhor Envio';

      const res = await processTransparentCardPayment({
        token: cardTokenId,
        cardData: !cardTokenId ? {
          cardNumber: cleanNum,
          cardholderName: cardholderName.toUpperCase().trim(),
          expirationMonth: expParts[0],
          expirationYear: expParts[1],
          securityCode: cardCvv,
          cpf: cleanCpf
        } : undefined,
        transactionAmount: total,
        installments,
        paymentMethodId: brand !== 'unknown' ? brand : 'visa',
        description: `Street Store (${items.length} peças) - Pedido Oficial`,
        payer: {
          name: customerName || cardholderName,
          email: customerEmail,
          cpf: cleanCpf,
          phone: customerPhone
        },
        items: items.map((it) => ({
          id: it.product.id,
          name: `${it.product.name} (${it.selectedSize})`,
          price: it.product.price,
          quantity: it.quantity,
          selectedSize: it.selectedSize,
          variantId: it.product.variantsList?.[0]?.id
        })),
        shippingAddress: !isPickup ? {
          street: shippingAddress.street.trim(),
          number: shippingAddress.number.trim(),
          complement: shippingAddress.complement.trim(),
          neighborhood: shippingAddress.neighborhood.trim(),
          city: shippingAddress.city.trim(),
          state: shippingAddress.state.trim().toUpperCase(),
          zip: cleanCep
        } : undefined,
        shippingServiceId: !isPickup ? selectedShippingOption?.id : undefined,
        shippingCarrier: resolvedCarrier
      });

      if (res.success && (res.status === 'approved' || res.statusDetail === 'accredited')) {
        setPaymentApproved(true);
        setApprovedPaymentDetails({
          id: res.orderNumber || res.paymentId,
          amount: total,
          method: `Cartão de Crédito ${installments}x sem juros`,
          orderNumber: res.orderNumber,
          customerEmail: customerEmail
        });
        confetti({
          particleCount: 130,
          spread: 110,
          origin: { y: 0.6 },
          colors: ['#009EE3', '#E50914', '#00FF66', '#FFFFFF']
        });
      } else if (res.status === 'in_process' || res.status === 'pending') {
        setPaymentApproved(true);
        setApprovedPaymentDetails({
          id: res.paymentId,
          amount: total,
          method: 'Cartão em Análise de Segurança',
          customerEmail: customerEmail
        });
      } else {
        // Human-friendly error translation
        let msg = res.error || 'Não foi possível processar o cartão no momento.';
        if (res.statusDetail === 'cc_rejected_bad_filled_security_code') {
          msg = 'Código de segurança (CVV) inválido. Verifique os 3 dígitos no verso.';
        } else if (res.statusDetail === 'cc_rejected_bad_filled_date') {
          msg = 'Data de validade incorreta ou cartão vencido.';
        } else if (res.statusDetail === 'cc_rejected_insufficient_amount') {
          msg = 'Limite insuficiente no cartão para esta compra.';
        } else if (res.statusDetail === 'cc_rejected_call_for_authorize') {
          msg = 'Ligue para a operadora do seu cartão para autorizar a transação.';
        } else if (res.statusDetail === 'cc_rejected_high_risk') {
          msg = 'Transação recusada pelo sistema antifraude do emissor. Experimente pagar via Pix com 5% de desconto imediato!';
        }
        setErrorMessage(msg);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Erro de conexão com o gateway de pagamento.');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // Generate Transparent Pix directly in drawer (100% in-app, ZERO redirects)
  const handleGeneratePix = async () => {
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setPixPendingNotice(null);

    if (!currentUser) {
      setErrorMessage('Faça login ou cadastre-se para finalizar sua compra.');
      onRequireAuth?.();
      return;
    }

    const cleanCpf = customerCpf.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!customerEmail.includes('@')) {
      setErrorMessage('Informe seu e-mail para emissão do Pix e envio do comprovante.');
      return;
    }

    const cleanCep = shippingCep.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!isPickup) {
      if (cleanCep.length !== 8 || !shippingAddress.street.trim() || !shippingAddress.number.trim() || !shippingAddress.city.trim() || !shippingAddress.state.trim()) {
        setErrorMessage('Preencha o CEP e endereço completo para entrega via Melhor Envio (ou selecione Retirada na Loja).');
        return;
      }
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    saveCustomerInfo();

    try {
      const resolvedCarrier = isPickup
        ? 'Retirada na Loja Física (Itabira - MG)'
        : selectedShippingOption
          ? `${selectedShippingOption.company.name} ${selectedShippingOption.name}`
          : 'Melhor Envio';

      const res = await createDirectPix({
        amount: total,
        description: `Street Store (${items.length} itens)`,
        payer: {
          name: customerName || 'Cliente Street Store',
          email: customerEmail,
          cpf: cleanCpf.length === 11 ? cleanCpf : undefined,
          phone: customerPhone
        },
        items: items.map((it) => ({
          id: it.product.id,
          name: `${it.product.name} (${it.selectedSize})`,
          price: it.product.price,
          quantity: it.quantity,
          selectedSize: it.selectedSize,
          variantId: it.product.variantsList?.[0]?.id
        })),
        shippingAddress: !isPickup ? {
          street: shippingAddress.street.trim(),
          number: shippingAddress.number.trim(),
          complement: shippingAddress.complement.trim(),
          neighborhood: shippingAddress.neighborhood.trim(),
          city: shippingAddress.city.trim(),
          state: shippingAddress.state.trim().toUpperCase(),
          zip: cleanCep
        } : undefined,
        shippingServiceId: !isPickup ? selectedShippingOption?.id : undefined,
        shippingCarrier: resolvedCarrier
      });

      if (res.success && res.qrCode) {
        setPixData(res);
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Erro ao gerar Pix. Você também pode pagar no cartão até 6x sem juros!');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Erro ao gerar Pix');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // Strict Real In-App Pix verification (NEVER confirms without real bank accreditation)
  const handleConfirmPixPayment = async () => {
    if (!pixData?.paymentId) return;
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setPixPendingNotice(null);

    try {
      const res = await confirmPixPayment(pixData.paymentId);
      if (res.approved === true && res.status === 'approved') {
        setPaymentApproved(true);
        setApprovedPaymentDetails({
          id: res.orderNumber || pixData.paymentId,
          amount: total,
          method: 'Pix Instantâneo (Aprovado)',
          orderNumber: res.orderNumber,
          customerEmail: customerEmail
        });
        confetti({
          particleCount: 130,
          spread: 110,
          origin: { y: 0.6 },
          colors: ['#009EE3', '#E50914', '#00FF66', '#FFFFFF']
        });
      } else {
        // Did not confirm in bank yet! Inform user clearly and DO NOT approve!
        setPixPendingNotice(
          res.message ||
            'Aguardando compensação do banco: O pagamento ainda não foi identificado. Faça a transferência via Pix no app do seu banco e clique em verificar novamente.'
        );
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setPixPendingNotice('Erro ao consultar compensação do Pix. Tente novamente em instantes.');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // Copy Pix Copia e Cola
  const handleCopyPix = () => {
    if (pixData?.qrCode) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(pixData.qrCode);
      setPixCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setPixCopied(false), 2500);
    }
  };

  const handleWhatsAppHelp = () => {
    const lines = items.map(
      (item) => `• ${item.quantity}x ${item.product.name} (Tam: ${item.selectedSize}) - R$ ${(item.product.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`
    );
    const message = `Salve equipe Street Store! Estou finalizando meu pedido no site:\n\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\n*Total:* R$ ${total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}\n\nPoderiam me tirar uma dúvida rápida?`;
    window.open(`https://wa.me/5531984806556?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, '_blank');
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const cardBrand = detectCardBrand(cardNumber);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 max-w-full flex pl-0 sm:pl-8">
        
        <motion.div
          initial={{ x: '100%' }}
          animate={{ x: 0 }}
          exit={{ x: '100%' }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }}
          className="w-screen max-w-full sm:max-w-md bg-[#0F0F0F] border-l border-zinc-800 flex flex-col shadow-2xl h-full"
        >
          {/* Top Header */}
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-zinc-800/80 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-950/80 shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {step === 'checkout' && !paymentApproved && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setStep('cart')}
                  className="p-1 -ml-1 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer mr-1"
                  title="Voltar para a Sacola"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              )}

              <ShoppingBag className="w-5 h-5 text-[#E50914]" />
              <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-oswald">
                {step === 'cart' ? 'SEU CARRINHO' : 'CHECKOUT TRANSPARENTE'}
              </h2>
              
              <span className="bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full tabular-nums">
                {items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Fechar carrinho"
              className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Free Shipping Meter (Visible on step === 'cart') */}
          {step === 'cart' && (
            <div className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-zinc-900/60 border-b border-zinc-800/80 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1.5">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-300 font-semibold">
                  <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#E50914]" />
                  {missingForFreeShipping === 0 ? (
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">Você ganhou FRETE GRÁTIS! 🚀</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span>
                      Faltam <strong className="text-white">R$ {missingForFreeShipping.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</strong> para Frete Grátis
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold">
                  {Math.round(freeShippingProgress)}%
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="w-full bg-zinc-800 rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 via-amber-500 to-emerald-500 h-full transition-all duration-300 rounded-full"
                  style={{ width: `${freeShippingProgress}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* MAIN DRAWER CONTENT */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4">
            
            {/* 1. SUCCESS CONFIRMATION RECEIPT */}
            {paymentApproved ? (
              <div className="py-8 text-center space-y-4">
                <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/40 animate-bounce">
                  <Check className="w-8 h-8" />
                </div>
                
                <div>
                  <span className="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs font-bold mb-2">
                    PAGAMENTO CONFIRMADO COM SUCESSO
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-white uppercase font-oswald tracking-wide">
                    Pedido {approvedPaymentDetails?.orderNumber || `#${approvedPaymentDetails?.id || 'CONFIRMADO'}`} Aprovado!
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 mt-1.5 max-w-sm mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                    Agradecemos pela preferência! O comprovante e detalhes da compra foram enviados para o e-mail:{' '}
                    <strong className="text-white underline">{customerEmail || approvedPaymentDetails?.customerEmail || 'seu e-mail'}</strong>.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl text-left space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    <span>Status do Pedido:</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Pago com Sucesso
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    <span>Valor Total:</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-bold font-oswald text-sm">
                      R$ {total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    <span>Forma de Pagamento:</span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-200 font-semibold">{approvedPaymentDetails?.method || 'Pagamento Seguro'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    <span>Envio & Expedição:</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Envio Expresso (Preparando Pacote)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    <span>Código de Rastreio:</span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-300 font-medium">Será enviado por e-mail assim que postado</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      const orderNum = approvedPaymentDetails?.orderNumber || String(approvedPaymentDetails?.id || '');
                      setPaymentApproved(false);
                      setPixData(null);
                      setApprovedPaymentDetails(null);
                      setStep('cart');
                      onClearCart();
                      onClose();
                      if (onOpenTracking) {
                        onOpenTracking(orderNum);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-full px-6 py-3.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black text-xs rounded-xl uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/60 cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <Truck className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>ACOMPANHAR MEU PEDIDO AGORA</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setPaymentApproved(false);
                      setPixData(null);
                      setApprovedPaymentDetails(null);
                      setStep('cart');
                      onClearCart();
                      onClose();
                    }}
                    className="w-full px-6 py-3 bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95"
                  >
                    Continuar Comprando
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

            // 2. PIX DISPLAY STATE (Dentro do site)
            ) : pixData ? (
              <div className="space-y-4 py-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-800">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <QrCode className="w-5 h-5 text-[#009EE3]" />
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Pix Instantâneo (5% OFF)</span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setPixData(null);
                      setPixPendingNotice(null);
                    }}
                    className="text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Trocar Forma
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-3">
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-[11px] font-bold">
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Pagamento Seguro no Site · Sem Redirecionamento</span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300">
                    Abra o app do seu banco, escolha <strong>Pagar com Pix</strong> e escaneie o QR Code abaixo:
                  </p>

                  {/* QR Code Image */}
                  <div className="w-52 h-52 bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl border-2 border-zinc-700">
                    {pixData.qrCodeBase64 ? (
                      <img
                        src={`data:image/png;base64,${pixData.qrCodeBase64}`}
                        alt="QR Code Pix Oficial"
                        className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <QrCode className="w-44 h-44 text-black" />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Amount Badge */}
                  <div className="text-xl font-black text-white font-oswald">
                    R$ {total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-emerald-400 ml-2 font-normal font-sans">
                      (5% OFF Pix aplicado)
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Copy Pix Copia e Cola */}
                  <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
                    <div className="p-2.5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg text-left">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wider block font-bold mb-1">
                        Código Pix Copia e Cola:
                      </span>
                      <p className="font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-300 break-all select-all line-clamp-2">
                        {pixData.qrCode}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleCopyPix}
                      className="w-full py-3 bg-[#009EE3] hover:bg-[#0089c7] text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-sky-950/50 active:scale-95"
                    >
                      <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>{pixCopied ? 'Código Copiado com Sucesso!' : 'Copiar Código Pix'}</span>
                    </button>

                    {/* Pending bank notice if clicked without paying */}
                    {pixPendingNotice && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs text-amber-200 text-left flex items-start gap-2 animate-pulse">
                        <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <div>
                          <strong className="block font-bold text-amber-300">Pagamento não identificado ainda:</strong>
                          <span>{pixPendingNotice}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Manual In-App Confirmation Button */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleConfirmPixPayment}
                      disabled={isProcessing}
                      className="w-full py-3.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/60 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-70 mt-1"
                    >
                      {isProcessing ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                          <span>Consultando compensação no banco...</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>JÁ REALIZEI O PAGAMENTO PIX</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Live Status Polling Indicator */}
                  <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Aguardando confirmação bancária (reconhecimento automático)...</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            // 3. EMPTY CART
            ) : items.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="py-20 text-center space-y-3">
                <ShoppingBag className="w-12 h-12 text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
                <p className="text-base font-bold text-white">Seu carrinho está vazio.</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                  Adicione moletons, calças cargo, sneakers ou bonés para continuar.
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="mt-3 px-5 py-2 bg-[#E50914] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Explorar Catálogo
                </button>
              </div>

            // 4. STEP 1: REVIEW CART ITEMS
            ) : step === 'cart' ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {items.map((item) => (
                  <div
                    key={item.id}
                    className="flex gap-3 p-3 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800/80"
                  >
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                      <img
                        src={item.product.images[0]}
                        alt={item.product.name}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-1">
                        <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate">
                          {item.product.name}
                        </h4>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => onRemoveItem(item.id)}
                          className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-[#E50914] p-1 cursor-pointer"
                          aria-label="Remover item"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                        <span>Tam: <strong className="text-zinc-200">{item.selectedSize}</strong></span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span className="truncate">{item.selectedColor}</span>
                      </div>

                      {(item.product.stockCount ?? 0) <= 0 && (
                        <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-red-400 bg-red-950/60 border border-red-800/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                          Sem estoque no momento (Aguardando reposição)
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-md">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => onUpdateQuantity(item.id, -1)}
                            className="px-2 py-0.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                            aria-label="Diminuir"
                          >
                            <Minus className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                          <span className="px-2 text-xs font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                            {item.quantity}
                          </span>
                          <button
                            disabled={(item.product.stockCount ?? 0) <= 0}
                            onClick={() => onUpdateQuantity(item.id, 1)}
                            className="px-2 py-0.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                            aria-label="Aumentar"
                          >
                            <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                          R$ {(item.product.price * item.quantity).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}

                {/* Melhor Envio Live Shipping Calculator in Cart */}
                <div className="p-3.5 bg-zinc-900/70 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl space-y-2.5 mt-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white font-oswald flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#E50914]" />
                      Calcular Frete · Melhor Envio
                    </span>
                    {shippingOptions.length > 0 && (
                      <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${shippingLive ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}`}>
                        {shippingLive ? '● Cotação ao vivo' : '● Estimativa'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <div className="relative flex-1">
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        maxLength={9}
                        value={shippingCep}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const formatted = formatCep(e.target.value);
                          setShippingCep(formatted);
                          if (formatted.replace(/\D/g, '').length === 8) {
                            handleCalculateShipping(formatted);
                          }
                        }}
                        placeholder="Digite seu CEP (00000-000)"
                        className="w-full pl-8 pr-2 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914]"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleCalculateShipping()}
                      disabled={shippingLoading}
                      className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      {shippingLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <span>Calcular</span>}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {shippingError && (
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-red-400">{shippingError}</p>
                  )}

                  {/* Selectable Carrier Options */}
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    {shippingOptions.map((opt) => {
                      const effPrice = getOptionEffectivePrice(opt);
                      const isSelected = !isPickup && selectedShippingOption?.id === opt.id;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={opt.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setIsPickup(false);
                            setSelectedShippingOption(opt);
                          }}
                          className={`w-full p-2 rounded-lg border text-left flex items-center justify-between text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-zinc-950 border-[#E50914] text-white'
                              : 'bg-zinc-950/50 border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 hover:border-zinc-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <span className="font-bold block truncate">
                              {opt.company.name} · {opt.name}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                              Entrega em {opt.deliveryText}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <span className={`font-bold shrink-0 ml-2 ${effPrice === 0 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-white'}`}>
                            {effPrice === 0 ? 'Grátis' : `R$ ${effPrice.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsPickup(true)}
                      className={`w-full p-2 rounded-lg border text-left flex items-center justify-between text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        isPickup
                          ? 'bg-zinc-950 border-emerald-500 text-white'
                          : 'bg-zinc-950/50 border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 hover:border-zinc-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <span className="font-bold block truncate">Retirada na Loja Física · Itabira MG</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Av. João Pinheiro, 353 - Centro</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400 shrink-0 ml-2">Grátis</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            // 5. STEP 2: CHECKOUT LOGIN GATE OR TRANSPARENTE MERCADO PAGO FORM
            ) : !currentUser ? (
              <div className="py-12 px-4 text-center space-y-4">
                <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-[#E50914]/15 border border-[#E50914]/40 text-[#E50914] flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
                  <Lock className="w-7 h-7" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-black uppercase font-oswald text-white">
                    Login Obrigatório para Comprar
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 max-w-xs mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                    Para proteger seus pedidos e enviar o código de rastreio corretamente, faça login ou crie seu cadastro com nome, e-mail, telefone e senha.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onRequireAuth?.()}
                  className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-[#c90812] text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-red-950/60 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>FAZER LOGIN OU CADASTRO PARA COMPRAR</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setStep('cart')}
                  className="text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Voltar para o carrinho
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                
                {/* Order Summary Strip */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="text-xs">
                    <span className="text-zinc-400 block">
                      {items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.quantity, 0)} itens · {isPickup ? 'Retirada na Loja' : selectedShippingOption ? `${selectedShippingOption.company.name} ${selectedShippingOption.name}` : 'Frete Padrão'}
                    </span>
                    <strong className="text-white font-oswald text-base">Total: R$ {total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setStep('cart')}
                    className="text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Ver detalhes
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Delivery Address Section (Melhor Envio) */}
                <div className="p-3.5 bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white font-oswald flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#E50914]" />
                      Endereço de Entrega (Melhor Envio)
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsPickup(!isPickup)}
                      className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 underline cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {isPickup ? 'Receber via Melhor Envio' : 'Retirar na Loja (Grátis)'}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {isPickup ? (
                    <div className="p-2.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-emerald-800/50 rounded-lg text-[11px] text-zinc-300">
                      <strong className="text-emerald-400 block">Retirada na Loja Street Store</strong>
                      <span>Avenida João Pinheiro, 353 - Centro, Itabira - MG · CEP 35900-539</span>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          maxLength={9}
                          value={shippingCep}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const formatted = formatCep(e.target.value);
                            setShippingCep(formatted);
                            if (formatted.replace(/\D/g, '').length === 8) {
                              handleCalculateShipping(formatted);
                            }
                          }}
                          placeholder="CEP: 00000-000"
                          className="w-36 px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleCalculateShipping()}
                          disabled={shippingLoading}
                          className="px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          {shippingLoading ? 'Buscando...' : 'Buscar CEP'}
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {shippingOptions.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                          {shippingOptions.map((opt) => {
                            const effPrice = getOptionEffectivePrice(opt);
                            const active = selectedShippingOption?.id === opt.id;
                            return (
                              <button
                                key={opt.id}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setSelectedShippingOption(opt)}
                                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                                  active
                                    ? 'bg-[#E50914]/20 border-[#E50914] text-white'
                                    : 'bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {opt.company.name} {opt.name} · {effPrice === 0 ? 'Grátis' : `R$ ${effPrice.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`}
                              </button>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={shippingAddress.street}
                          onChange={(e) => setShippingAddress((p) => ({ ...p, street: e.target.value }))}
                          placeholder="Rua / Avenida"
                          className="col-span-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={shippingAddress.number}
                          onChange={(e) => setShippingAddress((p) => ({ ...p, number: e.target.value }))}
                          placeholder="Número"
                          className="px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={shippingAddress.complement}
                          onChange={(e) => setShippingAddress((p) => ({ ...p, complement: e.target.value }))}
                          placeholder="Complemento (opcional)"
                          className="px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={shippingAddress.neighborhood}
                          onChange={(e) => setShippingAddress((p) => ({ ...p, neighborhood: e.target.value }))}
                          placeholder="Bairro"
                          className="px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={shippingAddress.city}
                          onChange={(e) => setShippingAddress((p) => ({ ...p, city: e.target.value }))}
                          placeholder="Cidade"
                          className="col-span-3 px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          maxLength={2}
                          value={shippingAddress.state}
                          onChange={(e) => setShippingAddress((p) => ({ ...p, state: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
                          placeholder="UF"
                          className="px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 uppercase text-center focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Payment Method Selector Tabs */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 p-1 bg-zinc-900 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActivePaymentMethod('card');
                      setErrorMessage(null);
                    }}
                    className={`py-2 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      activePaymentMethod === 'card'
                        ? 'bg-[#009EE3] text-white shadow'
                        : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <CreditCard className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Cartão de Crédito</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActivePaymentMethod('pix');
                      setErrorMessage(null);
                    }}
                    className={`py-2 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      activePaymentMethod === 'pix'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow'
                        : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Pix (-5% OFF)</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* CREDIT CARD TRANSPARENT CHECKOUT */}
                {activePaymentMethod === 'card' && (
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    
                    {/* Visual Card Preview */}
                    <div className="relative h-44 rounded-2xl p-4 bg-gradient-to-br from-zinc-900 via-zinc-800 to-black border border-zinc-700/80 shadow-xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between text-white">
                      <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 -mr-8 -mt-8 w-32 h-32 rounded-full bg-red-600/10 blur-xl pointer-events-none" />
                      
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#E50914] font-oswald">
                          STREET STORE OFFICIAL
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-300">
                          {cardBrand !== 'unknown' ? cardBrand.toUpperCase() : 'CARTÃO'}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Chip & Contactless */}
                      <div className="w-9 h-7 rounded bg-amber-400/80 border border-amber-300/60 shadow-inner flex items-center justify-center">
                        <div className="w-6 h-4 border border-amber-600/50 rounded-sm" />
                      </div>

                      {/* Card Number */}
                      <div className="font-mono text-base tracking-widest font-semibold">
                        {cardNumber ? cardNumber : '•••• •••• •••• ••••'}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-end justify-between text-xs">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 block uppercase">Titular</span>
                          <span className="font-bold tracking-wider truncate max-w-[180px] block">
                            {cardholderName ? cardholderName : 'SEU NOME AQUI'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 block uppercase">Validade</span>
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold">
                            {cardExpiration ? cardExpiration : 'MM/AA'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Inputs */}
                    <form onSubmit={handleProcessCardPayment} className="space-y-2.5">
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                          Número do Cartão de Crédito
                        </label>
                        <div className="relative">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            maxLength={19}
                            value={cardNumber}
                            onChange={(e) => setCardNumber(formatCardNumber(e.target.value))}
                            placeholder="0000 0000 0000 0000"
                            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                          />
                          <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                          Nome Impresso no Cartão
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={cardholderName}
                          onChange={(e) => setCardholderName(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                          placeholder="EX: JOÃO DA SILVA"
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 uppercase focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                            Validade (MM/AA)
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            maxLength={5}
                            value={cardExpiration}
                            onChange={(e) => setCardExpiration(formatExpiration(e.target.value))}
                            placeholder="12/28"
                            className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono text-center focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                          />
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                            CVV (Segurança)
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="password"
                            maxLength={4}
                            value={cardCvv}
                            onChange={(e) => setCardCvv(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))}
                            placeholder="123"
                            className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono text-center focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                          Número de Parcelas
                        </label>
                        <select
                          value={installments}
                          onChange={(e) => setInstallments(Number(e.target.value))}
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3] cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <option value={1}>1x de R$ {total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} à vista (Sem juros)</option>
                          <option value={2}>2x de R$ {(total / 2).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} sem juros</option>
                          <option value={3}>3x de R$ {(total / 3).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} sem juros</option>
                          <option value={4}>4x de R$ {(total / 4).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} sem juros</option>
                          <option value={5}>5x de R$ {(total / 5).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} sem juros</option>
                          <option value={6}>6x de R$ {(total / 6).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} sem juros</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      {/* Customer Info */}
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800 space-y-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                          Dados do Titular para Emissão do Comprovante
                        </span>

                        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                          <div>
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              maxLength={14}
                              value={customerCpf}
                              onChange={(e) => setCustomerCpf(formatCpf(e.target.value))}
                              placeholder="CPF: 000.000.000-00"
                              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                            />
                          </div>

                          <div>
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              maxLength={15}
                              value={customerPhone}
                              onChange={(e) => setCustomerPhone(formatPhone(e.target.value))}
                              placeholder="WhatsApp: (31) 98480-6556"
                              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <input
                            type="email"
                            value={customerEmail}
                            onChange={(e) => setCustomerEmail(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Seu melhor e-mail para confirmação"
                            className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#009EE3]"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Error Message */}
                      {errorMessage && (
                        <div className="p-3 bg-red-950/60 border border-red-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-200 flex items-start gap-2">
                          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-400 mt-0.5" />
                          <span>{errorMessage}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Action Button */}
                      <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={isProcessing}
                        className="w-full py-4 rounded-xl bg-[#009EE3] hover:bg-[#0089c7] text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-sky-950/60 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-70 mt-2"
                      >
                        {isProcessing ? (
                          <>
                            <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                            <span>Processando pagamento seguro...</span>
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
                            <span>FINALIZAR PAGAMENTO · R$ {total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</span>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </form>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* PIX TRANSPARENT CHECKOUT */}
                {activePaymentMethod === 'pix' && (
                  <div className="space-y-3">
