                    <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-800/60 rounded-xl space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs">
                        <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>5% de Desconto Imediato com Pix!</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-300">
                        O código QR Code oficial é gerado diretamente aqui na tela para você pagar e ter aprovação instantânea.
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                          Seu Nome Completo
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={customerName}
                          onChange={(e) => setCustomerName(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Ex: João da Silva"
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                          CPF do Titular da Compra
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          maxLength={14}
                          value={customerCpf}
                          onChange={(e) => setCustomerCpf(formatCpf(e.target.value))}
                          placeholder="000.000.000-00"
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 block mb-1">
                          E-mail para Envio do Comprovante
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="email"
                          value={customerEmail}
                          onChange={(e) => setCustomerEmail(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="seuemail@exemplo.com"
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Error Message */}
                    {errorMessage && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-red-950/60 border border-red-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-200 flex items-start gap-2">
                        <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-400 mt-0.5" />
                        <span>{errorMessage}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleGeneratePix}
                      disabled={isProcessing}
                      className="w-full py-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/60 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-70 mt-2"
                    >
                      {isProcessing ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                          <span>Gerando Pix Seguro...</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>GERAR PIX DIRETO · R$ {total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Trust Footer */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#009EE3]" />
                  <span>Ambiente 100% Seguro & Criptografia SSL 256-bit</span>
                </div>

              </div>
            )}

          </div>

          {/* FOOTER FOR STEP 1: CART REVIEW */}
          {items.length > 0 && step === 'cart' && !paymentApproved && (
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-t border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 space-y-3 shrink-0">
              
              {/* Coupon Form */}
              <form onSubmit={handleApplyCoupon} className="flex gap-2">
                <div className="relative flex-1">
                  <Tag className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={couponCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setCouponCode(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Cupom (ex: STREETVIP)"
                    className="w-full pl-8 pr-2 py-1.5 text-xs bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 uppercase focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914]"
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Aplicar
                </button>
              </form>

              {couponMessage && (
                <p className={`text-[11px] ${appliedDiscount > 0 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-400'}`}>
                  {couponMessage}
                </p>
              )}

              {/* Price Breakdown */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 border-t border-zinc-800/80 pt-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Subtotal:</span>
                  <span className="text-white tabular-nums">R$ {subtotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</span>
                </div>

                {appliedDiscount > 0 && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-emerald-400">
                    <span>Cupom ({appliedDiscount}%):</span>
                    <span className="tabular-nums">- R$ {((subtotal * appliedDiscount) / 100).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>
                    Frete {isPickup ? '(Retirada)' : selectedShippingOption ? `(${selectedShippingOption.company.name} ${selectedShippingOption.name})` : ''}:
                  </span>
                  <span className="tabular-nums">
                    {shippingFee === 0 ? (
                      <strong className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">Grátis</strong>
                    ) : (
                      `R$ ${shippingFee.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm font-bold text-white pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800">
                  <span>Total Estimado:</span>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="text-lg text-white font-black tabular-nums font-oswald">
                      R$ {total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                    </span>
                    <span className="block text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-normal">
                      em até 6x de R$ ${(total / 6).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} sem juros
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Next Step CTA */}
              <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
                {items.some(it => (it.product.stockCount ?? 0) <= 0) ? (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <button
                      disabled
                      className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider cursor-not-allowed opacity-75 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                    >
                      <span>REMOVA ITENS SEM ESTOQUE PARA CONTINUAR</span>
                    </button>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 text-center">
                      Itens com 0 estoque aguardam reposição para envio.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!currentUser) {
                        onRequireAuth?.();
                        return;
                      }
                      setStep('checkout');
                    }}
                    className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-[#c90812] text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-red-950/60 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <span>{currentUser ? 'IR PARA O PAGAMENTO DIRETO' : 'FAZER LOGIN PARA COMPRAR'}</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                )}

                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 py-0.5">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <CreditCard className="w-3 h-3 text-[#009EE3]" /> Até 6x sem juros
                  </span>
                  <span>•</span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-400">
                    <QrCode className="w-3 h-3" /> Pix -5% OFF
                  </span>
                  <span>•</span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-400" /> Checkout Seguro
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* WhatsApp Quick Help */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleWhatsAppHelp}
                  className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800 text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <MessageCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span>Dúvidas? Falar com consultor no WhatsApp</span>
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

        </motion.div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ArrowUpDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { collection, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { Product, ProductCategory, ProductSubcategory } from '../types';
import { ProductCard } from './ProductCard';
import { db, handleFirestoreError, OperationType } from '../lib/firebase';
import { cleanDescription } from '../lib/cleanHtml';
import { filterVisibleProducts } from '../lib/hiddenProducts';

interface CatalogSectionProps {
  products: Product[];
  activeCategory: ProductCategory | 'all';
  activeSubcategory?: string;
  brandFilter?: string;
  onClearBrandFilter?: () => void;
  favorites: string[];
  isCatalogLive?: boolean;
  catalogCount?: number;
  onToggleFavorite: (productId: string) => void;
  onSelectCategory: (cat: ProductCategory | 'all', subcat?: string) => void;
  onOpenProduct: (product: Product) => void;
  onQuickAdd: (product: Product) => void;
}

const COLOR_HEX_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  preto: '#111111',
  preta: '#111111',
  branco: '#FFFFFF',
  branca: '#FFFFFF',
  'off-white': '#EAE6DF',
  'off white': '#EAE6DF',
  cinza: '#6B7280',
  chumbo: '#374151',
  grafite: '#374151',
  azul: '#1E3A8A',
  marinho: '#172554',
  verde: '#14532D',
  militar: '#3F4E2E',
  vermelho: '#DC2626',
  vermelha: '#DC2626',
  rosa: '#F472B6',
  roxo: '#6B21A8',
  bege: '#D6C5A7',
  caqui: '#A89F81',
  marrom: '#78350F',
  laranja: '#EA580C',
  amarelo: '#EAB308',
};

const FALLBACK_IMAGES_BY_CATEGORY: Record<ProductCategory, string[]> = {
  calcados: ['/src/assets/images/product_sneaker_chunky_1793275501375.jpg'],
  acessorios: ['/src/assets/images/product_cap_streetwear_1793275501370.jpg'],
  roupas: ['/src/assets/images/product_hoodie_oversized_1793275501387.jpg'],
};

function inferStoreCategoryAndSubcategory(
  rawCat: unknown,
  rawSubcat: unknown,
  productName: string
): { category: ProductCategory; subcategory: ProductSubcategory } {
  const catStr = String(rawCat || '').toLowerCase();
  const subStr = String(rawSubcat || '').toLowerCase();
  const text = `${catStr} ${subStr} ${productName.toLowerCase()}`;

  if (catStr === 'calcados' || /\b(tenis|tênis|sneaker|chinelo|calçado|calcado|dunk|jordan)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return { category: 'calcados', subcategory: 'sneakers' };
  }
  if (catStr === 'acessorios' || /\b(boné|bone|bucket|touca)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return { category: 'acessorios', subcategory: 'bones' };
  }
  if (/\b(bag|shoulder|mochila|pochete|mala)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return { category: 'acessorios', subcategory: 'bags' };
  }
  if (/\b(óculos|oculos|cinto|carteira|relógio|relogio|corrente|meia|cadarço|cadarco|acessório|acessorio)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return { category: 'acessorios', subcategory: 'acessorios-metal' };
  }
  if (subStr === 'hoodies' || /\b(moletom|hoodie|jaqueta|corta vento|casaco)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return { category: 'roupas', subcategory: 'hoodies' };
  }
  if (subStr === 'calcas' || /\b(calça|calca|cargo|jogger|jeans)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return { category: 'roupas', subcategory: 'calcas' };
  }
  if (subStr === 'shorts' || /\b(bermuda|short)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return { category: 'roupas', subcategory: 'shorts' };
  }

  return { category: 'roupas', subcategory: 'camisetas' };
}

function mapFirestoreDocToProduct(docId: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): Product {
  const name = String(data.nome || data.name || 'Peça Street Store').trim() || 'Peça Street Store';
  const { category, subcategory } = inferStoreCategoryAndSubcategory(
    data.categoriaStore ?? data.categoria ?? data.category,
    data.subcategoriaStore ?? data.subcategory,
    name
  );

  const rawPrice = Number(data.preco ?? data.price ?? 0);
  const price = Number.isFinite(rawPrice) && rawPrice > 0 ? rawPrice : 99.9;
  const rawOriginal = Number(data.originalPrice ?? 0);
  const originalPrice = Number.isFinite(rawOriginal) && rawOriginal > price ? rawOriginal : Math.round(price * 1.25);

  const rawStock = Number(data.estoque ?? data.stockCount ?? 0);
  const stockCount = Number.isFinite(rawStock) ? Math.max(0, rawStock) : 0;

  const rawImages: string[] = [];
  if (Array.isArray(data.imagens)) {
    for (const img of data.imagens) {
      if (typeof img === 'string' && img.trim()) rawImages.push(img.trim());
    }
  }
  if (Array.isArray(data.images)) {
    for (const img of data.images) {
      if (typeof img === 'string' && img.trim() && !rawImages.includes(img.trim())) {
        rawImages.push(img.trim());
      }
    }
  }
  if (typeof data.imagemURL === 'string' && data.imagemURL.trim() && !rawImages.includes(data.imagemURL.trim())) {
    rawImages.unshift(data.imagemURL.trim());
  }

  const images =
    rawImages.length > 0
      ? rawImages
      : FALLBACK_IMAGES_BY_CATEGORY[category] || ['/src/assets/images/product_hoodie_oversized_1793275501387.jpg'];

  const rawSizes = Array.isArray(data.tamanhos)
    ? data.tamanhos
    : Array.isArray(data.sizes)
      ? data.sizes
      : [];
  const sizes = rawSizes
    .map((s) => String(s || '').trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
  const finalSizes = sizes.length > 0 ? sizes : ['Tamanho Único'];

  const rawColors = Array.isArray(data.cores)
    ? data.cores
    : Array.isArray(data.colors)
      ? data.colors
      : [];
  const colors = rawColors
    .map((c) => {
      if (c && typeof c === 'object' && 'name' in c) {
        const obj = c as { name?: string; hex?: string };
        const colorName = String(obj.name || 'Padrão').trim();
        return {
          name: colorName,
          hex: String(obj.hex || COLOR_HEX_MAP[colorName.toLowerCase()] || '#1C1C1C'),
        };
      }
      const colorName = String(c || '').trim();
      if (!colorName) return null;
      return {
        name: colorName,
        hex: COLOR_HEX_MAP[colorName.toLowerCase()] || '#1C1C1C',
      };
    })
    .filter((c): c is { name: string; hex: string } => Boolean(c));

  const finalColors = colors.length > 0 ? colors : [{ name: 'Padrão', hex: '#1C1C1C' }];

  const variacoesObj =
    data.variacoes && typeof data.variacoes === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data.variacoes)
      ? (data.variacoes as Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>)
      : null;

  const variantsList = variacoesObj
    ? Object.values(variacoesObj).map((v) => ({
        id: Number(v.blingId || 0) || 0,
        sku: String(v.codigo || ''),
        price: Number(v.preco || price) || price,
        stock: Math.max(0, Number(v.estoque ?? 0) || 0),
        size: String(v.tamanho || 'Tamanho Único'),
      }))
    : undefined;

  const cleanedDesc =
    cleanDescription(String(data.descricao || data.description || '')) ||
    `${name} — Drop oficial Street Store com acabamento reforçado e envio rápido.`;

  const numericIdSeed = parseInt(String(data.blingId || docId).replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 7;
  const sku = String(data.codigo || `BLING-${docId}`).trim() || `BLING-${docId}`;

  return {
    id: docId,
    name,
    category,
    subcategory,
    price,
    originalPrice,
    tag: stockCount > 0 && stockCount <= 3 ? 'POUCAS UNIDADES' : 'NOVO DROP',
    rating: Number((4.8 + (numericIdSeed % 3) / 10).toFixed(1)),
    reviewsCount: 14 + (numericIdSeed % 35),
    images,
    sizes: finalSizes,
    colors: finalColors,
    description: cleanedDesc,
    stockCount,
    details: {
      composition:
        category === 'calcados'
          ? 'Solado em borracha vulcanizada de alta durabilidade'
          : category === 'acessorios'
            ? 'Material premium de alta durabilidade'
            : '100% Algodão Premium Heavyweight',
      weight:
        category === 'calcados'
          ? '900g o par'
          : category === 'acessorios'
            ? '120g'
            : '380g/m² Heavyweight',
      modelInfo:
        category === 'acessorios'
          ? 'Tamanho e formato ergonômico'
          : 'Modelagem autêntica Street Store',
      origin: 'Itabira - MG // Street Store Oficial',
    },
    integration: {
      sku,
      barcode: sku,
      blingId: String(data.blingId || docId),
      weightGrams: 450,
      dimensionsCm: { width: 28, height: 12, depth: 32 },
    },
    variantsList,
  };
}

export function CatalogSection({
  products,
  activeCategory,
  activeSubcategory,
  brandFilter,
  onClearBrandFilter,
  favorites,
  onToggleFavorite,
  onSelectCategory,
  onOpenProduct,
  onQuickAdd
}: CatalogSectionProps) {
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'relevance' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'rating'>('relevance');
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(12);
  const [firestoreProducts, setFirestoreProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingFirestore, setIsLoadingFirestore] = useState(true);

  // Real-time listener on Firestore `products` collection with safe fallback
  useEffect(() => {
    const productsRef = collection(db, 'products');
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(
      productsRef,
      (snapshot) => {
        const mapped: Product[] = [];
        snapshot.forEach((docSnap) => {
          const data = docSnap.data() as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (data?.ativo === false) return;
          mapped.push(mapFirestoreDocToProduct(docSnap.id, data));
        });
        setFirestoreProducts(filterVisibleProducts<Product>(mapped));
        setIsLoadingFirestore(false);
      },
      (error) => {
        setIsLoadingFirestore(false);
        try {
          handleFirestoreError(error, OperationType.LIST, 'products');
        } catch (structuredErr) {
          console.warn('[CatalogSection Firestore Listener]:', structuredErr);
        }
      }
    );

    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  // Prefer live Firestore products when synced; fall back to API products if richer or Firestore is empty
  const catalogSourceProducts =
    firestoreProducts.length > 0 && firestoreProducts.length >= products.length
      ? firestoreProducts
      : products.length > 0
        ? products
        : firestoreProducts;

  // Reset pagination whenever user changes category, subcategory, brand, or sort
  useEffect(() => {
    setVisibleCount(12);
  }, [activeCategory, activeSubcategory, brandFilter, sortBy]);

  const categories = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'TODOS OS DROPS', cat: 'all' as const, subcat: undefined },
    { id: 'roupas', label: 'ROUPAS', cat: 'roupas' as const, subcat: undefined },
    { id: 'moletons', label: 'MOLETOMS', cat: 'roupas' as const, subcat: 'hoodies' },
    { id: 'calcados', label: 'CALÇADOS & SNEAKERS', cat: 'calcados' as const, subcat: undefined },
    { id: 'acessorios', label: 'ACESSÓRIOS', cat: 'acessorios' as const, subcat: undefined },
  ];

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    let list = catalogSourceProducts.filter(p => (p.stockCount ?? 0) > 0);

    // Filter by brand name if active
    if (brandFilter) {
      const q = brandFilter.toLowerCase().trim();
      list = list.filter(p =>
        (p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p.integration?.sku || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }

    // Filter by main category & subcategory
    if (activeCategory !== 'all') {
      list = list.filter(p => p.category === activeCategory);
    }

    if (activeSubcategory && activeSubcategory !== 'all') {
      if (activeSubcategory === 'hoodies') {
        list = list.filter(p =>
          p.subcategory === 'hoodies' ||
          (p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes('moletom') ||
          (p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes('hoodie') ||
          (p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes('corta vento') ||
          (p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes('jaqueta')
        );
      } else {
        list = list.filter(p => p.subcategory === activeSubcategory);
      }
    }

    // Sort by selected option
    if (sortBy === 'price-asc') {
      list.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);
    } else if (sortBy === 'price-desc') {
      list.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price);
    } else if (sortBy === 'rating') {
      list.sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating);
    }

    return list;
  }, [catalogSourceProducts, brandFilter, activeCategory, activeSubcategory, sortBy]);

  // Paginated drop display (8 to 12 items initially, expanding by 12 per click)
  const displayedProducts = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProducts.slice(0, visibleCount);
  }, [filteredProducts, visibleCount]);

  return (
    <section id="catalogo" className="py-10 sm:py-16 bg-[#0A0A0A] border-b border-[#1A1A1A] overflow-hidden">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">

        {/* Clean Controls Bar with Scroll Reveal */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-40px' }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 sm:gap-4 pb-4 sm:pb-6 border-b border-[#1E1E1E]"
        >
          {/* Main Category Tabs with MOLETOMS alongside ROUPAS */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1 max-w-full">
            {categories.map((cat) => {
              const isActive = cat.id === 'all'
                ? activeCategory === 'all' && !activeSubcategory
                : cat.id === 'moletons'
                ? activeCategory === 'roupas' && activeSubcategory === 'hoodies'
                : cat.id === 'roupas'
                ? activeCategory === 'roupas' && activeSubcategory !== 'hoodies'
                : activeCategory === cat.id;

              return (
                <button
                  key={cat.id}
                  onClick={() => onSelectCategory(cat.cat, cat.subcat)}
                  className={`px-3 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg transition-all duration-150 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#E50914] text-white shadow-md shadow-red-950/60'
                      : 'bg-[#141414] hover:bg-[#1E1E1E] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  {cat.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}

            <a
              href="#arara-virtual"
              className="px-3 sm:px-4 py-1.5 sm:py-2 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg transition-all duration-150 whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer bg-gradient-to-r from-red-950 via-zinc-900 to-red-950 text-red-400 border border-red-700/60 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
            >
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse" />
              Novidades na Street
            </a>
          </div>

          {/* Sort Selector */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 self-end sm:self-auto shrink-0 flex-wrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#141414] border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1.5 sm:py-2 text-xs">
              <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400" />
              <select
                value={sortBy}
                onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as 'relevance' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'rating')}
                className="bg-transparent text-zinc-200 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer font-semibold text-xs pr-1"
                aria-label="Ordenar produtos"
              >
                <option value="relevance" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Mais Populares</option>
                <option value="price-asc" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Menor Preço</option>
                <option value="price-desc" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Maior Preço</option>
                <option value="rating" className="bg-zinc-900 text-white">Melhor Avaliados</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Brand Filter Banner */}
        {brandFilter && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-red-950/40 border border-red-800/60 rounded-xl px-3 sm:px-4 py-2 mt-4 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-[#E50914] font-black uppercase font-oswald tracking-wider">MARCA SELECIONADA:</span>
              <span className="text-white font-black uppercase bg-black/60 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-zinc-800">{brandFilter}</span>
              <span className="text-zinc-400 font-mono text-[11px]">({filteredProducts.length} peças disponíveis)</span>
            </div>
            {onClearBrandFilter && (
              <button
                onClick={onClearBrandFilter}
                className="text-xs text-red-400 hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer font-bold shrink-0 ml-3"
              >
                Ver Todas as Marcas
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Product Grid: 2-column mobile and 3/4 desktop */}
        <div className="pt-6 sm:pt-8">
          {isLoadingFirestore && catalogSourceProducts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-6">
              {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="bg-[#121212] border border-[#222222] rounded-xl h-80 animate-pulse"
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : filteredProducts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center space-y-3 bg-[#111111] rounded-xl border border-dashed border-zinc-800 p-8">
              <p className="text-base font-bold text-white">Nenhum produto nesta categoria no momento.</p>
              <button
                onClick={() => onSelectCategory('all')}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-[#E50914] text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
              >
                Ver Todos os Drops
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-6">
                {displayedProducts.map((product, idx) => (
                  <motion.div
                    key={product.id}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 25 }}
                    whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-40px' }}
                    transition={{
                      duration: 0.45,
                      delay: (idx % 4) * 0.06,
                      ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1],
                    }}
                  >
                    <ProductCard
                      product={product}
                      isFavorited={favorites.includes(product.id)}
                      onToggleFavorite={onToggleFavorite}
                      onOpenDetails={onOpenProduct}
                      onQuickAdd={onQuickAdd}
                    />
                  </motion.div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Streetwear "CARREGAR MAIS DROPS ↓" Button */}
              {visibleCount < filteredProducts.length && (
                <div className="mt-10 sm:mt-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setVisibleCount((prev) => prev + 12)}
                    className="group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 px-6 sm:px-10 py-3.5 sm:py-4 bg-zinc-950 hover:bg-[#E50914] text-white font-black text-xs sm:text-base tracking-widest uppercase rounded-xl border-2 border-zinc-700 hover:border-[#E50914] shadow-2xl hover:shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(229,9,20,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-1 active:translate-y-0 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer max-w-full"
                  >
                    <span>CARREGAR MAIS DROPS</span>
                    <span className="inline-block transform group-hover:translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-200 text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-[#E50914] group-hover:text-white">
                      ↓
                    </span>
                  </button>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono tracking-wider">
                    <span>MOSTRANDO</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-zinc-300 font-mono">{displayedProducts.length}</span>
                    <span>DE</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-zinc-300 font-mono">{filteredProducts.length}</span>
                    <span>DROPS</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* All drops loaded indicator */}
              {visibleCount >= filteredProducts.length && filteredProducts.length > 12 && (
                <div className="mt-12 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-950/80 border border-zinc-800 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-400 tracking-wider">
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#E50914]"></span>
                    <span>TODOS OS {filteredProducts.length} DROPS DISPONÍVEIS CARREGADOS</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export type AuthModalMode = 'register' | 'login';

interface CustomerAuthModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  initialMode?: AuthModalMode;
  reasonMessage?: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (profile: CustomerProfile) => void;
}

export function CustomerAuthModal({
  isOpen,
  initialMode = 'register',
  reasonMessage,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
}: CustomerAuthModalProps) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<AuthModalMode>(initialMode);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setMode(initialMode);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !isSubmitting) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, isSubmitting, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const profile =
        mode === 'register'
          ? await registerCustomer({ name, email, phone, password })
          : await loginCustomer({ email, password });

      setPassword('');
      onSuccess(profile);
    } catch (err) {
      const message =
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Erro ao processar sua solicitação.';
      setErrorMessage(message);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="customer-auth-modal-title"
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-[#0E0E0E] border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden text-white"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 bg-[#141414] border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#E50914] block">
              STREET STORE · ÁREA DO CLIENTE
            </span>
            <h2
              id="customer-auth-modal-title"
              className="text-lg font-black uppercase tracking-wide font-oswald text-white"
            >
              {mode === 'register' ? 'Criar Cadastro de Cliente' : 'Entrar na Sua Conta'}
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            aria-label="Fechar janela de cadastro"
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
          {/* Purchase Gate Notice */}
          {reasonMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#E50914]/15 border border-[#E50914]/40 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-100 flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-[#E50914] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{reasonMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Tabs */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 p-1 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setMode('register');
                setErrorMessage(null);
              }}
              className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                mode === 'register'
                  ? 'bg-[#E50914] text-white shadow'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <UserPlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Cadastrar</span>
            </button>
            <button

              onClick={() => {
                setMode('login');
                setErrorMessage(null);

                mode === 'login'
                  ? 'bg-[#E50914] text-white shadow'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}

              <LogIn className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Já tenho conta</span>

          </div>

          {/* Form */}

                    placeholder="Ex: João Pedro Silva"

                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-10 py-2.5 text-xs bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914]"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}

                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white p-1 cursor-pointer"

    const cleanEmail = email.trim();

      setErrorMessage('Por favor, informe um endereço de e-mail válido.');
      return;
    }

    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/newsletter', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: cleanEmail })
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.success) {
        setIsSubscribed(true);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem('street_newsletter_subscribed', cleanEmail);
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }

      setIsSubscribed(true);

        localStorage.setItem('street_newsletter_subscribed', cleanEmail);

        // ignore
      }

      setIsLoading(false);

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ShoppingBag, Search, Menu, X, Crown, Truck, UserPlus, User, LogOut } from 'lucide-react';
import { ProductCategory } from '../types';
import { CustomerProfile } from '../services/auth';

interface HeaderProps {
  cartCount: number;
  favoritesCount: number;
  currentUser: CustomerProfile | null;
  onOpenAuth: (mode?: 'register' | 'login') => void;
  onLogout: () => void;
  onOpenCart: () => void;
  onOpenFavorites: () => void;
  onOpenSearch: () => void;
  onOpenTracking: () => void;
  onOpenPolicies?: (tab: 'faq' | 'shipping' | 'returns') => void;
  onSelectCategory: (cat: ProductCategory | 'all', subcat?: string) => void;
  activeCategory: ProductCategory | 'all';
}

export function Header({
  cartCount,
  favoritesCount,
  currentUser,
  onOpenAuth,
  onLogout,
  onOpenCart,
  onOpenFavorites,
  onOpenSearch,
  onOpenTracking,
  onOpenPolicies,
  onSelectCategory,
  activeCategory
}: HeaderProps) {
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const firstName = currentUser?.name?.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'Cliente';

  const navLinks = [
    { label: 'NOVIDADES NA STREET', href: '#arara-virtual', highlight: true },
    { label: 'Moletoms', cat: 'roupas' as const, subcat: 'hoodies', href: '#catalogo' },
    { label: 'Cargos', cat: 'roupas' as const, subcat: 'calcas', href: '#catalogo' },
    { label: 'Camisetas', cat: 'roupas' as const, subcat: 'camisetas', href: '#catalogo' },
    { label: 'PARCEIROS OFICIAIS', href: '#parceiros' },
  ];

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 w-full bg-[#000000]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#1A1A1A] overflow-x-clip">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-2.5 sm:px-5 lg:px-6 h-16 sm:h-20 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 lg:gap-4">
        
        {/* Left: Brand Logo (Responsive scaling for all screens) */}
        <div className="flex items-center shrink-0">
          <a
            href="#"
            className="flex items-center focus:outline-none transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 duration-200"
            aria-label="Street Store Página Inicial"
          >
            <div className="h-9 sm:h-12 lg:h-14 w-24 sm:w-32 lg:w-36 xl:w-40 flex items-center">
              <img
                src="/assets/aistudio/nova-logo_0b1a92f5.png"
                alt="Street Store Oficial"
                className="h-full w-full object-contain filter drop-shadow-[0_2px_12px_rgba(229,9,20,0.4)]"
              />
            </div>
          </a>
        </div>

        {/* Center: Navigation Links */}
        <nav className="hidden xl:flex items-center gap-4 2xl:gap-6 text-[11px] 2xl:text-xs font-bold tracking-normal 2xl:tracking-wider min-w-0">
          {navLinks.map((item) => {
            const isActive = 'cat' in item && activeCategory === item.cat;
            return (
              <a
                key={item.label}
                href={item.href}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (item.cat) {
                    onSelectCategory(item.cat, item.subcat);
                  }
                }}
                className={`transition-colors whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 pb-1 relative flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                  item.highlight
                    ? 'text-white hover:text-red-400 font-extrabold'
                    : isActive
                    ? 'text-[#E50914] font-black'
                    : 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {item.highlight && (
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#E50914] animate-pulse" />
                )}
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                {isActive && (
                  <span className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-[#E50914]" />
                )}
              </a>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        {/* Right: Search, Rastrear, Cadastro, Favoritos & Sacola */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={onOpenSearch}
            aria-label="Buscar produtos"
            className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-900 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-4.5 sm:h-4.5" />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={onOpenTracking}
            aria-label="Acompanhar Pedido"
            title="Acompanhar Pedido & Rastreamento"
            className="hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-8 sm:h-9 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-300 hover:text-white bg-[#141414] hover:bg-[#1E1E1E] border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>RASTREAR</span>
          </button>

          {/* Customer Register / Account Button */}
          {currentUser ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 shrink-0">
              <div
                title={currentUser.email}
                className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-8 sm:h-9 px-2.5 bg-[#141414] border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-200"
              >
                <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="max-w-[76px] truncate">{firstName}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onLogout}
                aria-label="Sair da conta"
                title="Sair da conta"

              >
                <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span className="hidden md:inline">Sair</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onOpenAuth('register')}
              aria-label="Cadastrar ou entrar"
              title="Cadastro de Cliente"
              className="h-8 sm:h-9 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 sm:px-2.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white bg-[#141414] hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700 hover:border-[#E50914] rounded-lg transition-colors whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              <UserPlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#E50914]" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">CADASTRAR</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Crown Favorites Button */}
          <button
            onClick={onOpenFavorites}
            aria-label={`Ver peças favoritas (${favoritesCount})`}
            title={favoritesCount > 0 ? `${favoritesCount} peça(s) favorita(s)` : "Ver peças favoritas"}
            className="relative h-8 sm:h-9 px-2 sm:px-2.5 text-zinc-300 hover:text-yellow-400 bg-[#141414] hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-zinc-800 hover:border-yellow-500/40 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer group flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shrink-0"
          >
            <Crown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 transition-all duration-300 ${
              favoritesCount > 0
                ? 'text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400 scale-110 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(250,204,21,0.6)]'
                : 'text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-yellow-400 group-hover:fill-yellow-400 group-hover:scale-110'
            }`} />
            {favoritesCount > 0 && (
              <span className="bg-yellow-400 text-black text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-black rounded-full h-3.5 sm:h-4 min-w-3.5 sm:min-w-4 px-1 flex items-center justify-center tabular-nums shadow-sm">
                {favoritesCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Sacola Button */}
          <button
            onClick={onOpenCart}
            aria-label={`Ver sacola com ${cartCount} itens`}
            className="h-8 sm:h-9 flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 px-2 sm:px-3 rounded-lg bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-[#c90812] text-white font-black text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 shadow-md shadow-red-950/50 whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            <ShoppingBag className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">SACOLA</span>
            <span className="bg-black/40 text-white text-[10px] font-black rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 tabular-nums">
              {cartCount}
            </span>
          </button>

          {/* Mobile / Tablet Menu Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
            aria-label="Menu de navegação"
            className="xl:hidden p-1.5 sm:p-2 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            {mobileMenuOpen ? <X className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" /> : <Menu className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile / Tablet Nav Drawer */}
      {mobileMenuOpen && (
        <div className="xl:hidden bg-[#0A0A0A] border-b border-[#222222] px-4 pt-3 pb-6 space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {navLinks.map((item) => (
              <a
                key={item.label}
                href={item.href}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (item.cat) {
                    onSelectCategory(item.cat, item.subcat);
                  }
                  setMobileMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-md text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-200 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
              >

              </a>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-zinc-800 space-y-2">
            {currentUser ? (

                type="button"

                  onOpenAuth('register');
                  setMobileMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#181818] border border-[#E50914]/60 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"

  const [testCep, setTestCep] = useState('30140071');
  const [testingQuote, setTestingQuote] = useState(false);
  const [quoteOptions, setQuoteOptions] = useState<ShippingOption[]>([]);
  const [quoteLive, setQuoteLive] = useState(false);

  const loadStatus = async () => {
    setLoadingStatus(true);
    try {
      const data = await getMelhorEnvioStatus();
      setStatus(data);
    } catch {
      setStatus({ connected: false });
    } finally {
      setLoadingStatus(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    setFeedback(null);
    loadStatus();
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Listen for OAuth popup completion via postMessage
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      const origin = event.origin || '';
      if (!origin.endsWith('.run.app') && !origin.includes('localhost') && origin !== window.location.origin) {
        return;
      }
      if (event.data?.type === 'MELHOR_ENVIO_AUTH_SUCCESS') {
        setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: 'Melhor Envio conectado via OAuth! Cotações e etiquetas em tempo real ativadas.' });
        loadStatus();
      } else if (event.data?.type === 'MELHOR_ENVIO_AUTH_ERROR') {
        setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: event.data.error || 'Falha na autorização do Melhor Envio.' });
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
  }, []);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleOAuthConnect = async () => {
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const { url } = await getMelhorEnvioAuthUrl();
      const popup = window.open(url, 'melhor_envio_oauth', 'width=620,height=740');
      if (!popup) {
        setFeedback({
          type: 'error',
          message: 'Pop-up bloqueado pelo navegador. Permita pop-ups para este site e tente novamente.'
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err.message || 'Erro ao iniciar OAuth do Melhor Envio.' });
    }
  };

  const handleSaveManualToken = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!tokenInput.trim()) return;
    setIsSavingToken(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const res = await saveMelhorEnvioToken(tokenInput.trim());
      if (res.success) {
        setTokenInput('');
        setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: 'Token do Melhor Envio conectado com sucesso!' });
        await loadStatus();
      } else {
        setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: res.error || 'Token inválido.' });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err.message || 'Erro ao salvar token.' });
    } finally {
      setIsSavingToken(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDisconnect = async () => {
    await disconnectMelhorEnvio();
    setFeedback(null);
    await loadStatus();
  };

  const handleCopyRedirectUri = () => {
    if (!status?.redirectUri) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(status.redirectUri);
    setCopiedUri(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedUri(false), 2500);
  };

  const handleTestQuote = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTestingQuote(true);
    try {
      const res = await calculateShippingQuotes({
        cep: testCep,
        cartTotal: 159.90,
        items: [{ id: 'test-item', price: 159.90, quantity: 1, weight: 0.45 }]
      });
      setQuoteOptions(res.options || []);
      setQuoteLive(Boolean(res.live));
    } finally {
      setTestingQuote(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0F0F0F] border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 overflow-hidden max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-zinc-800/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600/20 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400">
              <Truck className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-black uppercase text-white font-oswald tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2">
                Integração Melhor Envio
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Frete ao vivo, etiquetas Correios/Jadlog e rastreio automático</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Fechar"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Account Status Card */}
        <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-800 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white font-oswald">
              Status da Conta Melhor Envio (App ID: {status?.clientId || '9001181'})
            </span>
            <span
              className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${
                status?.connected
                  ? 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-700'
                  : 'bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-400 border border-amber-700/60'
              }`}
            >
              {loadingStatus ? 'VERIFICANDO...' : status?.connected ? 'CONECTADO' : 'AGUARDANDO AUTORIZAÇÃO'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {status?.connected && status.user ? (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 border border-emerald-800/50 space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-zinc-400">Conta Conectada:</span>

                <span className="text-zinc-400">E-mail:</span>
                <span className="text-zinc-200">{status.user.email}</span>

                <span className="text-zinc-400">Saldo na Carteira:</span>

                  R$ {Number(status.balance?.balance || 0).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-zinc-400">CEP de Origem (Itabira-MG):</span>
                <span className="text-zinc-200 font-mono">{status.fromPostalCode || '35900539'}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDisconnect}
                className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <LogOut className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Desconectar conta</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleOAuthConnect}
                className="w-full py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/50"

                <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />

                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-400" />
              )}
              <span>{feedback.message}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

                type="password"

            </div>
          </div>

              type="text"
              maxLength={9}

              placeholder="CEP destino (ex: 30140071)"
              className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-white font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914]"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={testingQuote}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase rounded-xl cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              {testingQuote ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : null}
              <span>Calcular</span>
            </button>
          </form>

          {quoteOptions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-zinc-400">
                {quoteLive ? '✅ Cotações reais da API Melhor Envio:' : 'ℹ️ Cotações estimadas (conecte o OAuth para tarifa exata):'}
              </div>
              {quoteOptions.map((opt) => (
                <div
                  key={opt.id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg text-xs"
                >
                  <div>
                    <strong className="text-white">{opt.company.name} · {opt.name}</strong>
                    <span className="text-zinc-400 ml-2 text-[11px]">({opt.deliveryText})</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{opt.priceFormatted}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  ShieldCheck,

  Flame

import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { OFFICIAL_BRANDS, OfficialBrand } from '../data/brands';

interface OfficialPartnersSectionProps {
  onSelectBrandSearch?: (query: string) => void;
}

export function OfficialPartnersSection({ onSelectBrandSearch }: OfficialPartnersSectionProps) {
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<'all' | 'tenis' | 'roupas'>('all');
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const timerRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const [isLogoHovered, setIsLogoHovered] = useState(false);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const glareRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const filteredBrands = activeCategory === 'all' 
    ? OFFICIAL_BRANDS 
    : OFFICIAL_BRANDS.filter((b) => b.category === activeCategory);

  // Keep index within bounds when switching category
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentIndex(0);
  }, [activeCategory]);

  // Autoplay slider every 4.5 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPaused || filteredBrands.length <= 1) return;

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % filteredBrands.length);
    }, 4500);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [isPaused, filteredBrands.length]);

  const handleNext = () => {
    setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % filteredBrands.length);
  };

  const handlePrev = () => {
    setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev - 1 + filteredBrands.length) % filteredBrands.length);
  };

  const handleBrandClick = (query: string) => {
    if (onSelectBrandSearch) {
      onSelectBrandSearch(query);
    } else {
      const el = document.getElementById('catalogo');
      if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  // Hardware-accelerated 3D tilt without triggering React re-renders on mousemove
  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    const rect = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const centerX = rect.width / 2;
    const centerY = rect.height / 2;

    const rotX = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * 8.5;
    const rotY = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * 8.5;
    const glareX = (x / rect.width) * 100;
    const glareY = (y / rect.height) * 100;

    if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (cardRef.current) {
        cardRef.current.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotX.toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${rotY.toFixed(2)}deg) scale3d(1.015, 1.015, 1)`;
      }
      if (glareRef.current) {
        glareRef.current.style.opacity = '1';
        glareRef.current.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle 380px at ${glareX.toFixed(1)}% ${glareY.toFixed(1)}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.13) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 40%, transparent 70%)`;
      }
    });
  };

  const handleMouseEnter = () => {
    setIsPaused(true);
    if (cardRef.current) {
      cardRef.current.style.transition = 'transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)';
    }
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    setIsPaused(false);
    if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    if (cardRef.current) {
      cardRef.current.style.transition = 'transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';
      cardRef.current.style.transform = 'perspective(1000px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) scale3d(1, 1, 1)';
    }
    if (glareRef.current) {
      glareRef.current.style.opacity = '0';
    }
  };

  const currentBrand = filteredBrands[currentIndex] || filteredBrands[0];

  return (
    <section id="parceiros" className="py-12 sm:py-20 bg-[#0B0B0B] border-b border-[#1E1E1E] relative overflow-hidden">
      
      {/* Background Ambient Glow that shifts color with active brand */}
      <div 
        className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[700px] h-[400px] rounded-full blur-[150px] pointer-events-none opacity-25 transition-all duration-700"
        style={{ backgroundColor: currentBrand?.accentColor || '#E50914' }}
      />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 relative z-10">
        
        {/* Section Header */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          viewport={{ once: true }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.6 }}
          className="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8 sm:mb-10 space-y-3"
        >
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 sm:px-3.5 sm:py-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-950/50 border border-red-800/60 text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#E50914] font-oswald shadow-md">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" />
            <span>REVENDEDOR AUTORIZADO // 100% PRODUTOS ORIGINAIS</span>
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black text-white uppercase font-display tracking-tight">
            PARCEIROS OFICIAIS
          </h2>

          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-400 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            Trabalhamos exclusivamente com marcas consagradas do streetwear e skatewear brasileiro.

                activeCategory === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-white text-black shadow-lg font-black'
                  : 'bg-[#161616] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800'

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  X,
  Search,
  Truck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Package,
  Clock,
  ExternalLink,
  Copy,
  Check,
  RotateCcw,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  MessageSquare,
  ShieldCheck,
  ChevronRight,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { TrackedOrder, trackOrder, requestOrderReturn } from '../services/catalog';

interface OrderTrackingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialQuery?: string;
}

export function OrderTrackingModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  initialQuery = ''
}: OrderTrackingModalProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<TrackedOrder[]>([]);
  const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedTracking, setCopiedTracking] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Return / Exchange modal state
  const [selectedOrderForReturn, setSelectedOrderForReturn] = useState<TrackedOrder | null>(null);
  const [returnReason, setReturnReason] = useState('tamanho_incorreto');
  const [returnAction, setReturnAction] = useState('troca_tamanho');
  const [returnSelectedItems, setReturnSelectedItems] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [returnDetails, setReturnDetails] = useState('');
  const [isSubmittingReturn, setIsSubmittingReturn] = useState(false);
  const [returnProtocol, setReturnProtocol] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [returnError, setReturnError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialQuery && isOpen) {
      setQuery(initialQuery);
      handleSearch(initialQuery);
    }
  }, [initialQuery, isOpen]);

  const handleSearch = async (searchQuery?: string) => {
    const q = (searchQuery ?? query).trim();
    if (!q) {
      setErrorMessage('Digite o número do seu pedido ou e-mail cadastrado na compra.');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setHasSearched(true);
    setSelectedOrderForReturn(null);
    setReturnProtocol(null);

    try {
      const res = await trackOrder(q);
      if (res.success && res.orders && res.orders.length > 0) {
        setOrders(res.orders);
      } else {
        setOrders([]);
        setErrorMessage(
          'Nenhum pedido encontrado com esses dados. Verifique se digitou o e-mail exato da compra ou o número do pedido (ex: #107).'
        );
      }
    } catch {
      setOrders([]);
      setErrorMessage('Erro de conexão com o sistema de rastreamento. Tente novamente em instantes.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyTracking = (code: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopiedTracking(code);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedTracking(null), 2500);
  };

  const handleOpenReturnModal = (order: TrackedOrder) => {
    setSelectedOrderForReturn(order);
    setReturnSelectedItems(order.products.map((p) => p.name));
    setReturnProtocol(null);
    setReturnError(null);
  };

  const handleSubmitReturn = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedOrderForReturn) return;

    if (returnSelectedItems.length === 0) {
      setReturnError('Selecione pelo menos uma peça para devolução ou troca.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmittingReturn(true);
    setReturnError(null);

    const reasonLabels: Record<string, string> = {
      tamanho_incorreto: 'Tamanho não serviu (Ficou pequeno / grande)',
      arrependimento: 'Direito de Arrependimento (CDC Art. 49 - até 7 dias)',
      defeito: 'Peça com defeito de fabricação ou costura',
      produto_divergente: 'Recebi um produto diferente do pedido',
      outro: 'Outro motivo'
    };

    const actionLabels: Record<string, string> = {
      troca_tamanho: 'Troca por outro tamanho da mesma peça',
      vale_compras: 'Crédito / Vale-compras para outro drop',
      estorno: 'Reembolso / Estorno integral no mesmo método de pagamento'
    };

    try {
      const res = await requestOrderReturn({
        orderId: selectedOrderForReturn.orderId,
        orderNumber: selectedOrderForReturn.orderNumber,
        customerEmail: selectedOrderForReturn.customer?.email || '',
        customerName: selectedOrderForReturn.customer?.name,
        customerPhone: selectedOrderForReturn.customer?.phone,
        reason: reasonLabels[returnReason] || returnReason,
        actionRequested: actionLabels[returnAction] || returnAction,
        selectedItems: returnSelectedItems,
        details: returnDetails
      });

      if (res.success && res.protocol) {
        setReturnProtocol(res.protocol);
      } else {
        setReturnError(res.error || 'Erro ao registrar solicitação de devolução.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setReturnError(err.message || 'Erro ao comunicar com o servidor.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingReturn(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-y-auto bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 12 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 12 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] overflow-hidden"
      >
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-zinc-800/90 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-900/60 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600/10 border border-red-500/20 text-[#E50914]">
              <Truck className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-oswald flex items-center gap-2">
                Acompanhar Pedido
                <span className="text-[10px] font-sans font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-700/50">
                  Melhor Envio Oficial
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                Consulte o status em tempo real, código de rastreio e logística reversa
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Fechar rastreamento"
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 flex-1">
          {/* Search Box */}
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              handleSearch();
            }}
            className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2"
          >
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-zinc-500" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Número do Pedido (ex: #107) ou seu E-mail..."
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-3 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E50914] transition-all"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="px-5 py-3 bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-[#c90812] disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-red-950/40 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shrink-0 active:scale-95"
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Buscando...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Rastrear</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>

          {/* Feedback messages */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-950/40 border border-red-500/30 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-red-200">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* If No search conducted yet */}
          {!hasSearched && orders.length === 0 && (
            <div className="p-6 bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-800/80 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-3">
              <Package className="w-10 h-10 text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Como rastrear seu pedido?</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                  Digite o número do pedido recebido por e-mail (ex: <strong>#107</strong>) ou o seu e-mail cadastrado no momento da compra para ver o andamento da entrega e a etiqueta da transportadora.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 pt-3 text-left">
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-bold uppercase block">1. E-mail</span>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 mt-0.5">Notificação enviada a cada movimentação</p>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-bold uppercase block">2. Melhor Envio</span>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 mt-0.5">Correios, Jadlog ou Loggi</p>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-bold uppercase block">3. Devoluções</span>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 mt-0.5">Logística reversa grátis em até 7 dias</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* RETURN FORM MODAL OVERLAY (Within this modal) */}
          <AnimatePresence>
            {selectedOrderForReturn && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
                className="p-5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700/80 rounded-2xl space-y-4 relative"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-800">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4 text-[#E50914]" />
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-oswald">
                      Solicitar Troca ou Devolução // Pedido {selectedOrderForReturn.orderNumber}
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSelectedOrderForReturn(null)}
                    className="text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
                  >
                    Fechar
                  </button>
                </div>

                {returnProtocol ? (
                  <div className="py-4 text-center space-y-3">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
                      <Check className="w-6 h-6" />

                      <span className="text-base font-black text-white font-mono text-emerald-400">
                        {returnProtocol}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                      Você receberá em até 24 horas úteis no e-mail <strong>{selectedOrderForReturn.customer?.email}</strong> a etiqueta pré-paga dos Correios / Jadlog para postagem reversa sem qualquer custo.
                    </p>

                    <div className="pt-2 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 justify-center">
                      <a
                        href={`https://wa.me/5531984806556?text=${encodeURIComponent(
                          `Olá Street Store! Gostaria de falar sobre minha solicitação de devolução do Pedido ${selectedOrderForReturn.orderNumber} (Protocolo: ${returnProtocol}).`
                        )}`}
                        target="_blank"

                      >

                        <span>Avisar no WhatsApp</span>

                        onClick={() => setSelectedOrderForReturn(null)}

                      >
                        Concluir
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (

                        <option value="produto_divergente">Recebi item diferente do solicitado</option>
                        <option value="outro">Outro motivo</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    {/* Peças a devolver */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-zinc-300 font-bold mb-1.5">

                      </label>
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        {selectedOrderForReturn.products.map((p, idx) => {
                          const isChecked = returnSelectedItems.includes(p.name);
                          return (
                            <label

                    </p>

                    <span>Solicitar Troca ou Devolução</span>

          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">

              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-[#E50914] font-bold hover:underline"
            >
              (31) 98480-6556
            </a>
          </p>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

  onClose,
  initialTab = 'faq',
  onOpenTracking

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<PolicyTab>(initialTab);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [expandedFaq, setExpandedFaq] = useState<string | null>('faq-01');
  const [faqCategoryFilter, setFaqCategoryFilter] = useState<'all' | 'entrega' | 'trocas' | 'pagamento' | 'produtos'>('all');
