import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Eye, Plus, Star, Crown } from 'lucide-react';
import { Product } from '../types';

interface ProductCardProps {
  product: Product;
  isFavorited?: boolean;
  onToggleFavorite?: (productId: string) => void;
  onOpenDetails: (product: Product) => void;
  onQuickAdd: (product: Product) => void;
}

export function ProductCard({
  product,
  isFavorited = false,
  onToggleFavorite,
  onOpenDetails,
  onQuickAdd
}: ProductCardProps) {
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [rotateX, setRotateX] = useState(0);
  const [rotateY, setRotateY] = useState(0);
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    const rect = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const centerX = rect.width / 2;
    const centerY = rect.height / 2;

    // Subtle 3D tilt angles (max ~8 degrees for elegant responsive feel)
    const rotX = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * 7;
    const rotY = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * 7;

    setRotateX(rotX);
    setRotateY(rotY);
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    setIsHovered(false);
    setRotateX(0);
    setRotateY(0);
  };

  const handleMouseEnter = () => {
    setIsHovered(true);
  };

  const installments = (product.price / 6).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
  const isOutOfStock = (product.stockCount ?? 0) <= 0;

  return (
    <motion.div
      ref={cardRef}
      onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
      onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
      style={{
        transformStyle: 'preserve-3d',
        transform: `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) ${isHovered ? 'scale(1.025) translateY(-4px)' : 'scale(1) translateY(0)'}`,
        transition: isHovered ? 'transform 0.1s ease-out, box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease' : 'transform 0.4s ease-out, box-shadow 0.4s ease, border-color 0.4s ease',
      }}
      className={`group relative flex flex-col bg-[#121212] rounded-xl border shadow-md transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden cursor-pointer ${
        isOutOfStock
          ? 'border-zinc-800/80 hover:border-red-900/60 opacity-90'
          : 'border-[#222222] hover:border-[#E50914]/80 hover:shadow-[0_0_28px_rgba(229,9,20,0.35),0_0_8px_rgba(229,9,20,0.5),0_16px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)]'
      }`}
    >
      {/* Streetwear Neon Top Glow Line */}
      {!isOutOfStock && (
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#E50914] to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 z-30 pointer-events-none" />
      )}

      {/* Visual Image Container */}
      <div 
        onClick={() => onOpenDetails(product)}
        className="relative aspect-[4/3] sm:aspect-[1/1] w-full overflow-hidden bg-zinc-950 cursor-pointer"
      >
        <img
          src={product.images[0]}
          alt={product.name}
          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
          className={`w-full h-full object-cover object-center group-hover:scale-108 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out ${
            isOutOfStock ? 'grayscale-[40%] contrast-90' : ''
          }`}
        />

        {/* Overlay gradient */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300" />

        {/* Out of Stock Darkened Overlay & Badge */}
        {isOutOfStock && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-[1px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 z-10 pointer-events-none">
            <div className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-black/90 border border-red-700/80 text-[#E50914] font-black text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-widest shadow-xl text-center font-oswald">
              SEM ESTOQUE
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Minimalist Editorial Tag (Unboxed / Clean) */}
        {isOutOfStock ? (
          <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 sm:top-3 sm:left-3 z-10">
            <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 sm:py-1 rounded bg-black/90 text-[#E50914] border border-red-800/80 shadow-md">
              ESGOTADO
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : product.tag ? (
          <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 sm:top-3 sm:left-3 z-10">
            <span className={`text-[8px] sm:text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider sm:tracking-widest px-1.5 sm:px-2.5 py-0.5 sm:py-1 rounded ${
              product.tag === 'POUCAS UNIDADES'
                ? 'bg-[#E50914] text-white'
                : product.tag === 'NOVO DROP'
                ? 'bg-white text-black'
                : 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-700'
            }`}>
              {product.tag}
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {/* Crown Favorite Button */}
        <button
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (onToggleFavorite) onToggleFavorite(product.id);
          }}
          aria-label={isFavorited ? 'Remover dos favoritos' : 'Favoritar peça'}
          title={isFavorited ? 'Peça coroada nos favoritos' : 'Coroar peça favorita'}
          className={`absolute top-2 right-2 sm:top-3 sm:right-3 z-20 p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
            isFavorited
              ? 'bg-yellow-400/25 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-400/70 scale-110 shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(250,204,21,0.6)]'
              : 'bg-black/70 text-zinc-400 hover:text-yellow-400 hover:bg-black/90 border border-zinc-700/80 hover:scale-110'
          }`}
        >
          <Crown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 transition-transform ${isFavorited ? 'fill-yellow-400 scale-105' : ''}`} />
        </button>

        {/* Quick action hover trigger buttons (desktop) */}
        <div className="hidden sm:flex absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 items-center gap-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-200 translate-y-2 group-hover:translate-y-0 z-10">
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onOpenDetails(product);
            }}
            className="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/90 hover:bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider backdrop-blur-md border border-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{isOutOfStock ? 'Ver Detalhes' : 'Ver Detalhes'}</span>
          </button>
          
          {isOutOfStock ? (
            <button
              disabled
              title="Peça sem estoque no momento."
              className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800/80 text-zinc-500 text-xs font-bold border border-zinc-700/60 cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4 opacity-30" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onQuickAdd(product);
              }}
              title="Adicionar ao Carrinho"
              className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-[#c90812] text-white text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Card Content & Metadata */}
      <div className="p-2.5 sm:p-4 flex flex-col flex-1 justify-between space-y-2 sm:space-y-3">
        <div>
          {/* Subtle unboxed metadata */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold truncate">
            <span>{product.category}</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
            <span>{product.details.weight.split(' ')[0]}</span>
          </div>

          <h3 
            onClick={() => onOpenDetails(product)}
            className="text-xs sm:text-base font-bold text-white group-hover:text-[#E50914] transition-colors cursor-pointer mt-1 line-clamp-2 leading-tight sm:leading-snug"
          >
            {product.name}
          </h3>
        </div>

        {/* Price & Installments Module */}
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[#222222] flex items-end justify-between gap-1.5">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className={`text-sm sm:text-lg font-bold tabular-nums ${isOutOfStock ? 'text-zinc-400' : 'text-white'}`}>
                R$ {product.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
              </span>
              {product.originalPrice > product.price && (
                <span className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-zinc-500 line-through tabular-nums">
                  R$ {product.originalPrice.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {isOutOfStock ? (
              <p className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold text-red-400 uppercase tracking-wide truncate mt-0.5">
                SEM ESTOQUE • AUTO RENOVÁVEL
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-[9px] sm:text-[11px] text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                ou <span className="text-zinc-200 font-semibold">6x de R$ {installments}</span>
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Touch-Friendly Quick Add Button for Mobile screens */}
          {isOutOfStock ? (
            <button
              disabled
              title="Peça sem estoque no momento"
              className="sm:hidden px-2 py-1 rounded bg-zinc-900 border border-red-900/50 text-red-400 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider cursor-not-allowed opacity-80 shrink-0"
            >
              ESGOTADO
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onQuickAdd(product);
              }}
              title={`Adicionar ${product.name} à sacola`}
              aria-label={`Adicionar ${product.name} à sacola`}
              className="sm:hidden p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#E50914] text-white active:scale-95 shrink-0 shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { 
  X, 
  ShoppingBag, 
  Truck, 
  Ruler, 
  Check, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Database,
  ArrowRight,
  Crown,
  AlertCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Product } from '../types';
import { cleanDescription } from '../lib/cleanHtml';
import { calculateShippingQuotes, ShippingOption } from '../services/shipping';

interface ProductModalProps {
  product: Product | null;
  isOpen: boolean;
  isFavorited?: boolean;
  onToggleFavorite?: (productId: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAddToCart: (product: Product, size: string, color: string, quantity: number) => void;
  onBuyNow: (product: Product, size: string, color: string, quantity: number) => void;
}

export function ProductModal({
  product,
  isOpen,
  isFavorited = false,
  onToggleFavorite,
  onClose,
  onAddToCart,
  onBuyNow
}: ProductModalProps) {
  // Declare all hooks unconditionally at the top of the component (Rules of Hooks)
  const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = useState(0);
  const [selectedSize, setSelectedSize] = useState(product?.sizes?.[0] || 'Tamanho Único');
  const [selectedColor, setSelectedColor] = useState(product?.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Cor Única');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  const [showSizeGuide, setShowSizeGuide] = useState(false);
  const [showIntegrationDetails, setShowIntegrationDetails] = useState(false);

  // CEP simulator state (Melhor Envio live calculation)
  const [cep, setCep] = useState('');
  const [shippingCalculated, setShippingCalculated] = useState(false);
  const [shippingLoading, setShippingLoading] = useState(false);
  const [shippingOptions, setShippingOptions] = useState<ShippingOption[]>([]);

  // Synchronize selection whenever the active product changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (product) {
      setSelectedSize(product.sizes?.[0] || 'Tamanho Único');
      setSelectedColor(product.colors?.[0]?.name || 'Cor Única');
      setSelectedImage(0);
      setShowSizeGuide(false);
      setQuantity(1);
    }
  }, [product?.id]);

  // Early return only AFTER all hooks are declared
  if (!product || !isOpen) return null;

  const isUniqueSize = (product.sizes?.length || 0) <= 1 && (
    product.sizes?.[0] === 'Tamanho Único' || 
    product.sizes?.[0] === 'Único' || 
    product.sizes?.[0] === 'Ajustável' || 
    product.category === 'acessorios'
  );

  const isSingleColor = (product.colors?.length || 0) <= 1;
  const isOutOfStock = (product.stockCount ?? 0) <= 0;

  const handleSimulateShipping = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanCep = cep.replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (cleanCep.length < 8) return;
    setShippingLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await calculateShippingQuotes({
        cep: cleanCep,
        cartTotal: product.price,
        items: [{
          id: product.id,
          price: product.price,
          quantity,
          weight: (product.integration?.weightGrams || 350) / 1000
        }]
      });
      if (res && res.options && res.options.length > 0) {
        setShippingOptions(res.options);
      }
      setShippingCalculated(true);
    } catch {
      setShippingCalculated(true);
    } finally {
      setShippingLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const installments = (product.price / 6).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-y-auto bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6">
      
      {/* Modal Dialog Card */}
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
        className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-[#121212] border border-[#262626] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Favorite Crown Button */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (onToggleFavorite) onToggleFavorite(product.id);
          }}
          aria-label={isFavorited ? 'Remover dos favoritos' : 'Favoritar produto com a coroa'}
          title={isFavorited ? 'Peça coroada nos favoritos' : 'Coroar peça favorita'}
          className={`absolute top-4 right-16 z-20 p-2 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
            isFavorited
              ? 'bg-yellow-400/25 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-400/70 scale-105 shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(250,204,21,0.6)]'
              : 'bg-black/60 text-zinc-400 hover:text-yellow-400 hover:bg-black/90 border border-zinc-700'
          }`}
        >
          <Crown className={`w-5 h-5 transition-transform ${isFavorited ? 'fill-yellow-400 scale-105' : ''}`} />
        </button>

        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Fechar detalhes do produto"
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-20 p-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white bg-black/60 hover:bg-black rounded-full transition-colors border border-zinc-700 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2">
          
          {/* Left Column: Gallery */}
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 bg-zinc-950 flex flex-col justify-between border-b md:border-b-0 md:border-r border-[#262626]">
            {/* Main Active Image */}
            <div className="relative aspect-square w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#181818] border border-zinc-800">
              <img
                src={product.images[selectedImage] || product.images[0]}
                alt={product.name}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center"
              />
              {product.tag && (
                <span className="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-[#E50914] text-white text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-1 rounded">
                  {product.tag}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Thumbnails Row */}
            {product.images.length > 1 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
                {product.images.map((img, idx) => (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedImage(idx)}
                    className={`relative w-16 h-16 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 transition-all shrink-0 ${
                      selectedImage === idx
                        ? 'border-[#E50914] scale-105'
                        : 'border-zinc-800 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <img src={img} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Model & Origin Notice */}
            <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-zinc-800/80 text-xs text-zinc-400 space-y-1">
              <p><strong className="text-zinc-300">Caimento:</strong> {product.details.modelInfo}</p>
              <p><strong className="text-zinc-300">Origem:</strong> {product.details.origin}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Column: Information, Variant Pickers & Actions */}
          <div className="p-6 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6 max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
            
            {/* Header info */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 font-bold mb-1">
                <span className="text-[#E50914]">{product.category}</span>
                <span>/</span>
                <span>{product.subcategory}</span>
                <span>/</span>
                <span>SKU: {product.integration.sku}</span>
              </div>

              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white font-display leading-tight">
                {product.name}
              </h2>

              {/* Price & Installments */}
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-baseline gap-3">
                <span className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">
                  R$ {product.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                </span>
                {product.originalPrice > product.price && (
                  <span className="text-sm text-zinc-500 line-through tabular-nums">
                    R$ {product.originalPrice.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                  </span>
                )}
                <span className="text-xs text-green-400 font-bold bg-green-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-green-800/60">
                  5% OFF no PIX
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1">
                ou em até <strong className="text-zinc-200">6x de R$ {installments}</strong> sem juros no cartão
              </p>

              {/* Stock Indicator & Out of Stock Automatic Renewal Notice */}
              <div className="mt-3">
                {isOutOfStock ? (
                  <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-red-950/40 border border-red-800/60 text-xs space-y-1.5 shadow-md">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#E50914] font-black uppercase tracking-wider font-oswald text-sm">
                      <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                      <span>PRODUTO ESGOTADO / SEM ESTOQUE</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed text-[11px]">
                      Esta peça está sem estoque no momento. Assim que novas unidades forem repostas, ela ficará disponível para compra novamente aqui na loja.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                    <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${product.stockCount <= 4 ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-green-500'}`} />
                    <span className="text-zinc-300 font-medium">
                      {product.stockCount <= 4
                        ? `Apenas ${product.stockCount} unidades restantes no estoque!`
                        : `Estoque disponível para envio imediato.`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Description (100% clean of <p>, <br> and HTML tags) */}
            <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed border-t border-zinc-800/80 pt-3 whitespace-pre-line">
              {cleanDescription(product.description)}
            </div>

            {/* Size Selector: Smart handling for unique sizes (accessories, sunglasses, etc.) vs clothing/shoes */}
            {isUniqueSize ? (
              <div className="space-y-1.5 border-t border-zinc-800/80 pt-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-300">
                    Tamanho:
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded tracking-wide uppercase">
                    {product.category === 'acessorios' ? 'Acessório // Tamanho Único' : 'Tamanho Único'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-xs">
                  <span>{product.sizes[0] || 'Tamanho Único'}</span>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-zinc-800/80 pt-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-200">
                    Tamanho: <strong className="text-white">{selectedSize}</strong>
                  </span>
                  {product.category === 'roupas' && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowSizeGuide(!showSizeGuide)}
                      className="text-xs text-[#E50914] hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Ruler className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Guia de Medidas</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Sizes Buttons */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {product.sizes.map((sz) => (
                    <button
                      key={sz}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedSize(sz)}
                      className={`px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        selectedSize === sz
                          ? 'bg-[#E50914] text-white border-[#E50914] shadow-md shadow-red-950/60'
                          : 'bg-[#181818] text-zinc-300 border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500'
                      }`}

                      {sz}

                <AnimatePresence>

                      initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      className="overflow-hidden bg-[#181818] border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs space-y-2"
                    >
                      <p className="font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Tabela de Medidas (Centímetros)</p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400 border-t border-zinc-800 pt-2">
                        <span className="font-bold text-zinc-300">Tamanho</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-zinc-300">Tórax</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-zinc-300">Comp.</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-zinc-300">Manga</span>
                        <span>P</span><span>58 cm</span><span>72 cm</span><span>24 cm</span>
                        <span>M</span><span>60 cm</span><span>74 cm</span><span>25 cm</span>
                        <span>G</span><span>63 cm</span><span>77 cm</span><span>26 cm</span>
                        <span>GG</span><span>66 cm</span><span>80 cm</span><span>27 cm</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 italic">
                        *Modelagem Streetwear Boxy (ombros caídos e tronco reto).
                      </p>
                    </motion.div>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Color Selector: Smart handling for single color vs multi-color pieces */}
            {isSingleColor ? (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-300">
                    Cor:
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded tracking-wide uppercase">
                    {product.colors[0]?.name === 'Cor Única' ? 'Modelo Exclusivo' : 'Cor Única'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-medium text-white shadow-xs">
                  <span
                    className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border border-zinc-600 shrink-0"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: product.colors[0]?.hex || '#1C1C1C' }}
                  />
                  <span className="font-semibold">{product.colors[0]?.name || 'Cor Única'}</span>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-200 block">
                  Cor: <strong className="text-white">{selectedColor}</strong>
                </span>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                  {product.colors.map((c) => (
                    <button
                      key={c.name}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedColor(c.name)}
                      title={c.name}
                      className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                        selectedColor === c.name
                          ? 'border-[#E50914] bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow-sm shadow-red-950/40'
                          : 'border-zinc-800 bg-[#161616] text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:border-zinc-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span
                        className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border border-zinc-600 shrink-0"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: c.hex }}
                      />
                      <span>{c.name}</span>
                      {selectedColor === c.name && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#E50914]" />}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Quantity Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-200">
                Quantidade:
              </span>
              <div className={`flex items-center bg-[#181818] border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden ${isOutOfStock ? 'opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed' : ''}`}>
                <button
                  disabled={isOutOfStock}
                  onClick={() => setQuantity(Math.max(1, quantity - 1))}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  -
                </button>
                <span className="px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                  {isOutOfStock ? 0 : quantity}
                </span>
                <button
                  disabled={isOutOfStock}
                  onClick={() => setQuantity(Math.min(product.stockCount, quantity + 1))}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  +
                </button>
              </div>
              {isOutOfStock && (
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-red-400 uppercase tracking-wide">
                  0 no estoque
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Frete Simulator */}
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#161616] border border-zinc-800 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 uppercase">
                  <Truck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#E50914]" />
                  <span>Calcular Frete e Prazo</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">Ex: 35900-000</span>
              </div>
              <form onSubmit={handleSimulateShipping} className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  maxLength={9}
                  value={cep}
                  onChange={(e) => setCep(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))}
                  placeholder="Digite seu CEP"
                  className="flex-1 bg-black/60 border border-zinc-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914]"
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={shippingLoading}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {shippingLoading ? 'Calculando...' : 'Calcular'}
                </button>
              </form>

              {shippingCalculated && (
                <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800 text-[11px]">
                  {shippingOptions.length > 0 ? (
                    shippingOptions.slice(0, 4).map((opt) => (
                      <div key={opt.id} className="flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-300 py-0.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          {opt.company?.picture && (
                            <img src={opt.company.picture} alt={opt.company.name} className="w-3.5 h-3.5 object-contain" />
                          )}
                          <span className="font-medium text-white">{opt.company?.name} {opt.name}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">({opt.deliveryText})</span>
                        </div>
                        <strong className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{opt.priceFormatted}</strong>
                      </div>
                    ))
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-300">
                        <span>Sedex Expresso (1 a 2 dias úteis)</span>
                        <strong className="text-white">R$ 18,90</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-zinc-300">
                        <span>Correios PAC (3 a 5 dias úteis)</span>
                        <strong className="text-emerald-400">R$ 12,50</strong>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}

=== ARQUIVO: src\components\SearchBar.tsx ===
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Search, X, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Product } from '../types';

interface SearchBarProps {
  products: Product[];
  onSelectProduct: (product: Product) => void;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function SearchBar({ products, onSelectProduct, isOpen, onClose }: SearchBarProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
    } else {
      setQuery('');
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const filtered = query.trim() === '' ? [] : products.filter(p => 
    p.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
    p.subcategory.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
    p.category.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
    p.description.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
  ).slice(0, 5);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-20 px-4">
      <div 
        className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-[#141414] border border-[#262626] rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center px-4 py-3 border-b border-[#262626] gap-3">
          <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="text"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Buscar por moletom, cargo, sneaker, boné..."
            className="w-full bg-transparent text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none text-base font-medium"
          />
          {query && (
            <button 
              onClick={() => setQuery('')}
              className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-white p-1"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 hover:text-[#E50914] px-2 py-1 font-bold"
          >
            Fechar
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Instant Search Results */}
        <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto p-2">
          {query.trim() === '' ? (
            <div className="p-6 text-center text-zinc-500 text-sm">
              <p className="font-semibold text-zinc-400 mb-1">Sugestões rápidas de busca:</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center mt-3">
                {['Moletom Oversized', 'Calça Cargo', 'Sneaker Retro', 'Snapback', 'Shoulder Bag'].map(tag => (
                  <button
                    key={tag}
                    onClick={() => setQuery(tag)}
                    className="px-3 py-1 text-xs bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:bg-[#2A2A2A] text-zinc-300 rounded-md transition-colors"
                  >
                    {tag}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-zinc-400 text-sm">
              Nenhum produto encontrado para "<span className="text-white font-medium">{query}</span>".
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">
                Produtos Encontrados ({filtered.length})
              </div>
              {filtered.map(product => (
                <button
                  key={product.id}
                  onClick={() => {
                    onSelectProduct(product);
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-[#1E1E1E] transition-colors text-left group"
                >
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                    <img 
                      src={product.images[0]} 
                      alt={product.name} 
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-white truncate group-hover:text-[#E50914] transition-colors">
                      {product.name}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 capitalize">
                      {product.subcategory} · Estoque: {product.stockCount} un
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                      R$ {product.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                    </p>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">ou 6x s/ juros</span>
                  </div>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-500 group-hover:text-white transition-colors" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

        if (isMounted) {

        console.warn('Could not load reviews from Firestore:', err);

        if (isMounted) setIsLoadingReviews(false);

                {displayedReviews.map((rev, idx) => (
                  <motion.div
                    key={rev.id || `rev-${idx}`}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
                    whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    viewport={{ once: true }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.35, delay: Math.min(idx * 0.04, 0.3) }}
                    className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#121212] border border-[#222222] hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors space-y-3 shadow-md"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-red-950/80 border border-red-700/60 text-[#E50914] text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                          {rev.avatarText || 'CS'}
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate leading-none">{rev.name}</p>
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5 truncate">
                            <MapPin className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-[#E50914] shrink-0" /> {rev.city}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Crowns Rating */}
                      <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" title={`${rev.rating} Coroas`}>
                          {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
                            <Crown
                              key={i}
                              className={`w-3 h-3 ${
                                i < rev.rating
                                  ? 'text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_5px_rgba(250,204,21,0.5)]'
                                  : 'text-zinc-700'
                              }`}
                            />
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">{rev.date}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Foto do Cliente se houver */}
                    {rev.photoUrl && (
                      <div 
                        onClick={() => setSelectedPhoto(rev.photoUrl || null)}
                        className="relative h-44 w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black border border-zinc-800 cursor-pointer group/photo shadow-inner"
                      >
                        <img
                          src={rev.photoUrl}
                          alt={`Foto enviada por ${rev.name}`}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover/photo:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
                          loading="lazy"
                        />
                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover/photo:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-white text-xs font-bold">
                          <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>Ampliar Foto</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black text-red-400 border border-red-950/60 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Camera className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                          <span>FOTO REAL DO CLIENTE</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed italic">
                      "{rev.comment}"
                    </p>

                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate pr-2">
                        <Tag className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">Peça: <strong className="text-zinc-300">{rev.productName}</strong></span>
                      </div>

                      {rev.verifiedPurchase && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-400 font-semibold shrink-0">
                          <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>Comprador Verificado</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Quick button at bottom of reviews */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
              className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 bg-[#121212] hover:bg-[#181818] text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-[#E50914]" />
              <span>Já comprou na Street Store? Envie seu Feedback</span>
            </button>
          </motion.div>

        </div>

      </div>

      {/* MODAL: Enviar Depoimento com Coroas + Foto */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isModalOpen && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm overflow-y-auto">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 20 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
              className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[#121212] border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-6"
            >
              {/* Modal Header */}
              <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 bg-[#161616] border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#E50914] font-oswald">
                    <Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400" />
                    <span>AVALIAÇÃO EM COROAS // COMUNIDADE</span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-extrabold text-white uppercase font-display mt-0.5">
                    Deixar Minha Avaliação
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
                  className="p-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  aria-label="Fechar modal"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Modal Body / Form */}
              <form onSubmit={handleSubmitReview} className="p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
                
                {/* Success Banner */}
                {submitSuccess && (
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/50 flex items-center gap-3 text-emerald-300">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Avaliação Salva com Sucesso!</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-400/90 mt-0.5">
                        Seu feedback com coroas já está visível para toda a comunidade.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Error Banner */}
                {errorMessage && (
                  <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-red-950/50 border border-red-500/40 text-red-200 text-xs">
                    {errorMessage}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Crown Rating Picker (Substituindo Estrelas por Coroas) */}

                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Sua Avaliação em Coroas <span className="text-[#E50914]">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#181818] px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800">
                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((crownNum) => {
                        const active = (hoverRating || rating) >= crownNum;
                        return (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            key={crownNum}
                            onClick={() => setRating(crownNum)}
                            onMouseEnter={() => setHoverRating(crownNum)}
                            onMouseLeave={() => setHoverRating(0)}
                            className="p-1 text-zinc-600 hover:text-yellow-400 transition-transform active:scale-90 cursor-pointer"
                            aria-label={`${crownNum} Coroas`}

                            <Crown
                              className={`w-6 h-6 transition-all ${
                                active 
                                  ? 'text-yellow-400 fill-yellow-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(250,204,21,0.6)] scale-110' 
                                  : 'text-zinc-700'
                              }`}
                            />
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs text-zinc-300 font-medium ml-1">
                      {ratingDescriptions[hoverRating || rating]}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                      Seu Nome ou Apelido <span className="text-[#E50914]">*</span>
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={name}
                      onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Ex: Matheus Ribeiro"

                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                      Cidade / Estado
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={city}
                      onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Ex: Itabira - MG"
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#181818] border border-zinc-800 text-white placeholder-zinc-500 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914] transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Product Select (Real Site Drops) */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                    Peça ou Drop que você comprou
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={productName}
                    onChange={(e) => setProductName(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#181818] border border-zinc-800 text-white text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {DEFAULT_REVIEWS.map((r) => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.productName} className="bg-[#181818] text-white">
                        {r.productName}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                    {PRODUCTS.slice(0, 10).map((p) => (
                      <option key={p.id} value={p.name} className="bg-[#181818] text-white">
                        {p.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                    <option value="custom" className="bg-[#181818] text-white">
                      + Outra peça ou look da Street Store...
                    </option>
                  </select>

                  {productName === 'custom' && (

                      type="text"
                      value={customProduct}
                      onChange={(e) => setCustomProduct(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Qual peça você comprou?"
                      className="mt-2 w-full px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#181818] border border-zinc-800 text-white placeholder-zinc-500 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914]"
                    />
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Photo Upload Area */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Foto Real da Peça no Corpo / Look
                    </label>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Opcional</span>
                  </div>

                  <input
                    ref={fileInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    onChange={handlePhotoSelect}
                    className="hidden"
                  />

                  {photoPreview ? (
                    <div className="relative aspect-video sm:aspect-2/1 w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-700 bg-black group">
                      <img
                        src={photoPreview}
                        alt="Preview da sua foto"
                        className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={handleRemovePhoto}
                        className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
                        title="Remover foto"
                      >
                        <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div
                      onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                      className="border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-600 rounded-xl p-4 text-center cursor-pointer transition-colors bg-[#161616]/60 hover:bg-[#181818]"
                    >
                      <Upload className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-400 mx-auto mb-1.5" />
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                        Clique para anexar foto do seu look
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                        JPG, PNG ou WEBP da sua câmera ou galeria
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Review Text */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                    Seu Comentário / Relato <span className="text-[#E50914]">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    required
                    value={comment}
                    onChange={(e) => setComment(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Conta o que achou da modelagem, densidade do tecido, caimento e entrega..."
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#181818] border border-zinc-800 text-white placeholder-zinc-500 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E50914] transition-colors resize-none"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Submit Action */}
                <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-800">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Cancelar
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={isSubmitting || submitSuccess}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#E50914] hover:bg-red-700 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all shadow-lg shadow-red-950/40 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {isSubmitting ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                        <span>Publicando...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>Publicar Avaliação</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* LIGHTBOX: Zoom na Foto */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {selectedPhoto && (
          <div 
            onClick={() => setSelectedPhoto(null)}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 bg-black/92 backdrop-blur-md cursor-zoom-out"
          >
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92 }}
              className="relative max-w-3xl max-h-[90vh] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-800 bg-[#0E0E0E] shadow-2xl"
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
              <img
                src={selectedPhoto}
                alt="Foto ampliada"
                className="w-full h-full max-h-[82vh] object-contain"
              />
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedPhoto(null)}
                className="absolute top-3 right-3 p-2 rounded-xl bg-black/80 text-white hover:bg-[#E50914] transition-colors shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Fechar foto"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </section>
  );
}

  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'tees') return railItems.filter(i => i.kind === 'tee');
    if (activeTab === 'hoodies') return railItems.filter(i => i.kind === 'hoodie' || i.kind === 'jacket');
    if (activeTab === 'sneakers') return railItems.filter(i => i.id.includes('tesla'));
    return railItems;
  }, [railItems, activeTab]);

  const handleAction = (item: typeof railItems[0]) => {
    if (item.originalProduct) {
      onOpenProduct(item.originalProduct);
    } else {
      // Find matching or closest catalog product or open catalog search
      const fallback = products.find(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(item.name.toLowerCase().split(' ')[1])) || products[0];
      if (fallback) {
        onOpenProduct(fallback);
      } else {
        onExploreCatalog();
      }
    }
  };

  const handleQuickBuy = (item: typeof railItems[0]) => {
    if (item.originalProduct) {
      onQuickAdd(item.originalProduct);
    } else if (products.length > 0) {
      onQuickAdd(products[0]);
    }
    setAddedNotice(`${item.name} adicionado ao carrinho!`);
    setTimeout(() => setAddedNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  return (
    <section className="relative w-full border-t border-b border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-950 py-16 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Background ambient glow */}
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 -z-10">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[700px] h-[350px] bg-red-600/10 rounded-full blur-[140px]" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-10 right-10 w-96 h-96 bg-amber-500/5 rounded-full blur-[120px]" />
      </div>

      {/* Street Store Title Header */}
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 text-center mb-8">
        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-red-950/70 border border-red-600/40 text-red-400 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-widest uppercase mb-3">
          <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-pulse text-red-400" />
          <span>Experiência Interativa 3D · Street Store Itabira</span>
        </div>

        <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white font-bebas">
          NOVIDADES <span className="text-red-500">NA STREET</span>
        </h2>

        <p className="max-w-2xl mx-auto mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
          Passe o mouse ou deslize o dedo para afastar os cabides na arara. Clique em qualquer peça para abrir a visualização 360°, ver a modelagem e a estampa das costas.
        </p>

        {/* Interactive Tabs */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 mt-6">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('all')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'all'
                ? 'bg-red-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 ring-2 ring-red-500'
                : 'bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800'
            }`}
          >
            🔥 Todos os Drops ({railItems.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('tees')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'tees'
                ? 'bg-red-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 ring-2 ring-red-500'
                : 'bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800'
            }`}
          >
            👕 Camisetas & Oversized
          </button>
          {railItems.some(i => i.kind === 'hoodie' || i.kind === 'jacket') && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('hoodies')}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'hoodies'
                  ? 'bg-red-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 ring-2 ring-red-500'
                  : 'bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800'
              }`}
            >
              🧥 Moletons & Jaquetas
            </button>
          )}
          {railItems.some(i => i.id.includes('tesla')) && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('sneakers')}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'sneakers'
                  ? 'bg-red-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 ring-2 ring-red-500'
                  : 'bg-zinc-900/90 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white border border-zinc-800'
              }`}
            >
              👟 Sneakers Tesla
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Added to cart toast notice */}
      {addedNotice && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-500/50 text-emerald-100 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-5">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold">{addedNotice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* The Clothing Rail Hero Component with Street Store identity */}
      <div className="w-full relative">
        <ClothingRailHero
          items={filteredItems}
          hanger="wood"
          autoplay={false}
          labels={{
            front: "Frente",
            back: "Costas",
            close: "Fechar ✕",
            show: "Ver Peça"
          }}
          caption="Toque ou arraste qualquer cabide para escolher sua peça"
          action={
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3 mt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onExploreCatalog}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-red-600 px-6 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 transition-all hover:bg-red-500 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4" />
                Explorar Catálogo Completo
                <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          }
        />
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Hint Banner */}
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 mt-8">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RotateCw className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500 animate-spin [animation-duration:8s]" />
            <span>
              <strong>Dica de Interação:</strong> Arraste o mouse horizontalmente para simular o deslize físico dos cabides na loja física de Itabira.
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onExploreCatalog}
            className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 font-bold underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            Ver mais de 300 produtos no catálogo &rarr;
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

export default StreetwearRailSection;

// Deduplicate fallback PRODUCTS using user rule: repeated items add to canonical stockCount
const consolidatedFallbackMap = new Map<string, Product>();
[...BLING_STOCK_PRODUCTS, ...LOCAL_PRODUCTS].forEach((item) => {
  const normKey = item.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!consolidatedFallbackMap.has(normKey)) {
    consolidatedFallbackMap.set(normKey, { ...item, sizes: [...item.sizes], colors: [...item.colors], images: [...item.images] });
  } else {
    const canonical = consolidatedFallbackMap.get(normKey)!;
    canonical.stockCount += item.stockCount;
    item.sizes.forEach((s) => {
      if (!canonical.sizes.includes(s)) canonical.sizes.push(s);
    });
    item.colors.forEach((c) => {
      if (!canonical.colors.some((ex) => ex.name === c.name)) canonical.colors.push(c);
    });
  }
});

export const PRODUCTS: Product[] = filterVisibleProducts(Array.from(consolidatedFallbackMap.values()));

=== ARQUIVO: src\lib\cleanHtml.ts ===
/**
 * Utility to strip and clean HTML tags and entities from product descriptions.
 * Handles <p>, <br>, <div>, <span>, HTML entities, and formatting.
 */
export function cleanDescription(raw?: string): string {
  if (!raw) return '';
  let text = String(raw);

  // Unescape HTML entities first in case tags were encoded
  text = text
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, '&');

  // Replace block tags with paragraph / line breaks
  text = text
    .replace(/<\/p>/gi, '\n\n')
    .replace(/<p[^>]*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<\/div>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<div[^>]*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<\/li>/gi, '\n')
    .replace(/<li[^>]*>/gi, '• ')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '') // Strip all remaining tags (e.g. <span>, <strong>, <b>, <i>, <a>)
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/&[a-zA-Z0-9#]+;/g, ' ') // Strip other unknown html entities safely
    .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();

  return text;
}

import { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { getAuth } from 'firebase/auth';
import { getFirestore, doc, getDocFromServer } from 'firebase/firestore';
import firebaseConfig from '../../firebase-applet-config.json';

// Initialize Firebase App singleton
const app = getApps().length === 0 ? initializeApp(firebaseConfig) : getApp();

// Initialize Firebase Authentication
export const auth = getAuth(app);

// CRITICAL: Initialize Firestore using the specific provisioned database ID
export const db = getFirestore(app, firebaseConfig.firestoreDatabaseId);

// Test server connectivity on startup as mandated by Firestore guidelines
async function testConnection() {
  try {
    await getDocFromServer(doc(db, 'test', 'connection'));
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('the client is offline')) {
      console.warn('Firebase client is offline. Please verify connectivity.');
    }
  }
}
testConnection();

export enum OperationType {
  CREATE = 'create',
  UPDATE = 'update',
  DELETE = 'delete',
  LIST = 'list',
  GET = 'get',
  WRITE = 'write',
}

export interface FirestoreErrorInfo {
  error: string;
  operationType: OperationType;
  path: string | null;
  authInfo: {
    userId?: string | null;
    email?: string | null;
  };
}

export function handleFirestoreError(error: unknown, operationType: OperationType, path: string | null): never {
  const errInfo: FirestoreErrorInfo = {
    error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
    authInfo: {
      userId: auth.currentUser?.uid ?? null,
      email: auth.currentUser?.email ?? null,
    },
    operationType,
    path,
  };
  console.error('Firestore Error:', JSON.stringify(errInfo));
  throw new Error(JSON.stringify(errInfo));
}


=== ARQUIVO: src\lib\hiddenProducts.ts ===
import { Product } from '../types';

/**
 * List of products hidden from the storefront per user directive:
 * 1. CAMISETA CHRONIC\TRIPSIDE ORIGINAIS
 * 2. CSM500
 * 3. CAMISETA STREET MULTIMARCAS
 * 4. hock montreal
 * 5. bone aba curva
 * 6. shoulder bag
 * 7. oculos miragem
 * 8. BERMUDA CARPINTEIRO TRIP SIDE
 * 9. BERMUDA TRIP SIDE RAIO
 * 10. Boné tripside e chronic
 * 11. Carteira
 */
export function isProductHidden(product: Partial<Product> | any): boolean {
  if (!product) return false;

  // Automatically hide any out-of-stock product from the site
  if (typeof product.stockCount === 'number' && product.stockCount <= 0) {
    return true;
  }
  if (typeof product.stock === 'number' && product.stock <= 0 && product.stockCount === undefined) {
    return true;
  }
  if (String(product.tag || '').toUpperCase().trim() === 'SEM ESTOQUE') {
    return true;
  }

  const rawName = String(product.name || '').toLowerCase();
  const rawSku = String(product.integration?.sku || product.sku || '').toLowerCase();
  const rawDesc = String(product.description || '').toLowerCase();
  const rawSubcat = String(product.subcategory || '').toLowerCase();

  const variantSkus = Array.isArray(product.variantsList)
    ? product.variantsList.map((v: any) => String(v.sku || '').toLowerCase()).join(' ')
    : '';

  const fullText = `${rawName} ${rawSku} ${rawDesc} ${variantSkus}`;

  // 1. CAMISETA CHRONIC\TRIPSIDE ORIGINAIS
  if (
    (rawName.includes('chronic') && rawName.includes('tripside') && (rawName.includes('origina') || rawName.includes('camiseta'))) ||
    fullText.includes('cco500')
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 2. CSM500 & 3. CAMISETA STREET MULTIMARCAS
  if (
    fullText.includes('csm500') ||
    rawName.includes('street multimarca') ||
    rawName.includes('street multimarcas')
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 4. hock montreal (Hocks Montreal)
  if (
    (rawName.includes('hock') || rawName.includes('hocks')) &&
    rawName.includes('montreal')
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 5. bone aba curva
  if (
    (rawName.includes('bone') || rawName.includes('boné')) &&
    rawName.includes('aba curva')
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 6. shoulder bag (all shoulder bags)
  if (
    rawName.includes('shoulder bag') ||
    rawName.includes('sholder bag') ||
    rawName.includes('shoulder') ||
    rawName.includes('sholder') ||
    rawSku.startsWith('sb') ||
    (rawSubcat === 'bags' && (rawName.includes('shoulder') || rawName.includes('sholder')))
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 7. oculos miragem (OCULOS DE SOL MIRAGE / OSM100)
  if (
    rawName.includes('mirage') ||
    rawName.includes('miragem') ||
    fullText.includes('osm100')
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 8. BERMUDA CARPINTEIRO TRIP SIDE
  if (
    rawName.includes('bermuda') &&
    rawName.includes('carpinteiro') &&
    (rawName.includes('trip side') || rawName.includes('tripside'))
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 9. BERMUDA TRIP SIDE RAIO
  if (
    rawName.includes('bermuda') &&
    rawName.includes('raio') &&
    (rawName.includes('trip side') || rawName.includes('tripside'))
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 10. Boné tripside e chronic (all caps from Trip Side and Chronic)
  if (
    (rawName.includes('bone') || rawName.includes('boné')) &&
    (rawName.includes('trip side') || rawName.includes('tripside') || rawName.includes('chronic'))
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // 11. Carteira (all wallets)
  if (
    rawName.includes('carteira') ||
    rawSku.startsWith('ctl') ||
    rawSku.startsWith('clv') ||
    rawSku.startsWith('cg') ||
    rawSku.startsWith('cap100')
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

export function filterVisibleProducts<T = Product>(products: T[]): T[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(products)) return [];
  return products.filter((p) => !isProductHidden(p));
}

export function formatPhoneBr(value: string): string {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
  if (digits.length > 10) {
    return `(${digits.slice(0, 2)}) ${digits.slice(2, 7)}-${digits.slice(7)}`;
  }
  if (digits.length > 6) {
    return `(${digits.slice(0, 2)}) ${digits.slice(2, 6)}-${digits.slice(6)}`;
  }
  if (digits.length > 2) {
    return `(${digits.slice(0, 2)}) ${digits.slice(2)}`;
  }
  return digits;
}

function translateFirebaseAuthError(error: unknown): string {
  const code = (error as { code?: string })?.code || '';
  const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);

  if (code === 'auth/email-already-in-use') {
    return 'Este e-mail já está cadastrado. Clique em "Entrar" para acessar sua conta.';
  }
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-email') {
    return 'Informe um endereço de e-mail válido.';
  }
  if (code === 'auth/weak-password') {
    return 'A senha deve ter pelo menos 6 caracteres.';
  }
  if (
    code === 'auth/invalid-credential' ||
    code === 'auth/wrong-password' ||
    code === 'auth/user-not-found'
  ) {
    return 'E-mail ou senha incorretos. Confira seus dados e tente novamente.';
  }
  if (code === 'auth/too-many-requests') {
    return 'Muitas tentativas seguidas. Aguarde alguns instantes e tente novamente.';
  }
  if (code === 'auth/operation-not-allowed') {
    return 'O login por E-mail e Senha ainda não foi ativado no Firebase Console deste projeto.';
  }
  if (code === 'auth/network-request-failed') {
    return 'Falha de conexão com a internet. Verifique sua rede e tente novamente.';
  }

  return msg || 'Não foi possível concluir a autenticação. Tente novamente.';
}

async function fetchOrBuildProfile(user: User): Promise<CustomerProfile> {
  const path = `users/${user.uid}`;
  try {
    const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.uid));
    if (snap.exists()) {
      const data = snap.data();
      return {
        uid: user.uid,
        name: String(data.name || user.displayName || 'Cliente Street Store'),
        email: String(data.email || user.email || ''),
        phone: String(data.phone || ''),
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[auth] Aviso ao ler perfil em Firestore:', error);
  }

  return {
    uid: user.uid,
    name: user.displayName || 'Cliente Street Store',
    email: user.email || '',
    phone: '',
  };
}

export async function registerCustomer(
  input: RegisterCustomerInput
): Promise<CustomerProfile> {
  const cleanName = input.name.trim();
  const cleanEmail = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const phoneDigits = input.phone.replace(/\D/g, '');
  const formattedPhone = formatPhoneBr(phoneDigits);
  const password = input.password;

  if (cleanName.length < 2 || cleanName.length > 80) {
    throw new Error('Informe seu nome completo (mínimo 2 caracteres).');
  }
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
    throw new Error('Informe um e-mail válido.');
  }
  if (phoneDigits.length < 10 || phoneDigits.length > 11) {
    throw new Error('Informe um telefone/WhatsApp válido com DDD (ex: (31) 98480-6556).');
  }
  if (password.length < 6) {
    throw new Error('Crie uma senha com pelo menos 6 caracteres.');
  }

  let credential;
  try {
    credential = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, cleanEmail, password);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(translateFirebaseAuthError(error));
  }

  const user = credential.user;

  try {
    await updateProfile(user, { displayName: cleanName });
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking fallback if displayName update fails
  }

  const path = `users/${user.uid}`;
  try {
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.uid), {
      uid: user.uid,
      name: cleanName,
      email: cleanEmail,
      phone: formattedPhone,
      createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
      updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    handleFirestoreError(error, OperationType.CREATE, path);
  }

  return {
    uid: user.uid,
    name: cleanName,
    email: cleanEmail,
    phone: formattedPhone,
  };
}

export async function loginCustomer(
  input: LoginCustomerInput
): Promise<CustomerProfile> {
  const cleanEmail = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = input.password;

  if (!cleanEmail.includes('@')) {
    throw new Error('Informe um e-mail válido.');
  }
  if (!password) {
    throw new Error('Informe sua senha.');
  }

  let credential;
  try {
    credential = await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, cleanEmail, password);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(translateFirebaseAuthError(error));
  }

  return fetchOrBuildProfile(credential.user);
}

export async function logoutCustomer(): Promise<void> {
  await signOut(auth);
}

export function subscribeToCustomerAuth(
  onChange: (profile: CustomerProfile | null) => void
): () => void {
  return onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
    if (!user) {
      onChange(null);
      return;
    }
    const profile = await fetchOrBuildProfile(user);
    onChange(profile);
  });
}

/**
 * Fetch live products from Bling ERP & official store catalog via backend proxy
 */
export async function getLiveCatalog(forceRefresh: boolean = false): Promise<{
  products: Product[];
  isLive: boolean;
  statusText: string;
  blingConnected?: boolean;
  blingCount?: number;
  blingError?: string | null;
}> {
  try {
    const url = forceRefresh
      ? `/api/catalog/products?refresh=true&_t=${Date.now()}`
      : '/api/catalog/products';

    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        'Accept': 'application/json'
      }
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Servidor respondeu com status ${res.status}`);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success && Array.isArray(data.products) && data.products.length > 0) {
      const rawList: Product[] = data.products.map((p: Product) => ({
        ...p,
        description: cleanDescription(p.description),
      }));
      const sanitizedProducts = filterVisibleProducts<Product>(rawList);
      return {
        products: sanitizedProducts,
        isLive: true,
        blingConnected: Boolean(data.blingConnected),
        blingCount: Number(data.blingCount || 0),
        blingError: data.blingError || null,
        statusText: `Catálogo Oficial Ativo (${sanitizedProducts.length} peças em estoque)`,
      };
    }

    return {
      products: filterVisibleProducts(FALLBACK_PRODUCTS),
      isLive: false,
      blingConnected: false,
      blingCount: 0,
      blingError: data.blingError || null,
      statusText: 'Catálogo de Drops Street Store Oficial',
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Usando catálogo local de reserva:', error);
    return {
      products: filterVisibleProducts(FALLBACK_PRODUCTS),
      isLive: false,
      blingConnected: false,
      blingCount: 0,
      blingError: null,
      statusText: 'Catálogo de Drops Street Store Oficial',
    };
  }
}
