      const currentTokens = loadBlingTokens();
      const hasRemote = hasFirebaseAdminEnv() ? await hasFirestoreBlingToken() : false;
      if (currentTokens?.refresh_token || hasRemote) {
        console.log('[Bling Interceptor] 401 recebido. Forçando renovação automática via refresh_token...');
        try {
          const refreshed = await refreshBlingToken({ force: true, failedAccessToken: token });
          const retryRes = await fetch(url, {
            ...options,
            headers: {
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${refreshed.access_token}`,
              'Accept': 'application/json',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'User-Agent': 'StreetStore/1.0',
              ...(options.headers || {})
            }
          });
          if (retryRes.ok) {
            lastVerifiedAuth = { token: refreshed.access_token, valid: true, checkedAt: Date.now() };
            return retryRes.json();
          }
          if (retryRes.status === 401) {
            const msg = 'Token do Bling inválido ou expirado (401). Por favor, reconecte via OAuth.';
            lastVerifiedAuth = { token: refreshed.access_token, valid: false, error: msg, checkedAt: Date.now() };
            if (!hasRemote) clearBlingTokens();
            throw new Error(msg);
          }
        } catch (refreshErr: any) {
          const errDetail = refreshErr?.message || String(refreshErr);
          const msg = 'Sessão do Bling expirada ou inválida (401). Por favor, reconecte via OAuth.';
          console.warn('[Bling] Tentativa de renovação pós-401 falhou:', errDetail);
          lastVerifiedAuth = { token, valid: false, error: msg, checkedAt: Date.now() };
          if (!hasRemote) clearBlingTokens();
          throw new Error(msg);
        }
      } else {
        const msg = 'Token do Bling inválido ou expirado (401). Por favor, autorize novamente via OAuth.';
        console.warn('[Bling] 401 recebido e não há refresh_token. Limpando cache.');
        lastVerifiedAuth = { token, valid: false, error: msg, checkedAt: Date.now() };
        clearBlingTokens();
        throw new Error(msg);
      }
    }
    throw new Error(`Bling API [${res.status}]: ${errorText}`);
  }

  lastVerifiedAuth = { token, valid: true, checkedAt: Date.now() };
  return res.json();
}

/**
 * Register all Bling ERP routes on the Express app
 */
export function registerBlingRoutes(app: express.Express, hooks?: { onTokensUpdated?: () => void }) {
  const { clientId, state } = getClientCredentials();

  function resolveAppUrl(req: Request): string {
    const envUrl = process.env.APP_URL;
    if (envUrl) return envUrl.replace(/\/$/, '');
    const proto = (req.headers['x-forwarded-proto'] as string) || req.protocol || 'https';
    const host = (req.headers['x-forwarded-host'] as string) || req.headers.host || req.get('host');
    return `${proto}://${host}`.replace(/\/$/, '');
  }

  // 1. Get OAuth Authorization URL & Status Info
  app.get('/api/bling/auth-url', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const appUrl = resolveAppUrl(req);
    const redirectUri = `${appUrl}/auth/callback`;

    const authUrlWithoutRedirect = `${BLING_AUTH_BASE}?response_type=code&client_id=${clientId}&state=${state}`;
    const authUrlWithRedirect = `${BLING_AUTH_BASE}?response_type=code&client_id=${clientId}&state=${state}&redirect_uri=${encodeURIComponent(redirectUri)}`;

    res.json({
      url: authUrlWithoutRedirect,
      urlWithRedirect: authUrlWithRedirect,
      redirectUri,
      clientId,
      state
    });
  });

  // Direct 1-click redirect to Bling authorization
  app.get('/api/bling/authorize', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const appUrl = resolveAppUrl(req);
    const redirectUri = `${appUrl}/auth/callback`;
    const authUrl = req.query.strict === 'true'
      ? `${BLING_AUTH_BASE}?response_type=code&client_id=${clientId}&state=${state}&redirect_uri=${encodeURIComponent(redirectUri)}`
      : `${BLING_AUTH_BASE}?response_type=code&client_id=${clientId}&state=${state}`;
    res.redirect(authUrl);
  });

  // Helper to verify a candidate token against Bling API v3 before saving
  async function validateAndSaveToken(rawInput: string, refreshToken?: string, expiresIn: number = 21600, scope: string = '', redirectUri?: string) {
    const trimmed = rawInput.trim();

    // If user pasted a callback URL (?code=...) or explicitly flagged code, exchange it via OAuth
    let extractedCode: string | null = null;
    if (trimmed.includes('code=')) {
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(trimmed.startsWith('http') ? trimmed : `https://dummy.local/?${trimmed.replace(/^\?/, '')}`);
        extractedCode = parsed.searchParams.get('code');
      } catch {
        const m = trimmed.match(/[?&]code=([^&\s]+)/);
        if (m) extractedCode = m[1];
      }
    }

    if (extractedCode) {
      const tokens = await exchangeCodeForTokens(extractedCode, redirectUri);
      clearBlingAuthCache();
      return { tokens, mode: 'code_exchange' as const };
    }

    const candidate: BlingTokens = {
      access_token: trimmed,
      refresh_token: refreshToken ? String(refreshToken).trim() : undefined,
      expires_in: Number(expiresIn) || 21600,
      token_type: 'Bearer',
      scope,
      obtained_at: Date.now()
    };

    // Test the token live on Bling v3 API
    const testRes = await fetch(`${BLING_API_BASE}/produtos?pagina=1&limite=1`, {
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${candidate.access_token}`,
        'Accept': 'application/json'
      }
    });

    if (testRes.ok) {
      saveBlingTokens(candidate);
      lastVerifiedAuth = { token: candidate.access_token, valid: true, checkedAt: Date.now() };
      return { tokens: candidate, mode: 'direct_token' as const };
    }

    // If 401 and input looks like an OAuth authorization code (40 hex chars without refresh_token), try exchanging it as code as fallback
    if (testRes.status === 401 && !refreshToken && /^[a-f0-9]{32,64}$/i.test(trimmed)) {
      try {
        const exchanged = await exchangeCodeForTokens(trimmed);
        clearBlingAuthCache();
        return { tokens: exchanged, mode: 'code_exchange' as const };
      } catch {
        // Fall through to clear invalid token message
      }
    }

    const errText = await testRes.text().catch(() => '');
    clearBlingTokens();
    clearBlingAuthCache();
    throw new Error(`Token rejeitado pelo Bling (${testRes.status}). Gere um novo token clicando em "Autorizar Conexão no Bling ERP (1 Clique)". Detalhe: ${errText.slice(0, 120)}`);
  }

  // Set or update Bling API tokens directly (supports access_token, callback URL with ?code=, or OAuth code)
  app.post('/api/bling/token', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const { access_token, refresh_token, expires_in = 21600, code } = req.body;
      const inputVal = String(code || access_token || '').trim();
      if (!inputVal) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Informe o token de acesso ou link de retorno com ?code= do Bling.' });
      }
      const appUrl = resolveAppUrl(req);
      const { mode } = await validateAndSaveToken(inputVal, refresh_token, Number(expires_in), '', `${appUrl}/auth/callback`);
      hooks?.onTokensUpdated?.();
      res.json({
        success: true,
        mode,
        message: 'Bling ERP validado e conectado com sucesso!'
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Token do Bling inválido ou expirado.'
      });
    }
  });

  // 2. OAuth Callback Route (/bling/callback & /auth/callback - exchanges code for initial tokens & saves to DB)
  app.get(['/bling/callback', '/bling/callback/', '/auth/callback', '/auth/callback/'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const code = req.query.code as string;
    const reqState = req.query.state as string;
    const error = req.query.error as string;

    console.log(`[Bling Callback] Path: ${req.path}, Received code: ${code ? code.slice(0, 8) + '...' : 'none'}, state: ${reqState}, error: ${error}`);

    if (error) {
      return res.send(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
          <head>
            <meta charset="utf-8" />
            <title>Erro de Autenticação Bling</title>
            <style>
              body { background: #0E0E0E; color: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; margin: 0; }
              .card { background: #181818; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; max-width: 480px; text-align: center; }
              h2 { color: #E50914; margin-top: 0; }
              p { color: #888; font-size: 14px; }
              button { background: #E50914; color: #fff; border: 0; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; }
            </style>
          </head>
          <body>
            <div class="card">
              <h2>Falha na Autorização</h2>
              <p>O Bling retornou o seguinte erro: ${error}</p>
              <button onclick="window.close()">Fechar Janela</button>
            </div>
          </body>
        </html>
      `);
    }

    if (!code) {
      return res.send(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
          <head><meta charset="utf-8" /><title>Código não informado</title></head>
          <body style="background:#0E0E0E;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;margin:0;">
            <div style="background:#181818;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:16px;padding:32px;text-align:center;">
              <h3 style="color:#E50914;">Nenhum código de autorização recebido</h3>
              <p style="color:#888;">Por favor, tente autorizar novamente pela Street Store.</p>
              <button onclick="window.close()" style="background:#333;color:#fff;border:0;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;">Fechar</button>
            </div>
          </body>
        </html>
      `);
    }

    try {
      // Exchange authorization code for token using identical APP_URL resolution & matched callback path
      const appUrl = resolveAppUrl(req);
      const callbackPath = req.path.startsWith('/bling/callback') ? '/bling/callback' : '/auth/callback';
      const redirectUri = `${appUrl}${callbackPath}`;

      await exchangeCodeForTokens(code, redirectUri);
      hooks?.onTokensUpdated?.();

      return res.send(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
          <head>
            <meta charset="utf-8" />
            <title>Bling ERP Conectado com Sucesso</title>
            <style>
              body {
                background: #0E0E0E;
                color: #ffffff;
                font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                height: 100vh;
                margin: 0;
              }
              .card {
                background: #141414;
                border: 1px solid #282828;
                border-radius: 16px;
                padding: 40px;
                max-width: 440px;
                text-align: center;
                box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
              }
              .badge {
                display: inline-flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;
                width: 60px;
                height: 60px;
                background: #166534;
                color: #4ade80;
                border-radius: 50%;
                font-size: 28px;
                margin-bottom: 20px;
              }
              h2 {
                font-size: 20px;
                font-weight: 800;
                text-transform: uppercase;
                letter-spacing: 1px;
                margin: 0 0 8px 0;
                color: #fff;
              }
              p {
                color: #9ca3af;
                font-size: 13px;
                line-height: 1.5;
                margin: 0 0 20px 0;
              }
              .status {
                font-size: 11px;
                text-transform: uppercase;
                letter-spacing: 1px;
                color: #22c55e;
                font-weight: 700;
              }
            </style>
          </head>
          <body>
            <div class="card">
              <div class="badge">✓</div>
              <h2>Bling ERP Conectado!</h2>
              <p>Sua conta da Street Store agora está autorizada e sincronizada com o Bling ERP v3.</p>
              <div class="status">Sincronizando dados com o site...</div>
              <script>
                if (window.opener) {
                  window.opener.postMessage({ type: 'OAUTH_AUTH_SUCCESS', provider: 'bling' }, '*');
                  setTimeout(function() {
                    window.close();
                  }, 1200);
                } else {
                  setTimeout(function() {
                    window.location.href = '/';
                  }, 1500);
                }
              </script>
            </div>
          </body>
        </html>
      `);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[Bling Callback Exchange Error]:', err);
      return res.send(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
          <head><meta charset="utf-8" /><title>Erro na troca do token Bling</title></head>
          <body style="background:#0E0E0E;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;margin:0;">
            <div style="background:#181818;border:1px solid #441111;border-radius:16px;padding:32px;max-width:500px;text-align:center;">
              <h3 style="color:#E50914;">Erro ao trocar código por token no Bling</h3>
              <p style="color:#bbb;font-size:13px;">${err.message || String(err)}</p>
              <p style="color:#888;font-size:12px;">Dica: Verifique se a URL de redirecionamento está configurada no app do Bling ou cole o token manualmente no painel.</p>
              <button onclick="window.close()" style="background:#E50914;color:#fff;border:0;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;">Fechar</button>
            </div>
          </body>
        </html>
      `);
    }
  });

  // 3. Manual exchange of code via API
  app.post('/api/bling/exchange-code', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const { code, redirectUri } = req.body;
      if (!code) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Parâmetro code é obrigatório' });
      }
      const tokens = await exchangeCodeForTokens(code, redirectUri);
      hooks?.onTokensUpdated?.();
      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Conectado com sucesso ao Bling ERP!',
        tokens: {
          scope: tokens.scope,
          expires_in: tokens.expires_in,
          obtained_at: tokens.obtained_at
        }
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[API Exchange Error]:', err);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Falha ao trocar código do Bling'
      });
    }
  });

  // 4. Manual set token (direct paste for instant connection)
  app.post('/api/bling/set-token', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const { access_token, refresh_token, expires_in, scope } = req.body;
      if (!access_token) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'access_token é obrigatório' });
      }

      const appUrl = resolveAppUrl(req);
      const { tokens } = await validateAndSaveToken(
        String(access_token),
        refresh_token,
        Number(expires_in) || 21600,
        scope || '',
        `${appUrl}/auth/callback`
      );
      hooks?.onTokensUpdated?.();

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Token do Bling validado e configurado com sucesso!',
        status: {
          connected: true,
          expires_in: tokens.expires_in
        }
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      res.status(401).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
    }
  });

  // 5. Connection Status (verifies token health against Bling API v3 & Firestore)
  app.get('/api/bling/status', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const appUrl = resolveAppUrl(req);
    const redirectUri = `${appUrl}/auth/callback`;
    const authorizeUrl = `${BLING_AUTH_BASE}?response_type=code&client_id=${clientId}&state=${state}`;

    let tokens = loadBlingTokens();
    const fsStatus = hasFirebaseAdminEnv() ? await getBlingTokenStatusFromFirestore() : null;
    if ((!tokens || !tokens.access_token) && fsStatus?.refresh_token) {
      tokens = {
        access_token: fsStatus.access_token || '',
        refresh_token: fsStatus.refresh_token,
        expires_in: fsStatus.expires_in || 21600,
        expires_at: fsStatus.expires_at,
        token_type: fsStatus.token_type || 'Bearer',
        scope: fsStatus.scope || '',
        obtained_at: fsStatus.obtained_at || Date.now(),
      };
    }

    if (!tokens || (!tokens.access_token && !tokens.refresh_token)) {
      return res.json({
        connected: false,
        clientId,
        redirectUri,
        authorizeUrl
      });
    }

    const forceVerify = req.query.verify === 'true';
    const cacheRecent =
      !forceVerify &&
      lastVerifiedAuth &&
      lastVerifiedAuth.token === tokens.access_token &&
      Date.now() - lastVerifiedAuth.checkedAt < 25 * 1000;

    if (cacheRecent && !lastVerifiedAuth!.valid) {
      return res.json({
        connected: false,
        tokenInvalid: true,
        error: lastVerifiedAuth!.error || 'Token do Bling expirado ou inválido. Reconecte via OAuth.',
        clientId,
        redirectUri,
        authorizeUrl
      });
    }

    if (!cacheRecent) {
      try {
        await fetchFromBling('/produtos?pagina=1&limite=1');
        tokens = loadBlingTokens() || tokens;
      } catch (verifyErr: any) {
        return res.json({
          connected: false,
          tokenInvalid: true,
          error: verifyErr?.message || 'Token do Bling expirado ou inválido. Reconecte via OAuth.',
          clientId,
          redirectUri,
          authorizeUrl
        });
      }
    }

    const latestFs = hasFirebaseAdminEnv() ? await getBlingTokenStatusFromFirestore() : null;
    const activeTokenData = latestFs?.access_token
      ? {
          access_token: latestFs.access_token,
          refresh_token: latestFs.refresh_token || tokens.refresh_token,
          expires_in: latestFs.expires_in || 21600,
          expires_at: latestFs.expires_at,
          scope: latestFs.scope || tokens.scope,
          obtained_at: latestFs.obtained_at || tokens.obtained_at,
        }
      : tokens;

    if (!activeTokenData || !activeTokenData.access_token) {
      return res.json({
        connected: false,
        tokenInvalid: true,
        clientId,
        redirectUri,
        authorizeUrl
      });
    }

    const expiresInMs = (activeTokenData.expires_in || 21600) * 1000;
    const expiresAt = activeTokenData.expires_at ?? (activeTokenData.obtained_at + expiresInMs);
    const isExpired = Date.now() >= expiresAt;

    res.json({
      connected: true,
      clientId,
      redirectUri,
      callbackUri: `${appUrl}/bling/callback`,
      authorizeUrl,
      scope: activeTokenData.scope,
      hasRefreshToken: Boolean(activeTokenData.refresh_token),
      isExpired,
      expiresAt: new Date(expiresAt).toISOString(),
      obtainedAt: new Date(activeTokenData.obtained_at).toISOString()
    });
  });

  // 5b. Keep-Alive Cron Endpoint mounted on /api/bling/keep-alive & blingRouter
  blingRouter.get('/keep-alive', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const cronSecret = (process.env.CRON_SECRET || '').trim();
      if (cronSecret) {
        const authHeader = (req.headers.authorization || '').trim();
        const xCron = typeof req.headers['x-cron-secret'] === 'string' ? req.headers['x-cron-secret'].trim() : '';
        const qSecret = typeof req.query.secret === 'string' ? req.query.secret.trim() : '';
        if (authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}` && xCron !== cronSecret && qSecret !== cronSecret) {
          return res.status(401).json({ ok: false, error: 'Unauthorized' });
        }
      }
      const token = await getValidBlingToken();
      return res.status(200).json({
        ok: true,
        refreshedOrValid: Boolean(token),
        checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      return res.status(200).json({
        ok: false,
        error: message,
        checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }
  });

  function verifySyncSecretMiddleware(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'POST') {
      return res.status(405).json({ error: 'Method not allowed. Use GET or POST.' });
    }
    if (process.env.CRON_SECRET?.trim()) {
      const querySecret = typeof req.query.secret === 'string' ? req.query.secret : '';
      const headerCron = typeof req.headers['x-cron-secret'] === 'string' ? req.headers['x-cron-secret'] : '';
      const headerAdmin = typeof req.headers['x-admin-secret'] === 'string' ? req.headers['x-admin-secret'] : '';
      const authHeader = typeof req.headers.authorization === 'string' ? req.headers.authorization : '';
      const bearerSecret = authHeader.toLowerCase().startsWith('bearer ') ? authHeader.slice(7).trim() : '';
      const providedSecret = querySecret || headerCron || headerAdmin || bearerSecret;

      if (!verifySyncSecret(providedSecret)) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          error: 'Não autorizado. Informe CRON_SECRET válido via header ou ?secret=.',
        });
      }
    }
    return next();
  }

  // 5c. Automated Auto-Loop / Paginated Catalog Sync (/api/bling/sync) com Middleware de Interrupção
  blingRouter.all('/sync', verifySyncSecretMiddleware, blingAuthInterceptorMiddleware, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    if (req.query.verify === 'true') {
      return res.status(200).json({ authorized: true });
    }

    try {
      const hasExplicitPage = typeof req.query.pagina === 'string' && req.query.pagina.trim() !== '';
      const autoAll = req.query.all === 'true' || !hasExplicitPage;

      if (autoAll) {
        const startPageRaw = typeof req.query.pagina === 'string' ? req.query.pagina : '1';
        const startPage = Math.max(1, parseInt(startPageRaw, 10) || 1);
        const maxMsRaw = typeof req.query.maxMs === 'string' ? parseInt(req.query.maxMs, 10) : 0;
        const result = await syncAllBlingProdutosToFirestore({
          startPage,
          maxExecutionMs: maxMsRaw > 0 ? Math.min(55000, maxMsRaw) : (process.env.VERCEL ? 7500 : 45000),
        });
        return res.status(200).json(result);
      }

      const pagina = Math.max(1, parseInt(String(req.query.pagina), 10) || 1);
      const result = await syncBlingProdutosPageToFirestore(pagina);
      return res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      console.error('[Express /api/bling/sync Error]:', message);
      return res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: message });
    }
  });

  // 5d. Batch Catalog Sync (Bling API v3 -> Firestore WriteBatch) com Middleware de Interrupção
  blingRouter.all('/sync-produtos', verifySyncSecretMiddleware, blingAuthInterceptorMiddleware, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    if (req.query.verify === 'true') {
      return res.status(200).json({ authorized: true });
    }

    try {
      const paginaRaw = typeof req.query.pagina === 'string' ? req.query.pagina : '1';
      const pagina = Math.max(1, parseInt(paginaRaw, 10) || 1);
      const resultado = await syncBlingProdutosPageToFirestore(pagina);
      return res.status(200).json(resultado);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      console.error('[Express /api/bling/sync-produtos Error]:', message);
      return res.status(500).json({ error: message });
    }
  });

  app.use('/api/bling', blingRouter);

  // 6. Fetch Products from Bling API v3 (Interceptado por blingAuthInterceptorMiddleware)
  app.get('/api/bling/products', blingAuthInterceptorMiddleware, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const pagina = req.query.pagina ? String(req.query.pagina) : '1';
      const limiteParam = parseInt(String(req.query.limite || '100'), 10);
      const maxProducts = Math.min(10000, parseInt(String(req.query.max || '10000'), 10) || 10000);
      const includeZeroStock = req.query.includeZeroStock === 'true';
      const fetchAll = req.query.all === 'true' || req.query.todos === 'true' || limiteParam > 100 || (!req.query.pagina && !req.query.limite);

      let rawProducts: any[] = [];
      if (fetchAll) {
        const seenIds = new Set<number>();
        const pushUnique = (items: any[]) => {
          for (const it of items) {
            if (it?.situacao === 'I' || it?.situacao === 'E') continue;
            if (it?.id && !seenIds.has(it.id) && rawProducts.length < maxProducts) {
              seenIds.add(it.id);
              rawProducts.push(it);
            }
          }
        };

        // Paginate all active products (criterio=2: Ativos) until the end (up to 10,000 items)
        for (let p = 1; p <= 100 && rawProducts.length < maxProducts; p++) {
          try {
            const pageData = await fetchFromBling(`/produtos?pagina=${p}&limite=100&criterio=2`);
            const items = pageData?.data || [];
            if (items.length > 0) pushUnique(items);
            if (items.length < 100) break;
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 140));
          } catch (pageErr: any) {
            console.warn(`[Bling Products] Stopped pagination at page ${p}:`, pageErr?.message || pageErr);
            break;
          }
        }
      } else {
        const data = await fetchFromBling(`/produtos?pagina=${pagina}&limite=${limiteParam}&criterio=2`);
        rawProducts = (data?.data || []).slice(0, maxProducts);
      }

      // Fetch real stock balances in chunks of 50 product IDs
      const stockMap: Record<number, number> = {};
      let stockApiSucceeded = false;
      const allIds = rawProducts.map((p: any) => p.id).filter(Boolean);
      for (let i = 0; i < allIds.length; i += 50) {
        const chunk = allIds.slice(i, i + 50);
        try {
          const qs = chunk.map((id: number) => `idsProdutos[]=${id}`).join('&');
          const stockData = await fetchFromBling(`/estoques/saldos?${qs}`);
          stockApiSucceeded = true;
          (stockData.data || []).forEach((item: any) => {
            const pId = item.produto?.id;
            const balance = item.saldoVirtualTotal ?? item.saldoFisicoTotal ?? item.saldoFisico ?? 0;
            if (pId) stockMap[pId] = Number(balance) || 0;
          });
          if (i + 50 < allIds.length) {
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 120));
          }
        } catch (stockErr) {
          console.warn('[Bling] Could not fetch stock balances chunk:', stockErr);
        }
      }

      // Map to consistent format extracting all Bling image fields & real stock
      const formatted = rawProducts.map((p: any) => {
        const directImages = extractImagesFromBlingItem(p);
        const directFullRes = directImages.filter(u => !isThumbnailLikeUrl(u));
        const cachedImgs = getBlingImagesForProduct({ name: p.nome, sku: p.codigo, blingId: String(p.id) }) || [];
        const cachedFullRes = cachedImgs.filter(u => !isThumbnailLikeUrl(u));
        const combinedFullRes = Array.from(new Set([...directFullRes, ...cachedFullRes]));
        const storedImages = combinedFullRes.length > 0
          ? combinedFullRes
          : (cachedImgs.length > 0 ? cachedImgs : directImages);
        const realStock = stockMap[p.id] !== undefined
          ? stockMap[p.id]
          : (p.estoque?.saldoVirtualTotal ?? p.estoque?.saldoFisicoTotal ?? p.estoque?.saldoFisico ?? (stockApiSucceeded ? 0 : 0));
        return {
          id: `bling-${p.id}`,
          blingId: p.id,
          idProdutoPai: p.idProdutoPai || null,
          name: p.nome,
          code: p.codigo,
          sku: p.codigo,
          price: p.preco || 0,
          stock: Math.max(0, Number(realStock) || 0),
          stockCount: Math.max(0, Number(realStock) || 0),
          status: p.situacao,
          format: p.formato,
          type: p.tipo,
          shortDescription: p.descricaoCurta || '',
          imageUrl: storedImages[0] || '',
          images: storedImages,
        };
      });

      const visible = formatted.filter((p: any) => !isProductHidden(p) && (includeZeroStock || p.stock > 0));

      res.json({
        success: true,
        count: visible.length,
        products: visible,
        rawCount: rawProducts.length
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[Bling Products Error]:', err);
      const isAuthErr = String(err?.message || '').includes('401') || String(err?.message || '').includes('OAuth');
      res.status(isAuthErr ? 401 : 500).json({
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Falha ao buscar produtos do Bling ERP',
        connected: Boolean(loadBlingTokens())
      });
    }
  });

  // 7. Fetch Sales Orders from Bling API v3 (Interceptado; fallback local se nunca autorizado)
  app.get('/api/bling/orders', createBlingAuthMiddleware({ allowLocalFallback: true }), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      if (!(req as BlingAuthorizedRequest).blingAccessToken) {
        const localOrders = loadLocalBlingOrders();
        return res.json({
          success: true,
          count: localOrders.length,
          orders: localOrders
        });
      }
      const pagina = req.query.pagina || '1';
      const limite = req.query.limite || '50';

      const data = await fetchFromBling(`/pedidos/vendas?pagina=${pagina}&limite=${limite}`);
      const rawOrders = data.data || [];

      const formatted = rawOrders.map((o: any) => ({
        id: o.id,
        numero: o.numero,
        data: o.data,
        total: o.total,
        situacao: o.situacao?.valor || o.situacao?.id || 'Pendente',
        cliente: o.contato?.nome || 'Cliente Street Store',
        documento: o.contato?.numeroDocumento || '',
        itens: (o.itens || []).map((it: any) => ({
          codigo: it.codigo,
          descricao: it.descricao,
          quantidade: it.quantidade,
          valor: it.valor
        }))
      }));

      res.json({
        success: true,
        count: formatted.length,
        orders: formatted
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[Bling Orders Error]:', err);
      // Fallback to local stored orders
      const localOrders = loadLocalBlingOrders();
      res.json({
        success: true,
        count: localOrders.length,
        orders: localOrders
      });
    }
  });

  // 7.1 Create Sales Order in Bling ERP
  app.post('/api/bling/orders', blingAuthInterceptorMiddleware, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const result = await createBlingOrder(req.body);
      res.json(result);
    } catch (err: any) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Falha ao criar pedido no Bling'
      });
    }
  });

  // 8. Fetch Stock Balances
  app.get('/api/bling/stock', blingAuthInterceptorMiddleware, async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const data = await fetchFromBling('/estoques/saldos?pagina=1&limite=100');
      res.json({
        success: true,
        stock: data.data || []
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      const msg = String(err?.message || '');
      const isAuthErr = msg.includes('401') || msg.includes('OAuth') || msg.includes('expirad');
      res.status(isAuthErr ? 401 : 500).json({
        success: false,
        tokenInvalid: isAuthErr,
        error: msg || 'Falha ao buscar estoque do Bling'
      });
    }
  });

  // 9. Disconnect / Logout Bling
  app.post('/api/bling/disconnect', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
    clearBlingTokens();
    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Bling desconectado com sucesso.' });
  });
}

const LOCAL_ORDERS_FILE = path.resolve(process.env.VERCEL ? '/tmp' : process.cwd(), '.bling_orders.json');

export interface BlingOrderParams {
  numero?: string | number;
  customer: {
    name: string;
    email: string;
    cpf?: string;
    phone?: string;
  };
  shippingAddress?: {
    address: string;
    number: string;
    locality?: string;
    city: string;
    province: string;
    zipcode: string;
    complement?: string;
  };
  shippingCarrier?: string;
  shippingCost?: number;
  items: Array<{
    id?: string | number;
    name: string;
    sku?: string;
    quantity: number;
    price: number;
    selectedSize?: string;
  }>;
  total: number;
  paymentMethod: 'pix' | 'credit_card' | string;
  paymentId?: string | number;
}

export function loadLocalBlingOrders(): any[] {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(LOCAL_ORDERS_FILE)) {
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(LOCAL_ORDERS_FILE, 'utf-8');
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Bling] Could not read local orders file:', err);
  }
  return [];
}

export function saveLocalBlingOrder(order: any): void {
  try {
    const list = loadLocalBlingOrders();
    const updated = [order, ...list.filter((o: any) => o.numero !== order.numero && o.id !== order.id)];
    fs.writeFileSync(LOCAL_ORDERS_FILE, JSON.stringify(updated.slice(0, 200), null, 2), 'utf-8');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Bling] Could not save order to local store:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Creates sales order in Bling ERP (API v3 /pedidos/vendas) with local store backup
 */
export async function createBlingOrder(params: BlingOrderParams): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  orderNumber: string;
  orderId: string | number;
  status: string;
  order: any;
  blingSynced: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const orderNumber = params.numero 
    ? String(params.numero) 
    : `ST-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
  
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const blingPayload = {
    numero: parseInt(orderNumber.replace(/\D/g, '') || String(Date.now()).slice(-5), 10),
    data: todayStr,
    dataPrevista: todayStr,
    contato: {
      nome: params.customer.name || 'Cliente Street Store',
      tipoPessoa: 'F',
      numeroDocumento: (params.customer.cpf || '').replace(/\D/g, ''),
      email: params.customer.email,
      telefone: (params.customer.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '')
    },
    itens: params.items.map((it) => ({
      codigo: it.sku || `SKU-${String(it.id || 'ITEM').replace(/\D/g, '') || '01'}`,
      descricao: `${it.name}${it.selectedSize ? ` - Tam ${it.selectedSize}` : ''}`,
      quantidade: it.quantity || 1,
      valor: it.price || 139.90
    })),
    transporte: {
      transportadora: {
        nome: params.shippingCarrier || 'Melhor Envio'
      },
      etiqueta: params.shippingAddress ? {
        nome: params.customer.name || 'Cliente Street Store',
        endereco: params.shippingAddress.address || '',
        numero: params.shippingAddress.number || 'S/N',
        complemento: params.shippingAddress.complement || '',
        bairro: params.shippingAddress.locality || '',
        municipio: params.shippingAddress.city || '',
        uf: params.shippingAddress.province || 'MG',
        cep: (params.shippingAddress.zipcode || '').replace(/\D/g, '')
      } : undefined
    },
    pagamento: {
      formas: [
        {
          valor: params.total,
          formaPagamento: {
            id: 1
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    observacoes: `Street Store Oficial - Pedido #${orderNumber} | Pagamento: ${params.paymentMethod} (${params.paymentId || 'Aprovado Mercado Pago'}) | Frete: ${params.shippingCarrier || 'Melhor Envio'}`
  };

  let blingSynced = false;
  let remoteId: any = orderNumber;

  try {
    if (await ensureBlingAuthorized()) {
      console.log(`[Bling] Submitting order #${orderNumber} to Bling API v3...`);
      const res = await fetchFromBling('/pedidos/vendas', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(blingPayload)
      });
      if (res?.data?.id) {
        remoteId = res.data.id;
        blingSynced = true;
        console.log(`[Bling] Order #${orderNumber} registered successfully in Bling ERP (ID: ${remoteId})`);
      }
    }
  } catch (apiErr: any) {
    console.warn('[Bling] Notice syncing order to remote Bling API (saved locally):', apiErr.message);
  }

  const storedOrder = {
    id: remoteId,
    numero: orderNumber,
    data: todayStr,
    total: params.total,
    situacao: 'Em Aberto / Pago',
    cliente: params.customer.name,
    email: params.customer.email,
    documento: params.customer.cpf || '',
    transporte: params.shippingCarrier || 'Melhor Envio',
    rastreio: null,
    itens: params.items.map((it) => ({
      codigo: it.sku || `SKU-${it.id || 'ITEM'}`,
      descricao: `${it.name}${it.selectedSize ? ` (${it.selectedSize})` : ''}`,
      quantidade: it.quantity,
      valor: it.price
    })),
    blingSynced,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  saveLocalBlingOrder(storedOrder);

  return {
    success: true,
    orderNumber,
    orderId: remoteId,
    status: 'pago',
    order: storedOrder,
    blingSynced
  };
}


=== ARQUIVO: server-melhor-envio.ts ===
import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';

dotenv.config({ override: !process.env.VERCEL });

const isJwtToken = (val?: string) =>
  Boolean(val && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(val.trim()));

const localEnvPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env');
if (fs.existsSync(localEnvPath)) {
  const parsedEnv = dotenv.parse(fs.readFileSync(localEnvPath));
  if (isJwtToken(parsedEnv.MELHOR_ENVIO_TOKEN)) {
    process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_TOKEN = parsedEnv.MELHOR_ENVIO_TOKEN.trim();
  }
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test((parsedEnv.MELHOR_ENVIO_URL || '').trim())) {
    process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_URL = parsedEnv.MELHOR_ENVIO_URL.trim();
  }
}

function resolveMelhorEnvioBaseUrl(): string {
  for (const raw of [process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_URL, process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL]) {
    const cleaned = (raw || '')
      .trim()
      .replace(/\/+$/, '')
      .replace(/\/api\/v2$/i, '');
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(cleaned)) {
      return cleaned;
    }
  }
  return 'https://melhorenvio.com.br';
}

const MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL = `${resolveMelhorEnvioBaseUrl()}/api/v2`;
const MELHOR_ENVIO_FROM_POSTAL_CODE = process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_FROM_POSTAL_CODE || '35900539';
const USER_AGENT = (process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_USER_AGENT || 'StreetStore (streetstore364@gmail.com)').trim();

export function sanitizeMelhorEnvioToken(): string | null {
  const token = (process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_TOKEN || '').trim();
  return token || null;
}

export async function getValidMelhorEnvioToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  return sanitizeMelhorEnvioToken();
}

export interface ShippingQuoteItem {
  id?: string;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  length?: number;
  weight?: number; // in kg
  price?: number;
  quantity?: number;
}

export interface FormattedShippingOption {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  company: {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    picture: string;
  };
  price: number;
  priceFormatted: string;
  discount: number;
  currency: string;
  deliveryTimeDays: number;
  deliveryText: string;
  source?: 'melhor-envio' | 'estimated';
  error?: string;
}

export function sanitizeCep(raw: string): string {
  return String(raw || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 8);
}

function buildFallbackOptions(toCep: string, cartTotal?: number): FormattedShippingOption[] {
  const isLocalMg = toCep.startsWith('35') || toCep.startsWith('30') || toCep.startsWith('31');
  const pacPrice = isLocalMg ? 16.90 : 22.90;
  const sedexPrice = isLocalMg ? 21.90 : 34.90;
  const jadlogPrice = isLocalMg ? 17.50 : 21.40;
  const freeEligible = (cartTotal || 0) >= 299;

  return [
    {
      id: 1,
      name: freeEligible ? 'PAC (Frete Grátis)' : 'PAC',
      company: { id: 1, name: 'Correios', picture: 'https://assets.melhorenvio.com.br/companies/correios.png' },
      price: freeEligible ? 0 : pacPrice,
      priceFormatted: freeEligible ? 'Grátis' : pacPrice.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }),
      discount: 0,
      currency: 'BRL',
      deliveryTimeDays: isLocalMg ? 4 : 7,
      deliveryText: isLocalMg ? '4 dias úteis' : '7 dias úteis',
      source: 'estimated'
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      name: '.Package',
      company: { id: 2, name: 'Jadlog', picture: 'https://assets.melhorenvio.com.br/companies/jadlog.png' },
      price: jadlogPrice,
      priceFormatted: jadlogPrice.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }),
      discount: 0,
      currency: 'BRL',
      deliveryTimeDays: isLocalMg ? 3 : 5,
      deliveryText: isLocalMg ? '3 dias úteis' : '5 dias úteis',
      source: 'estimated'
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      name: 'SEDEX',
      company: { id: 1, name: 'Correios', picture: 'https://assets.melhorenvio.com.br/companies/correios.png' },
      price: sedexPrice,
      priceFormatted: sedexPrice.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }),
      discount: 0,
      currency: 'BRL',
      deliveryTimeDays: isLocalMg ? 2 : 3,
      deliveryText: isLocalMg ? '2 dias úteis' : '3 dias úteis',
      source: 'estimated'
    }
  ];
}

/**
 * Calculates live shipping rates with Melhor Envio API v2 across all carriers (Correios, Jadlog, Loggi, etc.)
 */
export async function calculateMelhorEnvioShipping(params: {
  fromPostalCode?: string;
  toPostalCode: string;
  items?: ShippingQuoteItem[];
  cartTotal?: number;
}): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  live: boolean;
  options: FormattedShippingOption[];
  rawCount?: number;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const cleanToCep = sanitizeCep(params.toPostalCode);
  if (cleanToCep.length !== 8) {
    return {
      success: false,
      from: MELHOR_ENVIO_FROM_POSTAL_CODE,
      to: cleanToCep,
      live: false,
      options: [],
      error: 'CEP de destino inválido. Informe 8 números.'
    };
  }

  const cleanFromCep = sanitizeCep(params.fromPostalCode || MELHOR_ENVIO_FROM_POSTAL_CODE) || '35900539';
  const token = await getValidMelhorEnvioToken();

  if (!token) {
    return {
      success: true,
      from: cleanFromCep,
      to: cleanToCep,
      live: false,
      options: buildFallbackOptions(cleanToCep, params.cartTotal)
    };
  }

  const productsPayload = (params.items && params.items.length > 0)
    ? params.items.map((item, idx) => ({
        id: String(item.id || `item-${idx + 1}`),
        width: Math.max(12, item.width || 25),
        height: Math.max(4, item.height || 5),
        length: Math.max(16, item.length || 25),
        weight: Math.max(0.2, item.weight || 0.35),
        insurance_value: Math.max(50, item.price || 139.9),
        quantity: Math.max(1, item.quantity || 1)
      }))
    : [
        {
          id: 'street-product-default',
          width: 25,
          height: 5,
          length: 25,
          weight: 0.35,
          insurance_value: params.cartTotal || 139.9,
          quantity: 1
        }
      ];

  const payload = {
    from: { postal_code: cleanFromCep },
    to: { postal_code: cleanToCep },
    products: productsPayload,
    options: {
      receipt: false,
      own_hand: false
    }
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL}/me/shipment/calculate`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Accept': 'application/json',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        'User-Agent': USER_AGENT
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errText = await res.text();
      console.warn('[Melhor Envio] Calculate returned', res.status, errText);
      return {
        success: true,
        from: cleanFromCep,
        to: cleanToCep,
        live: false,
        options: buildFallbackOptions(cleanToCep, params.cartTotal),
        error: `Melhor Envio API [${res.status}]`
      };
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
      return {
        success: true,
        from: cleanFromCep,
        to: cleanToCep,
        live: false,
        options: buildFallbackOptions(cleanToCep, params.cartTotal),
        error: data.message || 'Resposta inesperada do Melhor Envio'
      };
    }

    const validOptions: FormattedShippingOption[] = data
      .filter((opt: any) => !opt.error && (opt.custom_price || opt.price))
      .map((opt: any) => {
        const rawPrice = parseFloat(opt.custom_price || opt.price || '0');
        const days = parseInt(opt.custom_delivery_time || opt.delivery_time || '5', 10);
        return {
          id: opt.id,
          name: opt.name,
          company: {
            id: opt.company?.id || 0,
            name: opt.company?.name || 'Transportadora',
            picture: opt.company?.picture || ''
          },
          price: rawPrice,
          priceFormatted: rawPrice.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }),
          discount: parseFloat(opt.discount || '0'),
          currency: opt.currency || 'BRL',
          deliveryTimeDays: days,
          deliveryText: days === 1 ? '1 dia útil' : `${days} dias úteis`,
          source: 'melhor-envio' as const
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);

    return {
      success: true,
      from: cleanFromCep,
      to: cleanToCep,
      live: true,
      options: validOptions.length > 0 ? validOptions : buildFallbackOptions(cleanToCep, params.cartTotal),
      rawCount: data.length
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[Melhor Envio] Network exception during calculate:', error);
    return {
      success: true,
      from: cleanFromCep,
      to: cleanToCep,
      live: false,
      options: buildFallbackOptions(cleanToCep, params.cartTotal),
      error: error.message || 'Falha ao consultar Melhor Envio'
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Add an order shipment to the Melhor Envio cart for label generation
 */
export async function addOrderToMelhorEnvioCart(params: {
  serviceId: number;
  orderNumber: string;
  customer: {
    name: string;
    email: string;
    phone?: string;
    cpf?: string;
  };
  shippingAddress: {
    street: string;
    number: string;
    complement?: string;
    neighborhood: string;
    city: string;
    state: string;
    zip: string;
  };
  items: Array<{
    name: string;
    quantity: number;
    price: number;
  }>;
  total: number;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; cartId?: string; protocol?: string; error?: string }> {
  const token = await getValidMelhorEnvioToken();
  if (!token) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Melhor Envio não conectado via OAuth.' };
  }

  try {
    const meInfo = await getMelhorEnvioAccountInfo();
    const fromUser = meInfo.user;

    const payload = {
      service: params.serviceId || 1,
      from: {
        name: fromUser?.name || 'Street Store Itabira',
        phone: fromUser?.phone || '31984806556',
        email: fromUser?.email || 'streetstore364@gmail.com',
        document: (fromUser?.document || '45892109000132').replace(/\D/g, ''),
        address: 'Avenida João Pinheiro',
        number: '353',
        district: 'Centro',
        city: 'Itabira',
        state_abbr: 'MG',
        country_id: 'BR',
        postal_code: MELHOR_ENVIO_FROM_POSTAL_CODE
      },
      to: {
        name: params.customer.name || 'Cliente Street Store',
        phone: (params.customer.phone || '31984806556').replace(/\D/g, ''),
        email: params.customer.email,
        document: params.customer.cpf ? params.customer.cpf.replace(/\D/g, '') : undefined,
        address: params.shippingAddress.street,
        number: params.shippingAddress.number || 'S/N',
        complement: params.shippingAddress.complement || '',
        district: params.shippingAddress.neighborhood || 'Centro',
        city: params.shippingAddress.city,
        state_abbr: (params.shippingAddress.state || 'MG').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(),
        country_id: 'BR',
        postal_code: sanitizeCep(params.shippingAddress.zip)
      },
      products: params.items.map((it) => ({
        name: it.name,
        quantity: it.quantity || 1,
        unitary_value: Number(it.price || 99.90)
      })),
      volumes: [
        {
          height: 10,
          width: 26,
          length: 30,
          weight: Math.max(0.35, params.items.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.quantity || 1) * 0.35, 0))
        }
      ],
      options: {
        insurance_value: Math.max(20, params.total),
        receipt: false,
        own_hand: false,
        non_commercial: true,
        platform: 'Street Store',
        tags: [{ tag: `Pedido ${params.orderNumber}`, url: '' }]
      }
    };

    const res = await fetch(`${MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL}/me/cart`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Accept': 'application/json',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        'User-Agent': USER_AGENT
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) {
      return { success: false, error: data.message || JSON.stringify(data.errors || data) };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      cartId: data.id,
      protocol: data.protocol
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Fetch authenticated user info & wallet balance from Melhor Envio
 */
export async function getMelhorEnvioAccountInfo(): Promise<any> {
  const token = await getValidMelhorEnvioToken();

  if (!token) {
    return {
      connected: false,
      user: null,
      balance: { balance: 0, reserved: 0 },
      fromPostalCode: MELHOR_ENVIO_FROM_POSTAL_CODE
    };
  }

  const [meRes, balanceRes] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(`${MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL}/me`, {
      headers: {
        'Accept': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        'User-Agent': USER_AGENT
      }
    }),
    fetch(`${MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL}/me/balance`, {
      headers: {
        'Accept': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        'User-Agent': USER_AGENT
      }
    })
  ]);

  const me = meRes.ok ? await meRes.json() : null;
  const balance = balanceRes.ok ? await balanceRes.json() : null;

  return {
    connected: Boolean(me?.email || me?.id),
    user: me ? {
      id: me.id,
      name: `${me.firstname || ''} ${me.lastname || ''}`.trim() || me.email,
      email: me.email,
      document: me.document,
      phone: me.phone?.phone || ''
    } : null,
    balance: balance || { balance: 0, reserved: 0 },
    fromPostalCode: MELHOR_ENVIO_FROM_POSTAL_CODE
  };
}

let cachedMelhorEnvioState: {
  connected: boolean;
  user?: any;
  companiesCount: number;
  syncedAt: number;
} | null = null;

/**
 * Automatic background Melhor Envio sync (token validation/refresh, account & carrier status,
 * and automatic tracking status check for open shipments). Runs at startup & periodically.
 */
export async function syncMelhorEnvioIntegration(): Promise<{
  connected: boolean;
  companiesCount: number;
  syncedAt: string;
}> {
  const token = await getValidMelhorEnvioToken();
  if (!token) {
    cachedMelhorEnvioState = { connected: false, companiesCount: 0, syncedAt: Date.now() };
    return { connected: false, companiesCount: 0, syncedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  }

  try {
    const [info, companiesRes] = await Promise.all([
      getMelhorEnvioAccountInfo(),
      fetch(`${MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL}/me/shipment/companies`, {
        headers: {
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
          'User-Agent': USER_AGENT
        }
      }).catch(() => null)
    ]);

    const companiesJson = companiesRes && companiesRes.ok ? await companiesRes.json().catch(() => []) : [];
    const companiesCount = Array.isArray(companiesJson) ? companiesJson.length : 0;

    // Also sync tracking info for any unshipped/open orders stored locally if tracking codes exist
    const ordersPath = path.resolve(process.env.VERCEL ? '/tmp' : process.cwd(), '.street_orders.json');
    if (fs.existsSync(ordersPath)) {
      try {
        const db = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(ordersPath, 'utf-8'));
        const pendingOrders = (db?.orders || []).filter(
          (o: any) => o.trackingNumber && o.shippingStatus !== 'delivered'
        );
        if (pendingOrders.length > 0) {
          const codes = pendingOrders.map((o: any) => o.trackingNumber).slice(0, 20);
          const trackRes = await fetch(`${MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL}/me/shipment/tracking`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Accept': 'application/json',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
              'User-Agent': USER_AGENT
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ orders: codes })
          }).catch(() => null);
          if (trackRes && trackRes.ok) {
            const trackData = await trackRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
            let changed = false;
            for (const o of pendingOrders) {
              const infoTrack = trackData?.[o.trackingNumber];
              if (infoTrack?.status === 'delivered' && o.shippingStatus !== 'delivered') {
                o.shippingStatus = 'delivered';
                changed = true;
              } else if (infoTrack?.status === 'posted' && o.shippingStatus === 'unshipped') {
                o.shippingStatus = 'shipped';
                changed = true;
              }
            }
            if (changed) {
              fs.writeFileSync(ordersPath, JSON.stringify(db, null, 2), 'utf-8');
            }
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // non-blocking order tracking check
      }
    }

    cachedMelhorEnvioState = {
      connected: Boolean(info.connected),
      user: info.user,
      companiesCount,
      syncedAt: Date.now()
    };

    console.log(`[Melhor Envio Auto-Sync] Conectado: ${info.connected ? 'SIM' : 'NÃO'} (${info.user?.email || 'sem usuário'}) | Transportadoras ativas: ${companiesCount}`);
    return {
      connected: Boolean(info.connected),
      companiesCount,
      syncedAt: new Date(cachedMelhorEnvioState.syncedAt).toISOString()
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('[Melhor Envio Auto-Sync] Aviso:', err?.message || err);
    return {
      connected: Boolean(cachedMelhorEnvioState?.connected),
      companiesCount: cachedMelhorEnvioState?.companiesCount || 0,
      syncedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
}

let melhorEnvioIntervalStarted = false;

export function startMelhorEnvioAutoSync(): void {
  if (melhorEnvioIntervalStarted) return;
  melhorEnvioIntervalStarted = true;

  // Immediate startup verification & sync
  syncMelhorEnvioIntegration().catch(() => {});

  // Keep Mejor Envio token/status/tracking automatically synced every 15 minutes
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    syncMelhorEnvioIntegration().catch(() => {});
  }, 15 * 60 * 1000);
  if (typeof timer.unref === 'function') timer.unref();
}

/**
 * Register Melhor Envio Express routes (fixed JWT Bearer token from process.env.MELHOR_ENVIO_TOKEN)
 */
export function registerMelhorEnvioRoutes(app: express.Express) {
  app.get('/api/melhor-envio/status', async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const info = await getMelhorEnvioAccountInfo();
      res.json({
        success: true,
        authMode: 'fixed_jwt',
        ...info
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        connected: false,
        error: err.message || 'Erro ao obter status do Melhor Envio'
      });
    }
  });

  // 6. Calculate Shipping Rates across carriers (Correios PAC, Sedex, Jadlog, Loggi, etc.)
  app.post(['/api/shipping/calculate', '/api/shipping/quote'], async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const { cep, cepDestino, toPostalCode, postalCode, items, cartTotal } = req.body;
      const targetCep = cep || cepDestino || toPostalCode || postalCode;

      if (!targetCep) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'CEP de destino não informado.'
        });
      }

      const result = await calculateMelhorEnvioShipping({
        toPostalCode: targetCep,
        items,
        cartTotal
      });

      res.json(result);
    } catch (err: any) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Erro ao calcular frete com Melhor Envio'
      });
    }
  });

  // 7. Track order or shipment
  app.get('/api/shipping/track/:code', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const code = req.params.code.trim().toUpperCase();
    try {
      const token = await getValidMelhorEnvioToken();
      if (token) {
        const resTracking = await fetch(`${MELHOR_ENVIO_API_URL}/me/shipment/tracking`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
            'User-Agent': USER_AGENT
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({ orders: [code] })
        });

        if (resTracking.ok) {
          const trackingData = await resTracking.json();
          return res.json({
            success: true,
            code,
            provider: 'melhor-envio',
            data: trackingData
          });
        }
      }

      const isCorreios = /^[A-Z]{2}\d{9}[A-Z]{2}$/.test(code);
      const isJadlog = /^\d{14}$/.test(code);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        code,
        provider: isCorreios ? 'correios' : (isJadlog ? 'jadlog' : 'melhor-envio'),
        trackingUrl: isCorreios
          ? `https://rastreamento.correios.com.br/app/index.php?codigo=${code}`
          : (isJadlog ? `https://www.jadlog.com.br/jadlog/tracking?cte=${code}` : `https://melhorenvio.com.br/rastreio/${code}`),
        message: 'Código de rastreamento oficial ativo e despachado.'
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: err.message || 'Erro ao rastrear envio'
      });
    }
  });

  // 8. Melhor Envio Webhook Receiver
  app.post('/api/melhor-envio/webhook', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    console.log('[Melhor Envio Webhook] Event received:', JSON.stringify(req.body));
    res.status(200).json({ received: true });
  });
}


=== ARQUIVO: server-orders.ts ===
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fetchFromBling, ensureBlingAuthorized } from './server-bling';
import { addOrderToMelhorEnvioCart } from './server-melhor-envio';

const ORDERS_STORE_PATH = path.resolve(
  process.env.VERCEL ? '/tmp' : process.cwd(),
  '.street_orders.json'
);

export interface StoredOrderItem {
  id?: string;
  sku?: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  quantity: number;
  selectedSize?: string;
  image?: string;
}

export interface StoredOrder {
  orderId: number;
  orderNumber: string;
  status: 'open' | 'closed' | 'cancelled';
  paymentStatus: 'paid' | 'pending' | 'voided' | 'refunded';
  shippingStatus: 'unshipped' | 'shipped' | 'delivered' | 'unpacked';
  shippingCarrier: string;
  trackingNumber?: string | null;
  trackingUrl?: string | null;
  paymentMethod: string;
  paymentId: string | number;
  blingOrderId?: number;
  customer: {
    name: string;
    email: string;
    phone?: string;
    cpf?: string;
  };
  shippingAddress?: {
    name?: string;
    address: string;
    number: string;
    locality: string;
    city: string;
    province: string;
    zipcode: string;
    country?: string;
  };
  products: Array<{
    name: string;
    price: number;
    quantity: number;
    variant?: string;
    image?: string;
  }>;
  total: number;
  createdAt: string;
  paidAt?: string | null;
  shippedAt?: string | null;
  returnRequests?: Array<{
    protocol: string;
    reason: string;
    actionRequested: string;
    selectedItems: string[];
    details: string;
    createdAt: string;
  }>;
}

interface OrdersDatabase {
  lastOrderSequence: number;
  orders: StoredOrder[];
}

function loadOrdersDb(): OrdersDatabase {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(ORDERS_STORE_PATH)) {
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(ORDERS_STORE_PATH, 'utf8');
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.orders)) {
        return {
          lastOrderSequence: Number(parsed.lastOrderSequence) || 1000,
          orders: parsed.orders,
        };
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Orders Store] Erro ao carregar pedidos locais:', err);
  }
  return { lastOrderSequence: 1000, orders: [] };
}

function saveOrdersDb(db: OrdersDatabase): void {
  try {
    fs.writeFileSync(ORDERS_STORE_PATH, JSON.stringify(db, null, 2), 'utf8');
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Orders Store] Erro ao salvar pedidos locais:', err);
  }
}

export async function createStoreOrder(params: {
  customer: {
    name?: string;
    email: string;
    phone?: string;
    cpf?: string;
  };
  items: StoredOrderItem[];
  shippingAddress?: {
    street?: string;
    number?: string;
    complement?: string;
    neighborhood?: string;
    city?: string;
    state?: string;
    zip?: string;
    name?: string;
    phone?: string;
  };
  shippingServiceId?: number;
  shippingCarrier?: string;
  paymentMethod: string;
  paymentId: string | number;
  total: number;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; id: number; number: string; blingOrderId?: number; melhorEnvioCartId?: string }> {
  const db = loadOrdersDb();

  // Avoid duplicate order for same paymentId
  const existing = db.orders.find((o) => String(o.paymentId) === String(params.paymentId));
  if (existing) {
    return {
      success: true,
      id: existing.orderId,
      number: existing.orderNumber,
      blingOrderId: existing.blingOrderId,
    };
  }

  db.lastOrderSequence += 1;
  const orderId = db.lastOrderSequence;
  const orderNumber = `#${orderId}`;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  const newOrder: StoredOrder = {
    orderId,
    orderNumber,
    status: 'open',
    paymentStatus: 'paid',
    shippingStatus: 'unshipped',
    shippingCarrier: params.shippingCarrier || 'Melhor Envio (Correios / Jadlog)',
    trackingNumber: null,
    trackingUrl: null,
    paymentMethod: params.paymentMethod,
    paymentId: params.paymentId,
    customer: {
      name: params.customer.name?.trim() || 'Cliente Street Store',
      email: params.customer.email,
      phone: params.customer.phone || '',
      cpf: params.customer.cpf,
    },
    shippingAddress: params.shippingAddress
      ? {
          name: params.shippingAddress.name || params.customer.name || 'Cliente Street Store',
          address: params.shippingAddress.street || 'Rua Principal',
          number: params.shippingAddress.number || 'S/N',
          locality: params.shippingAddress.neighborhood || 'Centro',
          city: params.shippingAddress.city || 'Itabira',
          province: params.shippingAddress.state || 'MG',
          zipcode: (params.shippingAddress.zip || '').replace(/\D/g, ''),
          country: 'BR',
        }
      : undefined,
    products: (params.items || []).map((it) => ({
      name: it.name,
      price: Number(it.price || 0),
      quantity: Number(it.quantity || 1),
      variant: it.selectedSize || 'Tamanho Único',
      image: it.image || '',
    })),
    total: Number(params.total || 0),
    createdAt: nowIso,
    paidAt: nowIso,
    shippedAt: null,
  };

  // Optional: Sync order to Bling ERP if OAuth token is connected
  try {
    if (await ensureBlingAuthorized()) {
      const todayDate = nowIso.slice(0, 10);
      const blingPayload = {
        numero: orderId,
        data: todayDate,
        dataSaida: todayDate,
        observacoes: `[STREET STORE] Pago via ${params.paymentMethod} (ID: ${params.paymentId}). Cliente: ${newOrder.customer.name} (${newOrder.customer.email})`,
        itens: newOrder.products.map((p, idx) => ({
          codigo: params.items?.[idx]?.sku || `ST-${idx + 1}`,
          descricao: `${p.name} (${p.variant || 'Único'})`,
          quantidade: p.quantity,
          valor: p.price,
        })),
      };
      const blingRes = await fetchFromBling('/pedidos/vendas', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(blingPayload),
      });
      if (blingRes?.data?.id) {
        newOrder.blingOrderId = blingRes.data.id;
        console.log(`[Orders Store] Pedido ${orderNumber} sincronizado no Bling ERP (ID: ${blingRes.data.id}).`);
      }
    }
  } catch (blingErr: any) {
    console.warn('[Orders Store] Registro no Bling ERP opcional ignorado:', blingErr?.message || blingErr);
  }

  // Optional: Register shipment in Melhor Envio Cart if connected & address provided
  let melhorEnvioCartId: string | undefined;
  if (params.shippingAddress?.zip && params.shippingAddress?.street) {
    try {
      const meCart = await addOrderToMelhorEnvioCart({
        serviceId: params.shippingServiceId || 1,
        orderNumber,
        customer: newOrder.customer,
        shippingAddress: {
          street: params.shippingAddress.street,
          number: params.shippingAddress.number || 'S/N',
          complement: params.shippingAddress.complement,
          neighborhood: params.shippingAddress.neighborhood || 'Centro',
          city: params.shippingAddress.city || 'Itabira',
          state: params.shippingAddress.state || 'MG',
          zip: params.shippingAddress.zip,
        },
        items: newOrder.products.map((p) => ({
          name: p.name,
          quantity: p.quantity,
          price: p.price,
        })),
        total: newOrder.total,
      });
      if (meCart.success && meCart.cartId) {
        melhorEnvioCartId = meCart.cartId;
        console.log(`[Orders Store] Etiqueta adicionada ao carrinho Melhor Envio: ${meCart.cartId}`);
      }
    } catch (meErr: any) {
      console.warn('[Orders Store] Registro opcional no Melhor Envio ignorado:', meErr?.message || meErr);
    }
  }

  db.orders.unshift(newOrder);
  saveOrdersDb(db);
  console.log(`[Orders Store] Pedido oficial ${orderNumber} registrado com sucesso.`);

  return {
    success: true,
    id: orderId,
    number: orderNumber,
    blingOrderId: newOrder.blingOrderId,
    melhorEnvioCartId,
  };
}

export async function trackStoreOrders(query: string): Promise<StoredOrder[]> {
  const cleanQ = query.trim().replace(/^#/, '').toLowerCase();
  const db = loadOrdersDb();

  const localMatches = db.orders.filter((o) => {
    const numMatch = o.orderNumber.replace('#', '').toLowerCase() === cleanQ || String(o.orderId) === cleanQ;
    const emailMatch = o.customer.email.toLowerCase() === cleanQ || o.customer.email.toLowerCase().includes(cleanQ);
    const paymentMatch = String(o.paymentId).toLowerCase() === cleanQ;
    return numMatch || emailMatch || paymentMatch;
  });

  // Also check Bling ERP sales orders if connected
  const blingMatches: StoredOrder[] = [];
  try {
    if (await ensureBlingAuthorized()) {
      const blingData = await fetchFromBling('/pedidos/vendas?pagina=1&limite=50');
      const rawOrders = blingData?.data || [];
      for (const bo of rawOrders) {
        const numStr = String(bo.numero || '');
        const idStr = String(bo.id || '');
        const contactName = (bo.contato?.nome || '').toLowerCase();
        const contactEmail = (bo.contato?.email || '').toLowerCase();

        const isMatch =
          numStr === cleanQ ||
          idStr === cleanQ ||
          (cleanQ.length >= 4 && (contactName.includes(cleanQ) || contactEmail.includes(cleanQ)));

        if (isMatch && !localMatches.some((lm) => lm.blingOrderId === bo.id || lm.orderId === bo.numero)) {
          blingMatches.push({
            orderId: bo.id,
            orderNumber: `#${bo.numero || bo.id}`,
            status: 'open',
            paymentStatus: 'paid',
            shippingStatus: bo.transporte?.etiqueta ? 'shipped' : 'unshipped',
            shippingCarrier: bo.transporte?.transportador?.nome || 'Melhor Envio',
            trackingNumber: bo.transporte?.etiqueta?.codigoRastreamento || null,
            trackingUrl: bo.transporte?.etiqueta?.codigoRastreamento
              ? `https://melhorenvio.com.br/rastreio/${bo.transporte.etiqueta.codigoRastreamento}`
              : null,
            paymentMethod: 'Mercado Pago / Bling ERP',
            paymentId: String(bo.id),
            blingOrderId: bo.id,
            customer: {
              name: bo.contato?.nome || 'Cliente Street Store',
              email: bo.contato?.email || '',
              phone: bo.contato?.celular || bo.contato?.telefone || '',
            },
            products: (bo.itens || []).map((it: any) => ({
              name: it.descricao || 'Peça Street Store',
              price: Number(it.valor || 0),
              quantity: Number(it.quantidade || 1),
              variant: it.codigo || '',
              image: '',
            })),
            total: Number(bo.total || 0),
            createdAt: bo.data || new Date().toISOString(),
            paidAt: bo.data || null,
            shippedAt: null,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('[Orders Track] Bling lookup notice:', err?.message || err);
  }

  return [...localMatches, ...blingMatches];
}

export function requestStoreOrderReturn(params: {
  orderId: number | string;
  orderNumber: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  customerName?: string;
  customerPhone?: string;
  reason: string;
  actionRequested: string;
  selectedItems: string[];
  details: string;
}): { success: boolean; protocol: string; message: string } {
  const protocol = `DEV-${String(params.orderNumber || params.orderId).replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-4) || 'ST'}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;

  const db = loadOrdersDb();
  const order = db.orders.find(
    (o) => String(o.orderId) === String(params.orderId) || o.orderNumber === params.orderNumber
  );

  if (order) {
    if (!Array.isArray(order.returnRequests)) order.returnRequests = [];
    order.returnRequests.push({
      protocol,
      reason: params.reason,
      actionRequested: params.actionRequested,
      selectedItems: params.selectedItems,
      details: params.details,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
    saveOrdersDb(db);
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    protocol,
    message: 'Solicitação de devolução registrada com sucesso e vinculada à logística reversa Melhor Envio.',
  };
}
